  4S  "Game in spades"    shows S>=4 | (S>=5, partner.S>=3)
      when  partner.S>=4 | (partner.S>=3, S>=5)
      priority 2
  4H  "Game in hearts"    shows H>=4 | (H>=5, partner.H>=3)
      when  partner.H>=4 | (partner.H>=3, H>=5)
      priority 1
  3N  "Game in notrump: diamonds held"   shows stop(D), D>=3
  5C  "Game in clubs"     shows C>=3
      priority -1
  P   "Partner's 3NT"
      when  partner.last=3N
      priority -1
  3N  "Game in notrump"
      priority -2

# They come in over the sign-off: opener passes (responder may act).
after 2D (P) 2H (*) | 2D (P) 2S (*) | 2D (P) 3C (*)
  P   "No further bid"
      priority -5
files.conventions/bidding_conventions/roudi/ro:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Roudi: after 1m-1M-1NT, responder's 2C is artificial, invitational or
# better, and asks about support and strength. Opener (WB5_Roudi's
# definition, which BBA's corpus follows): 2D minimum without three of
# responder's major, 2H minimum with three, 2S maximum with three, 2NT
# maximum without, three of opener's minor maximum with three and five
# of the minor. Played instead of NMF. See roudi.notes.md.

module roudi "Roudi"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/roudi
  needs  responder-rebids
  skill  bidding_conventions/roudi

after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) when !tw(m)
  2C  "Roudi: invitational or better, asks for support and strength"   alert
      shows M>=5 | (H>=4, S>=4), points>=11
      sets  forcing=round, ask=roudi
      artificial
      priority 1                       # ahead of a natural 2NT or 3NT

# Minimum is 12-13 HCP, maximum 14 (the 1NT rebid's range).
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) when !tw(m)
  2D  "Minimum, at most two {M}"           alert   shows hcp<=13, M<=2   artificial
  2H  "Minimum with three {M}"             alert   shows hcp<=13, M=3    artificial
  2S  "Maximum with three {M}"             alert   shows hcp>=14, M=3    artificial
  2N  "Maximum, at most two {M}"           alert   shows hcp>=14, M<=2
  3m  "Maximum with three {M} and five {m}"  alert shows hcp>=14, M=3, m>=5

# Responder. After a minimum: with a fit invite or bid game; without one
# 2NT invites and 3NT is game. After a maximum: game.
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2D (P) when !tw(m)
  2N  "Invitational, no fit"               shows points=11..12, M<=5   sets ask=nt_invite
  3M  "Invitational: six {M}"              shows M>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(M)
  3N  "Game"                               shows points>=13, M<=5
  4M  "Game: six {M}"                      shows M>=6, points>=13
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2H (P) when !tw(m)
  3M  "Invitational, in the fit"           shows M>=5, points=11..12   sets trump=M, ask=invite(M)
  4M  "Game in the fit"                    shows M>=5, points>=13      sets trump=M
  2N  "Invitational, four {M}"             shows M=4, points=11..12    sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game, four {M}"                     shows M=4, points>=13
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2S (P) | 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 3m (P) when !tw(m)
  4M  "Game in the fit"                    shows M>=5                  sets trump=M
  3N  "Game, four {M}"                     shows M=4
after 1m (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2N (P) when !tw(m)
  4M  "Game: six {M}"                      shows M>=6
  3N  "Game"                               shows M<=5
files.conventions/bidding_conventions/smolen/s:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Smolen. With five cards in one major, four in the other and game values,
# responder bids Stayman (stayman.bid gives 5-4 hands priority for it);
# when opener denies a major, responder bids three of the FOUR-card major,
# showing five of the other. Opener, who has two or three of that suit,
# bids 3NT or game in the 5-3 fit, so the notrump opener declares either
# way. With three spades and a maximum, after 3♥ opener has room to agree
# spades below game (3♠): a slam try. Once a suit is agreed the keycard
# and control-bid modules take over; nothing here names them.
#
# Written against the Stayman question, not the auction: `answered
# majors` with opener's answer denying both majors covers 1NT–2♣–2♦,
# 2NT–3♣–3♦ (Smolen_after_2N) and the same with systems on after
# interference, as BBA plays it. Notes: smolen.notes.md.

module smolen "Smolen: 5-4 in the majors after Stayman's denial"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/smolen
  needs  stayman
  skill  bidding_conventions/smolen
  param  style = general.style

when answered majors, partner.H<=3, partner.S<=3
  3H  "Smolen: four hearts, five spades, game forcing"  alert
      shows H=4, S=5, strength>=game
      when  style is not bba
      sets  forcing=game, ask=smolen(S)
      artificial
      priority 1                          # ahead of 3NT, which now denies 5-4
  3S  "Smolen: four spades, five hearts, game forcing"  alert
      shows S=4, H=5, strength>=game
      when  style is not bba
      sets  forcing=game, ask=smolen(H)
      artificial
      priority 1
  # BBA (probes/smolen-resp-1N.toml): from 10 HCP opposite 15-17, in
  # HCP; with 8-9 it bids two of the five-card major.
  3H  "Smolen: four hearts, five spades, game forcing"  alert
      shows H=4, S=5, hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min
      when  style is bba
      sets  forcing=game, ask=smolen(S)
      artificial
      priority 1
  3S  "Smolen: four spades, five hearts, game forcing"  alert
      shows S=4, H=5, hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min
      when  style is bba
      sets  forcing=game, ask=smolen(H)
      artificial
      priority 1

# Opener: two or three cards in responder's five-card major (the 2♦ or
# 3♦ answer denied four). BBA (probes/smolen-opener-3H.toml, 3S): game
# with three, 3NT with two, whatever the strength; after 3♥, 3♠ with
# three spades and a maximum (17 opposite 15-17, every time).
when asked smolen(M)
  3S    "Three spades and a maximum: slam interest"
        shows S>=3, hcp>=shown.hcp.max
        when  M is S
        sets  trump=S
        priority 1                        # ahead of 4S
  4{M}  "Three {M}: game in the five-three fit"
        shows M>=3
        sets  trump=M
  3N    "Two {M}: no fit, play 3NT"
        shows M<=2

# Responder after 3NT: no fit. The slam counts after Stayman apply
# (stayman.bid): 6NT with 32 between us, else pass.
when answered smolen(M), partner.last=3N
  6N  "No fit, but slam values"           shows points>=32-partner.hcp.min
  P   "No fit: 3NT"
      priority -5
# After a fit (4M, or opener's 3♠) the agreed suit is enough: keycard
# (rkcb-1430.bid, blackwood.bid) and control bids (control-bids.bid) read
# `we.trump` and the game force; otherwise game (base.bid).
files.conventions/bidding_conventions/splinter:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Splinters over a major opening: responder's double jump in a new suit
# (1♥–3♠, 4♣, 4♦; 1♠–4♣, 4♦, 4♥) agrees opener's major with four or more
# trumps, game values, and a singleton or void in the suit bid; opener's
# double jump after a one-level major response (1♦–1♠–4♣) agrees
# responder's major with 17-21. Also: responder's double jump in the
# overcaller's suit (1♥ (2♣) 4♣), opener's jump over a two-over-one
# (1♠–2♥–4♣, 1♥–2♣–3♠), responder's over opener's raise (1♣–1♥–2♥–3♠)
# and over opener's second suit (1♣–1♥–1♠–4♦), at the end of the file.
# The splinterer's partner counts honours
# in the short suit as wasted (the ace is not) and bids game, or makes a
# slam try that the slam machinery (slam/) carries on. Wikipedia,
# "Splinter bid"; BBA probes probes/splinter-*.toml. See
# splinters.notes.md. The slam-or-game sections count support points
# less the honours wasted opposite the shortness (`tp(M) - wasted_hcp`, the
# engine's term since 2026-11-07: K 3, Q 2, J 1 opposite a singleton;
# it was eight spelled-out combinations before).
#
# A double jump is never a jump shift here: strong jump shifts are single
# jumps (1♥–2♠), invitational ones single jumps to the three level
# (1♠–3♣); the double jumps had no meaning before.

module splinters "Splinters over 1♥ / 1♠"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/splinters
  needs  responses
  skill  bidding_conventions/splinters
  param  by_resp = by_responder default true
  param  by_open = by_opener default true
  param  cue     = bidding_conventions/control_bids default false
  param  style   = bidding_conventions/control_bids:style default first_or_second_round
  param  rkcb   = bidding_conventions/roman_keycard default false
  # Under Transfer Walsh 1C-1D/1H are transfers: opener's splinters
  # read them as natural and agreed the wrong major (self A/B, 2026-10-05).
  param  twalsh  = bidding_conventions/transfer_walsh default false

# ── Responder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 12-15 HCP with a small singleton, 11 with a void (BBA, both probes);
# above that, Jacoby 2NT. A singleton honour, the ace included, is not
# shortness to show: those hands bid Jacoby 2NT too (BBA). A passed hand
# splinters with a maximum, 10-11 and four trumps.
after 1H (P) when by_resp
  3S  "Splinter: 4+ hearts, game values, at most one spade"  alert
      shows H>=4, S<=1, !has(A,S), !has(K,S), !has(Q,S), !has(J,S), tp(H)>=15
      shows hcp=12..15 | (hcp=11, S=0)
      when  !passed_hand

# ── Later splinters (2026-10-30) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Where the splinter comes a round later: opener's over a two-over-one,
# responder's over opener's raise or opener's second suit. The partner
# counts as above (support points less the honours wasted in the short
# suit, `tp(t) - wasted_hcp`) against a threshold set by what the splinter
# showed.
define spl_short(s) = s<=1, !has(A,s), !has(K,s), !has(Q,s), !has(J,s)
define spl_bare(t, s) = (t is not C, s is not C, C>=2, !has(A,C), !has(K,C)) | (t is not D, s is not D, D>=2, !has(A,D), !has(K,D)) | (t is not H, s is not H, H>=2, !has(A,H), !has(K,H)) | (t is not S, s is not S, S>=2, !has(A,S), !has(K,S))

# Opener over a two-over-one: a double jump (1♠–2♥–4♣/4♦) agrees
# responder's hearts with four, a singleton or void and 14+ HCP: the fast 4♥ (1♠–2♥–4♥) is
# the minimum, so the splinter has slam interest. Seat 1 or 2: after a
# passed hand 2♣ is Drury and 2♥ no two-over-one. Opener's splinters
# raising a two-over-one minor (1♥–2m–3♠, 1♠–2♣–4♦) and 1♠–2m–3♥ stay
# natural for now (Rick, 2026-10-31: advanced splinters deserve research
# as a whole).
after 1S (P) 2H (P) when by_open, seat <= 2
  4y  "Splinter: 4+ hearts, 14+, at most one {y}"  alert
      shows H>=4, spl_short(y), hcp>=14
      when  y is C | y is D
      sets  trump=H, forcing=game
      artificial
      priority 2
# Responder over it: the two-over-one was 12+ (11+ forcing), opener
# 14+ with shortness, so 16 support points less waste make the try.
after 1S (P) 2H (P) 4y (P) when by_open, y is C | y is D
  4H  "Game: no slam interest"
      shows !tp(H) - wasted_hcp >= 16
      priority 13
  cheapest(C)  "Slam try: control bid in ♣"  alert
      shows tp(H) - wasted_hcp >= 16
      when  cue, H is not C, y is not C, under_game(C), has(A,C) | C<=0 | (style is first_or_second_round, has(K,C) | C<=1)
      when  spl_bare(H,y)
      sets  ask=control(C), ladder=control
      artificial
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(C)
      priority 14
  cheapest(D)  "Slam try: control bid in ♦"  alert
      shows tp(H) - wasted_hcp >= 16
      when  cue, H is not D, y is not D, under_game(D), has(A,D) | D<=0 | (style is first_or_second_round, has(K,D) | D<=1)
      when  spl_bare(H,y)
      sets  ask=control(D), ladder=control
      artificial
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(D)
      priority 14
  cheapest(H)  "Slam try: control bid in ♥"  alert
      shows tp(H) - wasted_hcp >= 16
      when  cue, H is not H, y is not H, under_game(H), has(A,H) | H<=0 | (style is first_or_second_round, has(K,H) | H<=1)
      when  spl_bare(H,y)

      artificial
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(H)
      priority 14
  cheapest(S)  "Slam try: control bid in ♠"  alert
      shows tp(H) - wasted_hcp >= 16
      when  cue, H is not S, y is not S, under_game(S), has(A,S) | S<=0 | (style is first_or_second_round, has(K,S) | S<=1)
      when  spl_bare(H,y)

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.

module stayman "Stayman"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/stayman default true
  needs  notrump-base
  skill  bidding_conventions/stayman
  param  minors = bidding_conventions/minor_suit_transfers:style default relay
  param  mtp    = bidding_conventions/minor_suit_transfers:over_1nt default true
  param  systems_on = nt_overcalls.direct.systems_on default true
  param  vs_double = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:vs_double default false
  param  vs_2c = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:vs_2c default false
  param  style = general.style
  param  jacoby = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers default true
  param  smolen = bidding_conventions/smolen default false

after nt1 when !they.bid | systems_on
  2C  "Stayman: asks for a 4-card major"  alert
      shows strength>=invite, H=4 | S=4 | ((mtp, minors is four_way | minors is four_way_reversed), strength=invite, C<=5, D<=5), H<=4 | S<=3 | strength>=game
      when  !shape 4333 | ((mtp, minors is four_way | minors is four_way_reversed), strength=invite)
      when  style is not bba
      # 5 hearts and 4 spades below game transfers, then bids 2S
      # (jacoby-transfers.bid; BBA's treatment, Rick 2026-09-24).
      # Other 5-4 in the majors included (Smolen). 4-3-3-3 just bids notrump, except
      # with four-way transfers, where 2NT is not natural: invitational hands
      # go through Stayman, with or without a major, and bid 2NT next. A
      # six-card minor transfers instead (minor-transfers.bid): opposite
      # good support it bids 3NT.
      sets  forcing=round, ask=majors
      artificial
      priority 1                           # ahead of transfers with 5-4 majors
  2C  "Stayman: asks for a 4-card major"  alert
      shows hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, (H=4 | S=4, H<=5, S<=5, H<=4 | hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min) | ((mtp, minors is four_way | minors is four_way_reversed), strength=invite, C<=5, D<=5)
      when  style is bba
      # BBA (probed 2026-09-24): a four-card major and 7 HCP, whatever the
      # shape (4-3-3-3 too) or the tens; 2NT next shows 7-9. A six-card
      # major transfers, and so does 5 hearts and 4 spades below game
      # values (2D, then 2S: jacoby-transfers.bid). stayman.notes.md.
      sets  forcing=round, ask=majors
      artificial
      priority 1

  # Without transfers an invitational hand with a five-card major starts
  # with Stayman and bids two of the major over 2♦ (BBA, bare SAYC: 7-8
  # HCP with five, probes/nt-van-5m-resp.toml). Below the 4-card-major
  # rule, which partner reads 2♣ by: the answer is the same.
  2C  "Stayman: invitational with a five-card major"  alert
      shows H>=5 | S>=5, strength=invite, hcp>=7
      when  !jacoby, style is not bba
      sets  forcing=round, ask=majors
      artificial

# Opener. With both majors the first rule that fits (2H) wins.
after nt1 2C (P)
  2H  "4+ hearts"                 shows H>=4
  2S  "4 spades, not 4 hearts"    shows S>=4, H<=3
  2D  "No 4-card major"           shows H<=3, S<=3

# Responder's second call. No auction patterns: a fit is whatever opener's
# answer has shown. Without a fit, 2NT and 3NT imply the other major, and
# opener corrects with four of it (choice-of-games.bid).
#
# Once the fit is found, responder also counts support points, tp(x) (HCP
# plus shortness, capped by the trumps held): they can raise an invitation
# to game or a game to slam. Those rules come as extras beside the
# total-point ones, which stay the ones partner reads the negative
# inferences from (3NT here denies the fit only through them).
when answered majors
  # Five spades and four hearts, invitational: 2♠ over the 2♦ denial
  # (Smolen_Invitational; BBA bids it with 8-9 HCP,
  # probes/smolen-resp-1N.toml). With five hearts and four spades an
  # invitation transfers instead (jacoby-transfers.bid). Game-forcing
  # 5-4 hands use Smolen (smolen.bid).
  2S  "Five spades, four hearts, invitational"   shows S=5, H=4, strength=invite
      when  partner.last=2D, style is not bba
      sets  ask=spades_invite
  2S  "Five spades, four hearts, invitational"   shows S=5, H=4, hcp>=23-partner.hcp.min, hcp<=24-partner.hcp.min
      when  partner.last=2D, style is bba
      sets  ask=spades_invite
  # Without transfers: an invitation with five (or more) in a major,
  # after 2C with that hand (above). Over 2♥ the spades are new; over a
  # 4-card answer in the five-card major responder raises instead.
  2H  "Five or more hearts, invitational"   shows H>=5, H>S, strength=invite
      when  partner.last=2D, !jacoby, style is not bba
      sets  ask=invite(H)
  2S  "Five or more spades, invitational"   shows S>=5, strength=invite
      when  partner.last=2D | partner.last=2H, !jacoby, style is not bba
      when  H<=3                    # with four hearts: Smolen's 2S over 2D, a raise over 2H
      sets  ask=invite(S)
  # Without transfers or Smolen, 5-4 in the majors with game values bids
  # the five-card major over the denial, forcing: opener chooses 4M or
  # 3NT as over 1NT-3M (one-nt.bid, `choose_game`).
  3S  "Five spades, game forcing"   shows S>=5, S>=H, strength>=game
      when  partner.last=2D, !jacoby, !smolen
      sets  forcing=game, ask=choose_game(S)
  3H  "Five hearts, game forcing"   shows H>=5, H>S, strength>=game
      when  partner.last=2D, !jacoby, !smolen
      sets  forcing=game, ask=choose_game(H)
  6H  "Slam in the heart fit"                     shows H>=4, strength=slam   when partner.H>=4
      sets  trump=H
  6S  "Slam in the spade fit"                     shows S>=4, strength=slam   when partner.S>=4
      sets  trump=S
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"                     shows H>=4, strength>=game  when partner.H>=4, style is not bba
      sets  trump=H
  3H  "Invitational raise in hearts"              shows H>=4, strength=invite when partner.H>=4, style is not bba
      sets ask=invite(H), trump=H
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"                     shows S>=4, strength>=game  when partner.S>=4, style is not bba
      sets  trump=S
  3S  "Invitational raise in spades"              shows S>=4, strength=invite when partner.S>=4, style is not bba
      sets ask=invite(S), trump=S
  6H  "Slam in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, tp(H)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  partner.H>=4
      sets  trump=H
  6S  "Slam in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, tp(S)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  partner.S>=4
      sets  trump=S
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, tp(H)>=25-partner.points.min
      when  partner.H>=4, strength<=invite
      when  style is not bba
      sets  trump=H
      priority 1                                  # support points raise an invitation to game
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, tp(S)>=25-partner.points.min
      when  partner.S>=4, strength<=invite
      when  style is not bba
      sets  trump=S
      priority 1
  # Rick, 2026-09-24: balanced 16-17 with no fit, as over 1NT: 4NT with
  # 16, 6NT with 17 (32 combined opposite a minimum).
  # After a stronger opening (2NT: 20-21) the counts, fitted opposite
  # 15-17, do not apply: the earlier rules, measured against partner's range.
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.min | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=0)
      when  partner.H>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=H
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.min, !shape 4333) | hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=22-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=0)
      when  partner.H>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba                          # at IMPs a point bolder
      sets  trump=H
  3H  "Invitational raise in hearts"  shows H>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.max, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.max | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=0), (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.min, shortest>=1) | (hcp<=25-partner.hcp.min, shape 4333) | hcp<=23-partner.hcp.min
      when  partner.H>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(H), trump=H
  3H  "Invitational raise in hearts"  shows H>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.max, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.max | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=0), (hcp<=23-partner.hcp.min, shortest>=2) | (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.min, shape 4333) | (hcp<=22-partner.hcp.min, shortest=1) | hcp<=21-partner.hcp.min
      when  partner.H>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(H), trump=H
  P   "Weak with the heart fit: play here"  shows H>=4, (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest>=2) | (hcp<=25-partner.hcp.max, shape 4333) | (hcp<=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest=1) | hcp<=22-partner.hcp.max
      when  partner.H>=4, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.min | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=0)
      when  partner.S>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=S
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.min, !shape 4333) | hcp>=25-partner.hcp.min | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=22-partner.hcp.min, shortest<=0)
      when  partner.S>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba                          # at IMPs a point bolder
      sets  trump=S
  3S  "Invitational raise in spades"  shows S>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.max, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.max | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=0), (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.min, shortest>=1) | (hcp<=25-partner.hcp.min, shape 4333) | hcp<=23-partner.hcp.min
      when  partner.S>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(S), trump=S
  3S  "Invitational raise in spades"  shows S>=4, (hcp>=25-partner.hcp.max, !shape 4333) | hcp>=26-partner.hcp.max | (hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=1) | (hcp>=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest<=0), (hcp<=23-partner.hcp.min, shortest>=2) | (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.min, shape 4333) | (hcp<=22-partner.hcp.min, shortest=1) | hcp<=21-partner.hcp.min
      when  partner.S>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(S), trump=S
  P   "Weak with the spade fit: play here"  shows S>=4, (hcp<=24-partner.hcp.max, shortest>=2) | (hcp<=25-partner.hcp.max, shape 4333) | (hcp<=23-partner.hcp.max, shortest=1) | hcp<=22-partner.hcp.max
      when  partner.S>=4, partner.hcp.min<=14 | partner.hcp.max>=18
      when  style is bba
  6N  "Slam: 17 or more, no fit found"           shows points>=32-partner.hcp.min
      when  style is not bba
      priority -1
  4N  "Quantitative, no fit found"               shows balanced, strength=slam_invite, points<=31-partner.hcp.min
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      when  style is not bba
      sets  ask=quant
      priority -1
  3N  "Game: {game} total points, no fit found"   shows strength=game         sets ask=choice
      when  style is not bba
      priority -1                                 # a known major fit first
  2N  "Invitational: {invite} total points, no fit found"
      shows strength=invite
      when  style is not bba
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority -1                                 # a known major fit first

# The BBA treatment (probed and fitted 2026-09-24, stayman.notes.md,
# "BBA's counts after Stayman"). With the fit found BBA counts honours
# (tens worth nothing), about half a point for each doubleton, a third to
# a half less for 4-3-3-3: invite from 8 opposite 15-17, game from 10 at
# matchpoints, ~9.3 at IMPs. Without a fit 3NT against 2NT is the same
# kind of count with tens worth a third and a doubleton spade without A or
# K charged two points. The counts are engine measures (bba_stay_*).
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, bba_stay_game_points>=10
      when  partner.H>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=H
  3H  "Invitational raise in hearts"  shows H>=4, bba_stay_raise_points>=8, bba_stay_game_points<=9
      when  partner.H>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(H), trump=H
  P   "Weak with the heart fit: play here"  shows H>=4, bba_stay_raise_points<=7
      when  partner.H>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"  shows H>=4, bba_stay_game_imp_points>=10
      when  partner.H>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=H

      when  partner.H>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sgame_points>=10
      when  partner.S>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=S
  3S  "Invitational raise in spades"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sraise_points>=8, bba_stay_sgame_points<=9
      when  partner.S>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(S), trump=S
  P   "Weak with the spade fit: play here"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sraise_points<=7
      when  partner.S>=4, matchpoints, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sgame_imp_points>=10
      when  partner.S>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  trump=S
  3S  "Invitational raise in spades"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sraise_imp_points>=8, bba_stay_sgame_imp_points<=9
      when  partner.S>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
      sets  ask=fit_invite(S), trump=S
  P   "Weak with the spade fit: play here"  shows S>=4, bba_stay_sraise_imp_points<=7
      when  partner.S>=4, imps, partner.hcp.min>=15, partner.hcp.max<=17
      when  style is bba
  6N  "Slam: 17 or more, no fit found"  shows points>=32-partner.hcp.min
      when  style is bba                          # as over 1NT: 17 bids the slam
      priority -1

      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)

# BBA: opener answers the raise in the fit with a maximum (17 counting
# tens opposite 15-17), or one less with a fifth trump. Partner's range
# is no guide: the raise is in HCP by shape.
when asked fit_invite(M)
  4M  "Accepts: a maximum"             shows points>=shown.hcp.max | (M>=5, points>=shown.hcp.max-1)
  P   "Declines: not a maximum"        shows points<=shown.hcp.max-1, M<=4 | points<=shown.hcp.max-2

# Opener over the invitational 2♠ (five spades, four hearts): game with
# the top of the range, in spades with three, else 3NT; a minimum passes.
when asked spades_invite
  4S  "Accepts, three spades"          shows S>=3, hcp>=shown.hcp.max-1
  3N  "Accepts, two spades"            shows S<=2, hcp>=shown.hcp.max-1
  P   "Declines: a minimum"            shows hcp<=shown.hcp.max-2

# BBA: after 2NT opener shows his four spades with 3S when he declines;
# responder, who has them too, bids game with 9 (probed 2026-09-24).
after 1N (P) 2C (P) 2H (P) 2N (P) 3S (P) when style is bba
  4S  "Game in the spade fit: the top of the invitation"  shows S>=4, hcp>=26-partner.hcp.max
  P   "Minimum: play 3S"                                  shows hcp<=25-partner.hcp.max

# ── Under interference ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Two card switches say the 1NT structure survives RHO's action:
# `transfers.vs_double` keeps it over a double, and `transfers.vs_2c`
# over a 2♣ overcall. Over the double 2♣ is still Stayman; over 2♣ the
# call is gone and the double takes its place, which is what BBA plays
# on every card in the corpus that sets the switch.

# Over the double Stayman starts a point below the invitational floor
# (7 opposite 15-17): finding the 4-4 fit is also somewhere to run to.
# It denies a five-card major, unlike the uncontested 2C: with 5-4 BBA
# transfers rather than looking for the other major first.
after 1N (X) when vs_double
  2C  "Stayman: asks for a 4-card major"  alert
      shows hcp>=24-partner.hcp.max, H=4 | S=4
      when  H<=4, S<=4
      sets  forcing=round, ask=majors
      artificial
      priority 1

after 1N (2C) when vs_2c
  X   "Stayman: asks for a 4-card major"  alert
      shows strength>=invite, H=4 | S=4
      when  H<=4, S<=4
      sets  forcing=round, ask=majors
      artificial
      priority 1

# Opener answers, one level higher over the 2♣ overcall.
after 1N (X) 2C (P) when vs_double
  2H  "4+ hearts"                 shows H>=4
  2S  "4 spades, not 4 hearts"    shows S>=4, H<=3
  2D  "No 4-card major"           shows H<=3, S<=3

after 1N (2C) X (P) when vs_2c
  2H  "4+ hearts"                 shows H>=4
  2S  "4 spades, not 4 hearts"    shows S>=4, H<=3
  2D  "No 4-card major"           shows H<=3, S<=3

# BBA: opener after responder's 3m (probed 2026-09-24,
# probes/stay-3m-opener*.toml). A suit is open when the other minor is
# unstopped or, after 2D, a major doubleton is (responder's major is
# unknown); an open three-card major is no reason. Opener raises with a
# fit and a suit open, or with a flat minimum; 5m with 17. Otherwise
# 3NT, except with a minimum (15, counting tens): after 2D, 3D over 3C
# without four clubs and 4C over 3D with five; after a major, 3D over 3C
# with four diamonds, and after 2S 3H with a flat 4-3-3-3 (responder has
# four hearts).

  4C  "Fit, a flat minimum"          shows C>=4, shortest>=3, points<=15   priority 2
  3D  "Minimum, no club fit"         shows C<=3, points<=15   priority 1
  3N  "To play"                      shows hcp>=15

  5D  "To play"                    shows hcp>=15
after 1N (P) 2C (P) 2S (P) 4C (P) 5C (P) when style is bba

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.

module texas-transfers "Texas Transfers"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/texas
  needs  notrump-base
  skill  bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers
  param  tu = two_under default false
  param  tex1 = over_1nt default false
  param  tex2 = over_2nt default false
  param  o23 = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:over_2c_3nt default true

# Texas shows a six-card major and one of two hands: game with no slam
# interest (pass the completion), or slam values (keycard after it): 33 total
# points or more even opposite opener's minimum, so 18+ opposite 15-17,
# in suit points or in support points (HCP + shortness, the fit being
# certain with six trumps). With
# mild slam interest responder transfers at the two level and jumps to game
# instead (jacoby-transfers.bid), which lets opener bid on. Game values
# count HCP and length points (8 + 2 for six cards = 10 opposite 15-17:
# Rick, 2026-10-29); the top of game-only and the slam band are in suit
# points.
#
# Where (Rick, 2026-10-29): every notrump of ours where the system is on
# (`systems`, one-nt.bid): the 1NT and 2NT openings, our notrump overcall
# and balancing notrump as the card says, 2♣–2♦–2NT, Kokish's
# 2♣–2♦–2♥–2♠–2NT, 2♣ and a positive then 2NT. The strength bands are
# measured against opener's range, so the same rules serve every one.
# Over interference Texas stays on as long as it is a jump: a double, or
# any bid that leaves three of the transfer suit available (4♦ over
# 2-level bids and 3♣, 4♥ also over 3♦), and never into their suit.
# `notrump.jacoby_transfers.vs_2c` is a different question (2♦/2♥ transfers over
# their 2♣, nt-interference.bid) and does not switch Texas.
define texas_room_d = !tu, !me.named(H), rho.last=P | rho.last=X | (they.level<=2, they.strain is not H) | (they.level=3, they.strain is C)
# 2-under Texas (`notrump.texas.two_under`, Rick 2026-10-29): one
# step lower, 4♣ for hearts and 4♦ for spades, with the same hands; opener
# bids the suit in between to super-accept (four trumps, the top of his
# range) or four of the major. 4♥ is then natural (Rick, 2026-10-29).
define texas2_room_c = tu, !me.named(H), rho.last=P | rho.last=X | (they.level<=2, they.strain is not H)
define texas2_room_d = tu, !me.named(S), rho.last=P | rho.last=X | (they.level<=2, they.strain is not S) | (they.level=3, they.strain is C)
define texas_room_h = !tu, !me.named(S), rho.last=P | rho.last=X | (they.level<=2, they.strain is not S) | (they.level=3, they.strain is C | they.strain is D)

# Over 2♣–2♦–3NT only with `notrump.jacoby_transfers.over_2c_3nt` (Rick,
# 2026-11-07: "i would make this a treatment on the Jacoby Transfer card";
# "default to on"). Off, 4♦ and 4♥ there are natural.
# The card says where it plays Texas: over 1NT (and our 1NT overcalls),
# over 2NT (and the 2♣ auctions that reach 2NT or 3NT). A card that plays
# it over 1NT plays it over 2NT too, whatever its 2NT box says: most cards
# have one Texas box. Other modules read these two.
define texas_1nt = tex1
define texas_2nt = tex1 | tex2
define auction texas_entry = systems 1N (*)   when tex1
  systems 2N (*)   when tex1 | tex2
  2C (*) 2D (*) 3N (P)   when o23, tex1 | tex2

after texas_entry
  4D  "Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=30-partner.points.max
      when  texas_room_d
      sets  ask=texas(H)
      artificial
  4D  "Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, suit_points>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_d
      sets  ask=texas(H)
      artificial
  4D  "Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, tp(H)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_d
      sets  ask=texas(H)
      artificial
  4H  "Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=30-partner.points.max
      when  texas_room_h
      sets  ask=texas(S)
      artificial
  4H  "Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, suit_points>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_h
      sets  ask=texas(S)
      artificial
  4H  "Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, tp(S)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_h
      sets  ask=texas(S)
      artificial
  # Over interference Texas doubles as a preempt: with seven cards and
  # no values BBA transfers straight to game rather than to the two
  # level, and takes the auction away from them.
  4D  "Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=7, hcp>=4, suit_strength=signoff
      when  !(rho.last=P | rho.last=X), texas_room_d
      sets  ask=texas(H)
      artificial
  4H  "Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=7, hcp>=4, suit_strength=signoff
      when  !(rho.last=P | rho.last=X), texas_room_h
      sets  ask=texas(S)
      artificial

  # 2-under Texas: the same hands, one step lower.
  4C  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=30-partner.points.max
      when  texas2_room_c
      sets  ask=texas2(H)
      artificial
  4C  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, suit_points>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_c
      sets  ask=texas2(H)
      artificial
  4C  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, tp(H)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_c
      sets  ask=texas2(H)
      artificial
  4D  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=30-partner.points.max
      when  texas2_room_d
      sets  ask=texas2(S)
      artificial
  4D  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, suit_points>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_d
      sets  ask=texas2(S)
      artificial
  4D  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, tp(S)>=33-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_d
      sets  ask=texas2(S)
      artificial
  4C  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♥, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=7, hcp>=4, suit_strength=signoff
      when  !(rho.last=P | rho.last=X), texas2_room_c
      sets  ask=texas2(H)
      artificial
  4D  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♠, game only or slam values"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=7, hcp>=4, suit_strength=signoff
      when  !(rho.last=P | rho.last=X), texas2_room_d
      sets  ask=texas2(S)
      artificial

# After 2♣–2♦–3NT there is no Jacoby route for the mild slam hands
# between the two bands (31-32 combined): opposite Kokish's 26-27 (strong-
# openings.bid) that is a 4-5 count with six hearts, which passed 3NT
# (base fallback). They bid game through Texas (2026-11-07).
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 3N (P) when o23
  4D  "Texas: 6+ ♥, game"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=32-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_d
      sets  ask=texas(H)
      artificial
      priority -1
  4H  "Texas: 6+ ♠, game"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=32-partner.points.min
      when  texas_room_h
      sets  ask=texas(S)
      artificial
      priority -1
  4C  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♥, game"  announce "Transfer"
      shows H>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=32-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_c
      sets  ask=texas2(H)
      artificial
      priority -1
  4D  "2-under Texas: 6+ ♠, game"  announce "Transfer"
      shows S>=6, points>=25-partner.points.min, suit_points<=32-partner.points.min
      when  texas2_room_d
      sets  ask=texas2(S)
      artificial
      priority -1

# Opener completes, whatever came in between, when it is still legal.
when asked texas(H)
  4H  "Completes the transfer"
when asked texas(S)
  4S  "Completes the transfer"

when answered texas(M)
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}"   shows suit_points>=33-partner.points.min   sets ask=keycards(M)  artificial
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}"   shows tp(M)>=33-partner.points.min   sets ask=keycards(M)  artificial
  P   "No slam interest"

# 2-under Texas: opener super-accepts with the suit in between, else
# completes; responder signs off over the super-accept or asks for keycards.
when asked texas2(H)
  4D  "Super-accept: four hearts, a maximum"   shows H>=4, hcp>=shown.hcp.max-1
      artificial
      priority 1
  4H  "Completes the transfer"
when asked texas2(S)
  4H  "Super-accept: four spades, a maximum"   shows S>=4, hcp>=shown.hcp.max-1
      artificial
      priority 1
  4S  "Completes the transfer"

when answered texas2(M)
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}"   shows suit_points>=33-partner.points.min   sets ask=keycards(M)  artificial
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}"   shows tp(M)>=33-partner.points.min   sets ask=keycards(M)  artificial
  4{M} "Signoff"
      when  !(partner.last=4{M})
  P   "No slam interest"
      when  partner.last=4{M}

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Wilkosz 2♦ (Polish; BBO forum "Wilkosz responses", Matula's scheme;
# BBA's `Wilkosz`, probes/b2-Wilkosz-*.toml): a weak two-suiter, five or
# more cards in each of two suits, at least one of them a major (both
# minors are excluded), 5-10 HCP. The weak 2♦ is off (preempts.bid).
#
# Responder (BBA where it differs from Matula):
#
#   2♥   pass or correct: opener passes with hearts, else bids 2♠
#   2♠   pass or correct: opener passes with spades, else bids his minor
#   2NT  14+, asks: 3♣ clubs and a major, 3♦ diamonds and hearts,
#        3♥ both majors, 3♠ spades and diamonds
#   3♣   six or more clubs: to play
#   3♦   invitational, three or more in both majors: opener bids 3M
#        with a minimum, 4M with a maximum
#   4♦   game: bid your major
#
# See wilkosz.notes.md.

module wilkosz "Wilkosz 2♦"
  kind   convention
  convention  bidding_conventions/wilkosz
  needs  preempts
  skill  bidding_conventions/wilkosz

define wilkosz_shape = (H>=5, S>=5) | (H>=5, C>=5) | (H>=5, D>=5) | (S>=5, C>=5) | (S>=5, D>=5)

# ── The opening ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
when opening, seat<=3
  2D  "Wilkosz: 5-5 in two suits, one a major, 5-10"   alert
      shows hcp=5..10, wilkosz_shape
      artificial
      priority 1

# ── Responder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 2D (P) | 2D (X)
  2N  "Asks for the suits: 14+"   alert
      shows hcp>=14
      sets  forcing=game, ask=wilkosz
      artificial
  4D  "Game: bid your major"   alert
      shows H>=3, S>=3, hcp=12..13
      artificial
  3D  "Invitational: three or more in both majors"   alert
      shows H>=3, S>=3, hcp=10..11
      artificial
  3C  "Six or more clubs: to play"
      shows C>=6, hcp<=13
      priority 1
  2S  "Pass or correct: spades if you have them"   alert
      shows S>=3, S>H, hcp<=13
  2H  "Pass or correct: hearts if you have them"   alert
      shows hcp<=13
      artificial
      priority -1

# ── Opener: pass or correct ──────────────────────────────────────────
after 2D (P) 2H (P) | 2D (X) 2H (P)
  P   "Five or more hearts"              shows H>=5
  2S  "Spades and a minor"               shows S>=5, H<=4
after 2D (P) 2S (P) | 2D (X) 2S (P)
  P   "Five or more spades"              shows S>=5
  3C  "Hearts and clubs"                 shows H>=5, C>=5, S<=4
  3D  "Hearts and diamonds"              shows H>=5, D>=5, S<=4
after 2D (P) 3C (P) | 2D (X) 3C (P)
  P   "Partner's suit: to play"
after 2D (P) 3D (P) | 2D (X) 3D (P)
  4S  "Maximum, spades"     shows S>=5, hcp>=9, S>=H
  4H  "Maximum, hearts"     shows H>=5, hcp>=9
  3S  "Minimum, spades"     shows S>=5, S>=H
  3H  "Minimum, hearts"     shows H>=5
after 2D (P) 4D (P) | 2D (X) 4D (P)
  4S  "Spades"              shows S>=5, S>=H
  4H  "Hearts"              shows H>=5

# Responder after the correction to spades: pass with two, or bid 3♣
# pass-or-correct with fewer.
after 2D (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) | 2D (X) 2H (P) 2S (P)
  P   "Two or more spades: to play"     shows S>=2
  3C  "Short in spades: pass or correct to your minor"
      shows S<=1
after 2D (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) 3C (P) | 2D (X) 2H (P) 2S (P) 3C (P)
  P   "Spades and clubs"                 shows C>=5
  3D  "Spades and diamonds"              shows D>=5
after 2D (P) 2S (P) 3C (P) | 2D (P) 2S (P) 3D (P) | 2D (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) | 2D (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) | 2D (P) 3D (P) 3S (P)
  P   "Partner's suit: to play"

# They come in over the pass-or-correct response: opener passes.
after 2D (P) 2H (*) | 2D (P) 2S (*)
  P   "No further bid"
      priority -5

# ── Opener answers 2NT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
when asked wilkosz
  3H  "Both majors"                  shows H>=5, S>=5
      priority 1
  3C  "Clubs and a major"            shows C>=5
  3D  "Diamonds and hearts"          shows D>=5, H>=5
  3S  "Spades and diamonds"          shows S>=5, D>=5

# Responder: after 3♣ a major is still unknown; 3♦ asks for it.
after 2D (P) 2N (P) 3C (P)
  3D  "Which major?"   artificial
      priority 1
after 2D (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3D (P)
  3H  "Hearts and clubs"            shows H>=5
  3S  "Spades and clubs"            shows S>=5

# Responder places the contract: game in a fit, else 3NT.
after 2D (P) 2N (P) 3H (P) | 2D (P) 2N (P) 3D (P) | 2D (P) 2N (P) 3S (P) | 2D (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) | 2D (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) 3S (P)
  4S  "Game in spades"      shows S>=3
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2
  4H  "Game in hearts"      shows H>=3
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 1
  3N  "Game in notrump"
  5D  "Game in diamonds"    shows D>=3
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority -1
  5C  "Game in clubs"       shows C>=3
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority -1
