      priority -2
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 2y (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x
  3y  "Invitational: 11-12 with the fit"   shows tp(y)=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 13+ with the fit"             shows tp(y)>=13
      when  y is H | y is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {z} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(z)
      when  y is C | y is D
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 1N (P) | 1x (P) 1y (1z) 1N (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x, partner.hcp.min <= 13 | partner.hcp.max <= 16
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                shows points=11..12, y<=5
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+"                          shows points>=13, y<=5 | y is C | y is D
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}, 11-12"        shows y>=6, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 6+ {y}, 13+"                  shows y>=6, points>=13
      when  y is H | y is S
# Above a weak notrump opener's 1NT is 15-17 (rebids.bid): the counts
# are against his range, as after the uncontested 1NT rebid.
after 1x (1z) 1y (P) 1N (P) | 1x (P) 1y (1z) 1N (P) when z is not x, z is not y, y is not x, partner.hcp.min >= 14, partner.hcp.max >= 17
  2N  "Invitational"             shows nt_rebid_invite, y<=5
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game"                               shows nt_rebid_game, y<=5 | y is C | y is D
  3y  "Invitational: 6+ {y}"               shows y>=6, nt_rebid_invite
      sets  ask=invite(y)
  4y  "Game: 6+ {y}"                       shows y>=6, nt_rebid_game
      when  y is H | y is S

# ── Responder after a two-level free bid and opener's rebid ──────────
# Where the free bid is forcing (the 21GF cards) opener has to rebid and
# responder may hold anything from 8 up; where it is not, 8-12. Game
# with 13+, an invitation with 11-12, a pass with a minimum
# (2026-09-25: the forcing auctions died in opener's rebid).
# Opener named a major:
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 2M (P) | 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3M (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 2M (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3M (P) | 1x (2y) 3z (P) 3M (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y, M is not x, M is not y, M is not z
  4M  "Game: four {M}, 13+"                shows M>=4, points>=13
  cheapest(M) "Raise: four {M}, 11-12"     shows M>=4, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(M)
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y), M<=3
  cheapest(x) "Preference: 11-12"          shows x>=3, points=11..12, M<=3
      sets  ask=invite(x)
      priority -1
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(y) <= 18      # below 3NT
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
  P   "Minimum: no game"                   shows points<=10
      priority -5
  cheapest(x) "Preference: two or more {x}"   shows x>=2
      priority -6
# Opener rebid his own suit or raised mine:
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 2x (P) | 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3x (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3x (P) | 1x (2y) 3z (P) 3x (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  4x  "Game: 3+ {x}, 13+"                  shows x>=3, points>=13
      when  x is H | x is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y)
  cheapest(x) "Invitational raise: 3+ {x}, 11-12"   shows x>=3, points=11..12
      sets  ask=invite(x)
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(y) <= 18      # below 3NT
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
after 1x (1y) 2z (P) 3z (P) | 1x (2y) 2z (P) 3z (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y
  4z  "Game in the fit: 13+"               shows points>=13
      when  z is H | z is S
  3N  "Game: 13+, {y} stopped"             shows points>=13, stop(y)
      when  z is C | z is D
  cheapest(y) "Cue bid: 13+, no stopper, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows points>=13
      when  z is C | z is D, cheapest_rank(y) <= 18
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -2
# Opener raised a three-level minor to four: no room for a cue bid or
# 3NT (2026-09-25: the cue bid landed at 4 of their suit).
after 1x (2y) 3z (P) 4z (P) when y is not x, z is not x, z is not y, z is C | z is D
  5{z}  "Game in the minor: 13+"           shows points>=13
  P     "No game"                          shows points<=12
        priority -5

# ── We redoubled, they ran, opener rebid his suit ────────────────────
# The redouble showed 10+, so the hand is ours: responder does not treat
# opener's rebid as a sign-off (2026-09-26: 10-13 counts passed 2m and
# 2M with game on). Game with 12+, an invitation with 10-11.
after 1x (X) XX (1y) 2x (P) | 1x (X) XX (2y) 2x (P) | 1x (X) XX (1y) 3x (P) | 1x (X) XX (2y) 3x (P) when y is not x
  4{x} "Game: 12+ with a doubleton or better"   shows x>=2, hcp>=12
       when  x is H | x is S
  3N   "Game: 12+ with a stopper in {y}"        shows hcp>=12, stop(y)
       when  x is C | x is D | x<=1
  5{x} "Game in the minor: 13+"                 shows x>=2, hcp>=13
       when  x is C | x is D
       priority -1
  3{x} "Invitational: 10-11 with a doubleton"   shows x>=2, hcp=10..11
       when  partner.last=2{x}
       sets  ask=invite(x)
  P    "Minimum for the redouble: no game"
       priority -5

# ── Catch-all after partner's notrump rebid (Rick, 2026-09-27) ───────
# A notrump rebid is a ladder bid: partner has put a range on a balanced
# hand, so I am captain and bid game with 25 total points between us,
# counting partner at his minimum; opposite 1NT, invite when only his
# maximum reaches it. Below the specific rules (ticket b6: 1C X 1D P
# 2NT P, where 7 passed 18-19).
#
# Not in notrump when partner's shown length and mine make eight cards in
# a major (2026-09-28, NT_Ladder 426: 2C P 2S P 2NT P, where 2NT showed
# two spades and six-card spades bid 3NT): game, or an invitation, in
# the major instead.
when partner.last=1N | partner.last=2N, me.has_bid | style is not bba, partner.balanced, !they.bid | lho.last=P, we.trump is none, !asked
  3N  "Game in notrump"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      priority -8
  2N  "Invitational"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      when  partner.last=1N
      priority -8
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(S).min >= 8
      priority -8
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"
      shows we.points.min >= 25, we.fit(H).min >= 8
      priority -8
  3S  "Invitation in the spade fit"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(S).min >= 8
      when  partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=invite(S)
      priority -8
  3H  "Invitation in the heart fit"
      shows we.points.max >= 25, we.fit(H).min >= 8
      when  partner.last=1N
      sets  ask=invite(H)
      priority -8
  P   "No game"
      shows we.points.max <= 26
      priority -9
  # Slam over partner's notrump (2026-09-30: 2C 2D 2NT 3NT with 33 between
  # us, random deals): over-3nt.bid's calibrated HCP numbers, 6NT with 34
  # on partner's floor, a quantitative 4NT with 32-33.
  6N  "Slam in notrump"
      shows hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 34, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      priority -8
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT"
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      shows hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 32, hcp + partner.hcp.max <= 35, we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7
      sets  ask=quant
      priority -8

# Opener's strong double after 1x (X) 1z (1y): describe, cheapest first
# (ticket b6). Not after a support double (support-doubles.bid).
after 1x (X) 1z (1y) X (P) when z is not x, y is not x, y is not z, !asked support
  cheapest(N) "A stopper in {y}"   shows stop(y), z<=5
  cheapest(z) "Five or more {z}"           shows z>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Three or more of partner's {x}"          shows x>=3
  cheapest(z) "Rebids {z}"          priority -5
files.rules/base/responses.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responses to a one-level suit opening, uncontested: Standard American
# (SAYC), as BBA's Basic-Bridge card plays it. Ranges come from BBA's own
# meanings (bba-cli --all-meanings) and the Basic_* corpus; see
# responses.notes.md.
#
# Which suit to bid first at the one level: the longest; with two four-card
# suits the cheaper (up the line); with two five-card suits the higher.

module responses "Responses to one-level suit openings"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  skill  basic_bidding/responses_to_suit_openings
  skill  bidding_conventions/walsh
  skill  bidding_conventions/forcing_1nt
  skill  bidding_conventions/semi_forcing_1nt
  param  limit_raise = major_openings.jump_raise.inv default true
  param  bergen      = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises default false
  param  rbergen     = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises:reverse default false
  param  strong_js   = bidding_conventions/strong_jump_shifts:two_level default true
  param  inv_js      = bidding_conventions/strong_jump_shifts:invitational default false
  param  weak_js3    = bidding_conventions/weak_jump_shifts:three_level default false
  param  soloway     = bidding_conventions/soloway default false
  param  over_1c     = minor_openings.one_club_responses default up_the_line
  param  nt2         = minor_openings.two_nt_response default invitational
  param  style       = general.style
  param  system      = general.system   # `brill`: the Brill card's treatments (limit raises)
  param  inverted    = bidding_conventions/inverted_minors default false
  param  drury       = bidding_conventions/drury default false
  param  drury_rev   = bidding_conventions/drury:reverse default false
  param  gf21        = bidding_conventions/two_over_one default false
  param  f1n         = major_openings.one_nt_response.forcing default false
  param  twalsh      = bidding_conventions/transfer_walsh default false
  param  semi        = major_openings.one_nt_response.semi_forcing default false   # opener's pass: rebids.bid

# The invitational 1M-3M, unless Bergen raises (majors/bergen.bid) take
# the jump to 3M for a preemptive raise: a three-card limit raise then
# goes through 2M, as on a card without the limit raise.
define inv_jump_raise = limit_raise, !bergen, !rbergen

# ── Over 1♣ / 1♦ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1C (P) when over_1c is up_the_line, !twalsh   # Transfer Walsh: transfer-walsh.bid
  1D  "4+ diamonds, 6+ HCP"         shows D>=4, hcp>=6, D>=H, D>H | D=4, D>=S, D>S | D=4
      sets forcing=round
  1H  "4+ hearts, 6+ HCP"           shows H>=4, hcp>=6, H>=D, H>D | H>=5, H>=S, H>S | H=4
      sets forcing=round
  1S  "4+ spades, 6+ HCP"           shows S>=4, hcp>=6, S>=D, S>D | S>=5, S>H | S>=5, S>=H
      sets forcing=round

# Walsh: with a four-card major, bypass diamonds unless game forcing (12+ HCP).
after 1C (P) when over_1c is walsh, !twalsh
  1D  "Walsh: 4+ diamonds, no 4-card major unless 12+ HCP"
      shows D>=4, hcp>=6, (H<=3, S<=3) | hcp>=12, D>=H, D>=S
      sets forcing=round
  1H  "4+ hearts, 6+ HCP"           shows H>=4, hcp>=6, H>=S, H>S | H=4, hcp<=11 | H>D
      sets forcing=round
  1S  "4+ spades, 6+ HCP"           shows S>=4, hcp>=6, S>H | S>=5, S>=H, hcp<=11 | S>D
      sets forcing=round

after 1C (P)
  1N  "6-10 HCP, balanced, no 4-card major or diamonds"   shows hcp=6..10, H<=3, S<=3, D<=3
      when  !inverted | C<=4           # with inverted minors five clubs raise, weak or strong
  2D  "Strong jump shift: 15+, 5+ diamonds"  shows D>=5, hcp>=15  when strong_js, !wjs_on, !soloway, !passed_hand
      sets forcing=game

after 1D (P)
  1H  "4+ hearts, 6+ HCP"           shows H>=4, hcp>=6, H>=S, H>S | H=4
      when  hcp<=10 | H>=C | (gf21, hcp<=11 | points<=12)   # 11+ HCP with longer clubs: 2C first (a 2/1 card: only with game values)
      sets forcing=round
  1S  "4+ spades, 6+ HCP"           shows S>=4, hcp>=6, S>H | S>=5, S>=H
      when  hcp<=10 | S>=C | (gf21, hcp<=11 | points<=12)
      sets forcing=round
  1N  "6-10 HCP, no 4-card major"          shows hcp=6..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  !inverted | D<=4           # with inverted minors five diamonds raise
  2C  "11+ points, 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, points>=11 | C>=6, suit_points>=10, H<=3 | C>H, S<=3 | C>S
      when  !gf21
      sets forcing=round
  2C  "Two over one, game forcing: 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13), H<=3 | C>H, S<=3 | C>S
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      sets forcing=game
  3C  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ clubs"  shows C>=6, points=10..12, H<=3, S<=3  when inv_js, !weak_js3

after 1m (P)
  2m  "Raise: 6-9, 5+ {m}, no 4-card major"     shows m>=5, hcp>=6, points<=9, H<=3, S<=3
      when  !inverted
  3m  "Limit raise: 10-12 HCP, 5+ {m}, no 4-card major"  shows m>=5, hcp=10..12, H<=3, S<=3
      when  !inverted                  # HCP: six clubs and 10-12 passed on 10-12 total points
  # With inverted minors the raises are in inverted-minors.bid.
  # Game values, a fit and no major, without inverted minors: 3NT, as BBA
  # (probes/minor-resp-std-1C.toml). A fallback below the natural calls.
  3N  "Game values, no 4-card major"            shows hcp>=13, H<=3, S<=3
      when  !inverted
      priority -1
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12, balanced, no 4-card major"        shows balanced, points=11..12, H<=3, S<=3
      when  nt2 is invitational
      priority -1                      # a one-level suit first when there is one
  3N  "13-15, balanced, no 4-card major"        shows balanced, points=13..15, H<=3, S<=3
      when  nt2 is invitational
      priority -1
  2N  "13-15, balanced, no 4-card major: game forcing"  shows balanced, points=13..15, H<=3, S<=3
      when  nt2 is game_forcing
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -1
  3N  "16-17, balanced, no 4-card major"        shows balanced, points=16..17, H<=3, S<=3
      when  nt2 is game_forcing
      priority -1
  2H  "Strong jump shift: 15+, 5+ hearts"       shows H>=5, hcp>=15  when strong_js, !wjs_on, !soloway, !passed_hand, !rf_2h_on
      sets forcing=game
  2S  "Strong jump shift: 15+, 5+ spades"       shows S>=5, hcp>=15  when strong_js, !wjs_on, !soloway, !passed_hand, !rf_2s_on
      sets forcing=game

# 2/1 cards: 2C over 1D is game forcing (13+), so 11-12 with clubs and
# no major bids the invitational 2NT, as BBA (probe 2026-09-30:
# 72.K84.K73.AQ952 bids 2NT). Same priority as the balanced 2NT: partner
# reads them together.
after 1D (P) when gf21, nt2 is invitational
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12, 4+ clubs, no 4-card major"   shows points=11..12, C>=4, H<=3, S<=3, D<=3
      priority -1
#
# 11-12 and unbalanced with four diamonds and a longer club suit (no
# major, too weak for a 2/1 2C, too long in diamonds for the 2NT above)
# had no call without inverted minors (the conv-ab off run, 2026-10-07):
# 1D promises four or more but for 4-4-3-2, so the limit raise.
after 1D (P) when !inverted
  3D  "Limit raise: 10-12 HCP, four diamonds, no 4-card major"  shows D=4, hcp=10..12, H<=3, S<=3, !balanced
      priority -2
after 1D (P) when gf21
  3C  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ clubs"   shows C>=6, hcp>=10, hcp<=11 | points<=12, H<=3, S<=3
      when  !weak_js3                  # with weak jump shifts 3C is weak (weak-jump-shifts.bid)
      priority -1

# With 2NT game forcing, 11-12 balanced bids a new minor first (2NT next).
after 1D (P) when nt2 is game_forcing
  2C  "11-12, balanced, no 4-card major"   shows balanced, points=11..12, C>=3, H<=3, S<=3
      sets forcing=round
      priority -1
after 1C (P) when nt2 is game_forcing, !twalsh
  1D  "11-12, balanced, no 4-card major"   shows balanced, points=11..12, D>=3, H<=3, S<=3
      sets forcing=round
      priority -1

# ── Over 1♥ / 1♠ ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1H (P)
  1S  "4+ spades, 6+ HCP"           shows S>=4, hcp>=6
      when  H<=2 | (style is not bba, (H=3, tp(H)>=11) | tp(H)>=13 | !inv_jump_raise) | (style is bba, H=3, hcp>=11 | S>=6 | (hcp>=10, S>=5 | shortest<=2)), hcp<=10 | (S>=C, S>=D) | (hcp<=12, C<=5, D<=5) | (gf21, hcp<=11 | points<=12)
      # 6-10 with 3+ hearts: raise; 11-12 with 4+: limit raise; 11+ with a longer minor: 2m first
      # (bba: with three hearts 1S from 11 HCP, or 10 with five spades or a doubleton; never with four hearts)
      sets forcing=round
  1N  "6-10 HCP, no heart fit, no 4 spades"   shows hcp=6..10, H<=2, S<=3
      when  !gf21
  # 2/1 cards: a weak three-card raise (5-7 support points) may bid
  # 1NT; a 12-count with 13 points bids its 2/1 (Rick, 2026-11-07, #87;
  # responder-rebids.notes.md).
  1N  "Forcing 1NT: 6-12 HCP, no heart fit or a weak three-card raise, no 4 spades"   shows hcp=6..12, H<=2 | (H=3, tp(H)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), S<=3, hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, f1n
      sets forcing=round
  1N  "6-12 HCP, no heart fit or a weak three-card raise, no 4 spades"   shows hcp=6..12, H<=2 | (system is brill, H=3, tp(H)>=10) | (H=3, tp(H)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), S<=3, hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, !f1n, !semi             # brill: a three-card limit raise starts here (3H below)
  1N  "Semi-forcing 1NT: 6-12 HCP, no heart fit or a weak three-card raise, no 4 spades"   shows hcp=6..12, H<=2 | (H=3, tp(H)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), S<=3, hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, !f1n, semi
  2S  "Strong jump shift: 15+, 5+ spades"  shows S>=5, hcp>=15  when strong_js, !wjs_on, !soloway, !passed_hand
      sets forcing=game
  2C  "11+ points, 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, points>=11 | C>=6 | (H>=3, tp(H)>=11), suit_points>=10, C>=D, S<=3 | (C>S, hcp>=13 | C>=6)
      when  !gf21
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)   # Drury (drury.bid) takes a passed hand's 2♣
      when  H<=2 | (style is not bba, H=3 | tp(H)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, H>=4))   # limit values and a fit: raise first
      sets forcing=round               # with 4 spades and no longer minor: 1S first
  2C  "Two over one, game forcing: 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13), C>=D, S<=3 | (C>S, hcp>=13 | C>=6)
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)   # Drury (drury.bid) takes a passed hand's 2♣
      when  H<=2 | (style is not bba, H=3 | tp(H)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, H>=4))   # limit values and a fit: raise first
      sets forcing=game               # with 4 spades and no longer minor: 1S first
  2D  "11+ points, 4+ diamonds"        shows D>=4, points>=11 | D>=6 | (H>=3, tp(H)>=11), suit_points>=10, D>C, S<=3 | (D>S, hcp>=13 | D>=6)
      when  !gf21
      when  H<=2 | (style is not bba, H=3 | tp(H)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, H>=4))
      sets forcing=round
  2D  "Two over one, game forcing: 4+ diamonds"        shows D>=4, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13), D>C, S<=3 | (D>S, hcp>=13 | D>=6)
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      when  H<=2 | (style is not bba, H=3 | tp(H)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, H>=4))
      sets forcing=game
  3H  "Limit raise: 11-12 support points, 3+ hearts"  shows H>=3, tp(H)=11..12 | (H>=4, tp(H)=10, shortest<=2), hcp<=12
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      when inv_jump_raise, H>=4 | S<=3, style is not bba, system is not brill
      priority -1                      # 3 hearts: a new suit, then a jump raise, when there is one
      sets trump=H
  # brill (the Brill card): the limit raise promises four trumps; with
  # three, 1NT and then 3H (responder-rebids.bid). Brill /explain,
  # 2026-10-15, "Nat, Inv, 10-12": `hcp >= 9 and hcp< 12 and H >= 4`.
  3H  "Limit raise: 10-12 support points, 4+ hearts"  shows H>=4, tp(H)=10..12, hcp<=12
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      when inv_jump_raise, system is brill
      sets trump=H
  3C  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ clubs"     shows C>=6, points=10..12, H<=2  when inv_js, !weak_js3
  3D  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ diamonds"  shows D>=6, points=10..12, H<=2  when inv_js, !weak_js3

after 1S (P)
  1N  "6-10 HCP, no spade fit"             shows hcp=6..10, S<=2
      when  !gf21
  # 2/1 cards: a weak three-card raise (5-7 support points) may bid
  # 1NT; a 12-count with 13 points bids its 2/1 (Rick, 2026-11-07, #87;
  # responder-rebids.notes.md).
  1N  "Forcing 1NT: 6-12 HCP, no spade fit or a weak three-card raise"   shows hcp=6..12, S<=2 | (S=3, tp(S)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, f1n
      sets forcing=round
  1N  "6-12 HCP, no spade fit or a weak three-card raise"   shows hcp=6..12, S<=2 | (system is brill, S=3, tp(S)>=10) | (S=3, tp(S)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, !f1n, !semi             # brill: a three-card limit raise starts here (3S below)
  1N  "Semi-forcing 1NT: 6-12 HCP, no spade fit or a weak three-card raise"   shows hcp=6..12, S<=2 | (S=3, tp(S)<=7, !passed_hand, style is not bba, system is not brill), hcp<=11 | points<=12
      when  gf21, !f1n, semi
  2C  "11+ points, 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, points>=11 | C>=6 | (S>=3, tp(S)>=11), suit_points>=10, C>=D, C>=H
      when  !gf21
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)   # Drury (drury.bid) takes a passed hand's 2♣
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))   # limit values and a fit: raise first
      sets forcing=round
  2C  "Two over one, game forcing: 4+ clubs"           shows C>=4, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13), C>=D, C>=H
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)   # Drury (drury.bid) takes a passed hand's 2♣
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))   # limit values and a fit: raise first
      sets forcing=game
  2D  "11+ points, 4+ diamonds"        shows D>=4, points>=11 | D>=6 | (S>=3, tp(S)>=11), suit_points>=10, D>C, D>=H
      when  !gf21
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))
      sets forcing=round
  2D  "Two over one, game forcing: 4+ diamonds"        shows D>=4, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13), D>C, D>=H
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))
      sets forcing=game
  2H  "11+ points, 5+ hearts"          shows H>=5, points>=11 | H>=6 | (S>=3, tp(S)>=11), suit_points>=10
      when  !gf21
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))
      sets forcing=round
  2H  "Two over one, game forcing: 5+ hearts"          shows H>=5, (style is not bba, hcp>=12, points>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13)
      when  gf21, !passed_hand
      when  S<=2 | (style is not bba, S=3 | tp(S)>=13) | (style is bba, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4))
      sets forcing=game
  3S  "Limit raise: 11-12 support points, 3+ spades"  shows S>=3, tp(S)=11..12 | (S>=4, tp(S)=10, shortest<=2), hcp<=12
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      when inv_jump_raise, style is not bba, system is not brill
      priority -1                      # 3 spades: a new suit, then a jump raise, when there is one
      sets trump=S
  # brill (the Brill card): four trumps, as over 1H above. Brill /explain,
  # 2026-10-15, "Nat, Inv, 10-12": `hcp >= 9 and hcp< 12 and S >= 4`.
  3S  "Limit raise: 10-12 support points, 4+ spades"  shows S>=4, tp(S)=10..12, hcp<=12
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      when inv_jump_raise, system is brill
      sets trump=S
  2H  "11+ points, 5+ hearts"       shows H>=5, hcp>=10, S<=2 | hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, S>=4)
      when  style is bba, !gf21          # BBA: ten HCP and five hearts are enough (not a 2/1 game force)
      sets forcing=round
  3C  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ clubs"     shows C>=6, points=10..12, S<=2  when inv_js, !weak_js3
  3D  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ diamonds"  shows D>=6, points=10..12, S<=2  when inv_js, !weak_js3
  3H  "Invitational jump shift: 10-12 points, 6+ hearts"    shows H>=6, points=10..12, S<=2  when inv_js, !weak_js3

after 1M (P)
  # Without the limit raise (a card with no "1M-3M inviting") 2M is the
  # only raise below game: it takes the 11-12 hands too, as BBA does on
  # such a card (responses.notes.md, 2026-09-30). Opener reads the wider
  # range from partner.tp(M) (rebids.bid).
  # On the 2/1 cards (their 1NT is 6-12, forcing or not) the single
  # raise is constructive with three trumps, 8+ support points; the weak
  # raise, 5-7 support points, bids 1NT and gives preference (Rick,
  # 2026-11-07: "support points. with 9 support points a direct,
  # constructive raise is correct"). With four spades over 1H there is
  # no 1NT, so 2H. Rick, 2026-11-06/07, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts
  # #87; responses.notes.md. Not by a
  # passed hand (the 1NT is not forcing then), nor on the Brill card,
  # whose raises are Brill's.
  2M  "Raise: 3+ {M}"
      shows M>=3, hcp>=6, (tp(M)=6..10, M=3 | tp(M)<=9 | shortest>=3) | (!inv_jump_raise, tp(M)<=12)
      shows M>=4 | tp(M)>=8 | (M is H, S>=4) | !gf21 | passed_hand | system is brill
      when  style is not bba
      sets trump=M
  4M  "Preemptive raise: 5+ {M}, weak" shows M>=5, hcp=5..9
      when  style is not bba
      sets trump=M
  2C  "Game values with a fit: a three-card minor to start"
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      shows M>=3, tp(M)>=13, C>=3
      when  style is not bba
      sets  forcing=round
      priority -2                      # no four-card side suit: temporize, as BBA
  2D  "Game values with a fit: a three-card minor to start"
      shows M>=3, tp(M)>=13, D>=3, C<=2
      when  style is not bba
      sets  forcing=round
      priority -2
  # BBA's raises, probed (responses.notes.md, "BBA treatment"). HCP and
  # shape; tens count for nothing. Three trumps: a limit raise with 11-12
  # flat or 9-11 and a doubleton or shorter. Four: 2M up to 8, 3M 9-10,
  # and with a singleton or void (or 9-10 with a five-card suit and a
  # doubleton, or four controls) straight to game. A new suit, forcing:
  # 11 HCP with four trumps, 12 with three and a doubleton, else 13.
  2M  "Raise: 3+ {M}"
      shows M>=3, hcp>=5, (tp(M)<=11, (M=3, hcp>=6, hcp<=10, hcp<=8 | shortest>=3) | (M>=4, hcp<=8, tp(M) + M <= 14)) | (!inv_jump_raise, hcp=6..12)
      when  style is bba
      sets trump=M
  3M  "Limit raise: 3+ {M}, invitational"
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      shows M>=3, (M=3, hcp=11..12, shortest>=3) | (M=3, hcp=9..11, shortest<=2, tp(M)<=13) | (M>=4, hcp=9..10, shortest>=2, shortest>=3 | controls<=3, shortest>=3 | longest<=4)
      shows M is S | S<=3 | hcp<=9     # three hearts, four spades and 10+: 1S
      when  inv_jump_raise, style is bba
      sets trump=M
  4M  "Raise to game: 4+ {M} and shortness"
      shows M>=4, (shortest<=1, hcp<=10, tp(M) + M >= 15) | (shortest=2, hcp=9..10, controls>=4 | longest>=5)
      when  style is bba
      sets trump=M
  2C  "Game values with a fit: a three-card minor to start"
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_rev)
      shows M>=3, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, M>=4), C>=3
      when  style is bba
      sets  forcing=round
      priority -2
  2D  "Game values with a fit: a three-card minor to start"
      shows M>=3, hcp>=13 | (hcp>=12, shortest<=2) | (hcp>=11, M>=4), D>=3, C<=2
      when  style is bba
      sets  forcing=round
      priority -2
  4M  "Game in the fit: 13+ support points"
      shows M>=3, tp(M)>=13
      priority -3                      # no three-card minor either
  2N  "11-12, balanced, no fit"        shows balanced, points=11..12, M<=2
      priority -1                      # a new suit first when there is one
  3N  "13-15, balanced"                shows balanced, points=13..15, M<=3
      priority -1

# ── Weak jump shifts (general.jump_shifts.weak_2, weak_3) ─────────────
# Bridge Bum: at the two level 2-5 HCP and six cards, at the three level
# 2-7 and seven. BBA (Weak_Jump_Shift corpus) jumps at three with up to
# 6 HCP; we keep the 2-6 between the two. A card that sets both strong
# and weak (21GF-WJS-MSS) plays weak, as BBA does; weak ones at three
# replace invitational ones. Opener's continuations: weak-jump-shifts.bid.
after 1C (P) when wjs_on
  2D  "Weak jump shift: 6+ diamonds, 2-5 HCP"   alert   shows D>=6, hcp=2..5
  2H  "Weak jump shift: 6+ hearts, 2-5 HCP"     alert   shows H>=6, hcp=2..5
  2S  "Weak jump shift: 6+ spades, 2-5 HCP"     alert   shows S>=6, hcp=2..5
after 1D (P) when wjs_on
  2H  "Weak jump shift: 6+ hearts, 2-5 HCP"     alert   shows H>=6, hcp=2..5
  2S  "Weak jump shift: 6+ spades, 2-5 HCP"     alert   shows S>=6, hcp=2..5
after 1H (P) when wjs_on
  2S  "Weak jump shift: 6+ spades, 2-5 HCP"     alert   shows S>=6, hcp=2..5, H<=2      # three hearts: pass or raise (BBA)
after 1D (P) when weak_js3
  3C  "Weak jump shift: 7+ clubs, 2-6 HCP"      alert   shows C>=7, hcp=2..6
after 1H (P) when weak_js3
  3C  "Weak jump shift: 7+ clubs, 2-6 HCP"      alert   shows C>=7, hcp=2..6, H<=2
  3D  "Weak jump shift: 7+ diamonds, 2-6 HCP"   alert   shows D>=7, hcp=2..6, H<=2
after 1S (P) when weak_js3
  3C  "Weak jump shift: 7+ clubs, 2-6 HCP"      alert   shows C>=7, hcp=2..6, S<=2
  3D  "Weak jump shift: 7+ diamonds, 2-6 HCP"   alert   shows D>=7, hcp=2..6, S<=2
  3H  "Weak jump shift: 7+ hearts, 2-6 HCP"     alert   shows H>=7, hcp=2..6, S<=2

# ── Soloway jump shifts (general.soloway.play) ─────────────────
# GIB's system notes: a jump shift at the two level, game forcing, 4+
# controls (A 2, K 1) and one of four types: (1) a strong rebiddable suit,
# 17+ total points, no side four-card suit; (2) a solid suit, 17+; (3) a
# rebiddable suit, 18+ HCP, 5-3-3-2 or 6-3-2-2; (4) a rebiddable suit,
# 17+ total points and four-card support for opener. The suit tests follow
# the scenario's own (Soloway_Jump_Shift.btn): strong is four of the top
# five honours with six cards, solid is AKQJ, rebiddable three of the top
# five with five cards. Continuations: soloway.bid.
# brill (the Brill card): every type has 16+ HCP. Brill /explain,
# 2026-10-15, "Soloway": `hcp >= 16 and (solid('H') or semisolid('H') or
# H >= 7) and singlesuited and controls >= 4`, `H >= 5 and D >= 4 and hcp>
# 17 and controls >= 4`, `H >= 6 and balish and hcp>= 17 and controls >= 4`
# (over 1C, 2D: `hcp >= 17 or diamondpoints >= 20`).
define soloway_js(y, x) = controls>=4, y>=5, hcp>=16 | system is not brill
    (y>=6, top5(y)>=4, points>=17, second_longest<=3, x<=3) | (y>=6, quality(y)>=excellent, has(J,y), points>=17, x<=3) | (top5(y)>=3, hcp>=18, x<=3, balanced | (y=6, second_longest=3, shortest=2)) | (top5(y)>=3, x>=4, tp(x)>=17)
after 1C (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, !passed_hand
  2D  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(D, C)
      sets  forcing=game
  2H  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(H, C)
      sets  forcing=game
  2S  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(S, C)
      sets  forcing=game
after 1D (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, !passed_hand
  2H  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(H, D)
      sets  forcing=game
  2S  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(S, D)
      sets  forcing=game
after 1H (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, !passed_hand
  2S  "Soloway jump shift: strong suit, 18+ balanced, or a fit"   alert
      shows soloway_js(S, H)
      sets  forcing=game

# ── Any one-level suit opening ─────────────────────────────────────────
after 1x (P)
  P   "Fewer than 6 HCP"               shows hcp<=5
      priority -10
files.rules/base/soloway.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Soloway jump shifts: the continuations. The jumps themselves are in
# responses.bid (`soloway_js`). GIB's system notes: opener rebids his
# suit with length, raises responder with three or more, bids a side suit
# without support to show at least KQ there, or bids notrump at the
# cheapest level with any other hand. Responder then rebids his suit
# (types 1 and 2), bids notrump (type 3) or raises opener (type 4). The
# auction is game forcing; keycard and control bids follow from the
# agreed suit (slam/). See soloway.notes.md.

module soloway "Soloway jump shifts"
  kind   convention
  needs  responses
  skill  bidding_conventions/soloway
  param  soloway = bidding_conventions/soloway default false

# ── Opener's rebid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1x (P) 2y (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  3y  "Support for {y}: three with an honour, or four"   shows y>=4 | (y=3, quality(y)>=fair)
      sets  trump=y
      priority 1                                # support first
  3x  "Rebids {x}: five or more, no support"    shows x>=5, y<=3, quality(y)<=poor | y<=2
  cheapest(z)  "No support, a side suit with two of the top three honours"
      shows z>=4, quality(z)>=good, y<=3, quality(y)<=poor | y<=2
      when  z is not x, z is not y
      prefer 0 - cheapest_rank(z)
  2N  "No support, no strong side suit"        shows y<=3, quality(y)<=poor | y<=2
      priority -1

# ── Responder's second call (no fit agreed yet) ───────────────────────
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) | 1x (P) 2y (P) 3x (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  cheapest(x)  "Type 4: support for {x}"        shows x>=4
      sets  trump=x
      priority 1
  cheapest(y)  "Type 1 or 2: a long, strong {y}"  shows y>=6, top5(y)>=4
  3N  "Type 3: balanced, 18+"                   shows balanced
      priority -1
  cheapest(y)  "Rebids {y}"                     shows y>=6
      priority -2
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2z (P) | 1x (P) 2y (P) 3z (P) when soloway, !wjs_on, y is not x, z is not x, z is not y, two_level_jump(y, x)
  cheapest(x)  "Type 4: support for {x}"        shows x>=4
      sets  trump=x
      priority 1
  cheapest(y)  "Type 1 or 2: a long, strong {y}"  shows y>=6, top5(y)>=4
  3N  "Type 3: balanced, 18+"                   shows balanced
      priority -1
  cheapest(y)  "Rebids {y}"                     shows y>=6
      priority -2
files.rules/base/strong-openings.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# The strong openings above 1NT (Rick, 2026-09-23).
#
# Balanced hands have a ladder, and every rung is a place to stop:
#
#   2NT            20-21        2♣ then 3NT    24-25
#   2♣ then 2NT    22-23        3NT            26-27
#                               2♣ then 4NT    28+
#
# Unbalanced hands open 2♣ on **23 total points**, or on playing strength:
# within one trick of game, which is nine tricks with a major and ten with
# a minor, since game there is eleven. Playing tricks are counted as
# 13 - losers, and the hand needs a six-card suit or 5-5 to be counted
# that way at all (strong-openings.notes.md has BBA's own 2♣ hands).
#
# Responder: 2♦ waits, a suit at the cheapest level is a positive with a
# real suit, and after opener describes, the cheapest minor is the second
# negative — a bust, less than a jack and a queen.

module strong-openings "2♣ and 2NT openings"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  skill  bidding_conventions/strong_2c
  param  two_c      = two_level.two_clubs.meaning default strong
  param  two_d_resp = two_level.two_clubs.2d_response default waiting
  param  bust_2h    = bidding_conventions/two_heart_bust default false
  param  kokish     = bidding_conventions/kokish default false   # 2♣–2♦–2♥ is the relay (openings/kokish.bid)
  # Off: no strong 2C, and strong hands open at the one level (base.bid
  # lifts its 21 HCP cap). A card whose forcing opening is 1C (Precision)
  # keeps 2C as the stand-in until a forcing 1C is built: without it the
  # strong hands open one of a suit and are passed out.
  param  forcing_2c = general.forcing_opening_2c default true
  param  forcing_1c = general.forcing_opening_1c default false
  param  two_nt_min = notrump.two_nt.range_min default 20
  param  two_nt_max = notrump.two_nt.range_max default 21
  param  three_nt_min = notrump.three_nt.range_min default 26
  param  three_nt_max = notrump.three_nt.range_max default 27
  param  gambling   = bidding_conventions/gambling_3nt default false
  param  rkcb   = bidding_conventions/roman_keycard default false
  param  benjamin   = bidding_conventions/benjamin_2d default false
  # French 2♦ (openings/french-2d.bid) takes every 24+ hand: 2♣ stops at 23.
  param  french     = bidding_conventions/french_2d default false
  param  style      = general.style
  param  system     = general.system   # `brill`: the Brill card's treatments (3NT)

when opening
  2N  "{two_nt_min}-{two_nt_max} HCP, balanced"
      shows hcp=two_nt_min..two_nt_max, balanced
  3N  "{three_nt_min}-{three_nt_max} HCP, balanced"
      shows hcp=three_nt_min..three_nt_max, balanced
      shows S<=4 | system is not brill, H<=4 | system is not brill
      when  !gambling, !french
  # brill (the Brill card: 3NT 25-27): no five-card major in the 3NT
  # opening, which then opens 2C (below). Brill /explain, 2026-10-15,
  # "Balanced hand, 25-27 HCP": `(balanced or semibalanced) and hcp>= 25
  # and hcp<= 27 and H<= 4 and S <= 4`.
  # Three ways in, written apart because one condition for all of them
  # cannot be read. Any of them is a 2♣ opening.
  2C  "Strong 2♣: 22+ HCP"    alert
      shows hcp>=22, !balanced | (system is not brill, hcp<=25) | (system is brill, hcp<=24 | S>=5 | H>=5) | hcp>=28 | gambling   # balanced 26-27 opens 3NT, unless 3NT is Gambling (brill: 25-27 without a five-card major)
      when  two_c is strong | two_c is very_strong, forcing_2c | forcing_1c, !benjamin   # Benjamin: openings/benjamin.bid
      shows !french | hcp<=23
      sets  forcing=game, ask=strong_2c
      artificial
      priority 1                       # ahead of a one-level opening
  2C  "Strong 2♣: nine tricks with a major"  alert
      shows hcp>=17, losers<=4, hcp+length_points>=23
      shows (H>=6, quality(H)>=good) | (S>=6, quality(S)>=good) | (H>=5, S>=5)
      when  two_c is strong | two_c is very_strong, forcing_2c | forcing_1c, !benjamin   # Benjamin: openings/benjamin.bid
      shows !french | hcp<=23
      sets  forcing=game, ask=strong_2c
      artificial
      priority 1
  2C  "Strong 2♣: ten tricks with a long suit"  alert
      shows hcp>=17, losers<=3, hcp+length_points>=23
      shows (C>=6, quality(C)>=good) | (D>=6, quality(D)>=good) | (H>=6, quality(H)>=good) | (S>=6, quality(S)>=good) | shape 5-5-x-x
      when  two_c is strong | two_c is very_strong, forcing_2c | forcing_1c, !benjamin   # Benjamin: openings/benjamin.bid
      shows !french | hcp<=23
      sets  forcing=game, ask=strong_2c
      artificial
      priority 1

# ── Responder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 2C (P)
  2D  "Waiting"                        artificial
      when  two_d_resp is waiting | two_d_resp is negative
      priority -1
  2H  "Positive: five or more hearts, 8+"
      shows H>=5, hcp>=8
      when  !bust_2h, (H>=6, top5(H)>=3) | quality(H)>=good
  2S  "Positive: five or more spades, 8+"
      shows S>=5, hcp>=8
      when  (S>=6, top5(S)>=3) | quality(S)>=good
  3C  "Positive: five or more clubs, 8+"
      shows C>=5, hcp>=8
      when  (C>=6, top5(C)>=3) | quality(C)>=good
      priority -1                      # balanced hands bid 2NT
  3D  "Positive: five or more diamonds, 8+"
      shows D>=5, hcp>=8
      when  (D>=6, top5(D)>=3) | quality(D)>=good
      priority -1
  2N  "Positive: balanced, 8+"         shows balanced, hcp>=8
  2H  "Bust: fewer than 3 HCP"         shows hcp<=2
      when  bust_2h
      sets  forcing=none                # opener may stop below game
      artificial
      priority 1

# ── Opener describes after the waiting bid ───────────────────────────
after 2C (P) 2D (P)
  2N  "22-23 HCP, balanced"            shows hcp=22..23, balanced
  # With a Gambling 3NT the balanced 26-27 opens 2C too, and rebids 3NT
  # (before 2026-10-05 it had no opening at all and passed: Kokish_Relay,
  # 10 of 50 boards). BBA rebids 3NT with 26-27 there.
  3N  "24-25 HCP, balanced"   shows balanced, hcp>=24, hcp<=25 | (gambling, hcp<=27)
      when  !kokish
  # With Kokish the 24-25 goes through the relay (kokish.bid, 2♣–2♦–2♥–
  # 2♠–2NT), so 3NT is the next rung up: 26-27 (BBA, Kokish_Relay with
  # Gambling: 85 boards, 59 at 26 and 26 at 27; the relay's 2NT 93 at 25).
  # Without a Gambling 3NT the 26-27 opens 3NT and we never rebid this,
  # but partner's 3NT reads the same (2026-11-07).
  3N  "26-27 HCP, balanced"   shows balanced, hcp>=26, hcp<=27
      when  kokish
  4N  "28+ HCP, balanced"              shows hcp>=28, balanced
  2H  "5+ hearts"                      shows H>=5
  2S  "5+ spades"                      shows S>=5
  3C  "5+ clubs"                       shows C>=5
  3D  "5+ diamonds"                    shows D>=5

# ── Opener after their overcall and partner's pass (2026-10-05) ──────
# The balanced hands rebid notrump as on the ladder, with a stopper in
# their suit; systems are on over the 2NT (one-nt.bid, `systems on`).
# Only the balanced rebids are written here so far.
after 2C (2x) P (P) | 2C (3x) P (P)
  2N  "22-23 HCP, balanced, a stopper in {x}"    shows hcp=22..23, balanced, stop(x)
  3N  "24-25 HCP, balanced, a stopper in {x}"    shows hcp=24..25, balanced, stop(x)

# ── Opener after a positive response ─────────────────────────────────
# Partner has a real suit and 8+, so the only questions left are the fit
# and the strain. `y is not D | partner.D>=5` is what tells the 3♦
# positive from the 2♦ waiting bid, which has its own block above.
# Responder after a positive and opener's suit: raise with three or more,
# agreeing the suit for the slam modules (2026-09-25: we bid 3NT with
# support and missed the slams BBA bid, To_Finesse_Or_Not_To_Finesse).
after 2C (P) 2N (P) 3S (P) | 2C (P) 3C (P) 3S (P) | 2C (P) 3D (P) 3S (P)
  4S  "Support: three or more spades"   shows S>=3   sets trump=S, forcing=game
      priority 1
after 2C (P) 2N (P) 3H (P) | 2C (P) 3C (P) 3H (P) | 2C (P) 3D (P) 3H (P)
  4H  "Support: three or more hearts"   shows H>=3   sets trump=H, forcing=game
      priority 1
# Opener's minor after a major positive: four-card support raises below
# game and agrees it, leaving the keycard ask to opener (2026-11-07,
# bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #94: 2C-2H-3D with J942 opposite AKT65
# bid 3NT, where 6D and 7D make).
after 2C (P) 2y (P) 3m (P) when y is H | y is S, m is C | m is D, !bust_2h | y is S
  4m  "Support: four or more {m}"       shows m>=4   sets trump=m, forcing=game
      priority 1

# The raise is the 22+ hand (Rick, 2026-10-01): the balanced 22-24 that
# was going to rebid 2NT, or any 22+ with three trumps, even with a suit
# of its own (BBA raises on all of them: probes/slam-2C-2H-opener.toml).
# A lighter 2C, opened on playing tricks, has a long suit and shows it.
# So responder counts the raise as 22, not the 2C floor of 17.
after 2C (P) 2y (P) | 2C (P) 3y (P) when y is not D | partner.D>=5, y is not H | !bust_2h
  cheapest(y) "Raise: three or more {y}, 22+"  shows y>=3, hcp>=22   sets trump=y
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Five or more spades"           shows S>=5   when y is not S
  cheapest(H) "Five or more hearts"           shows H>=5   when y is not H
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds"         shows D>=5   when y is not D
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs"            shows C>=5   when y is not C
  cheapest(N) "Balanced, no fit for {y}"      shows balanced, hcp>=22   # every balanced 2C is 22+
      priority -1

# ── Responder's rebid over opener's 2NT (2026-09-28) ─────────────────
# Opener is balanced, 22+, with exactly two cards in my major (three
# would have raised). We are forced to game and hold 30+ between us, so
# every call here is a step towards slam (NT_Ladder 426: 2C P 2S P 2NT
# P, where six spades opposite two bid 3NT and BBA reached 6S).
# BBA, probes/strong2c-2S-2N-resp.toml and strong2c-2H-2N-resp.toml:
# a six-card suit rebids, a four-card side suit is shown, 5-3-3-2 bids a
# quantitative 4NT with 8-9 and 6NT with 10+.
# That is BBA's treatment (`general.style = bba`). By default systems are
# on over this 2NT (Rick, 2026-10-05; one-nt.bid, `systems on`): the 2NT
# system of two-nt-responses.bid answers it, Stayman and transfers.
after 2C (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) when y is H | y is S, y is not H | !bust_2h, style is bba
  3y  "Six or more {y}"      shows y>=6   sets trump=y
      priority 2                             # the fit first, before a side suit
  3S  "Four or more spades"                    shows S>=4
      when  y is H
      priority 1                             # a major fit before a minor suit
  3H  "Four or more hearts"                    shows H>=4
      when  y is S
      priority 1
  3C  "Four or more clubs"                     shows C>=4
  3D  "Four or more diamonds"                  shows D>=4
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT"
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      shows balanced, hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 30, hcp + partner.hcp.min <= 32
      sets  ask=quant
  6N  "Slam in notrump"            shows balanced, hcp + partner.hcp.min >= 33
  3N  "To play"
      priority -1

# Opener with four cards in responder's second major agrees it and asks
# for keycards at once: 30+ between us and a fit (BBA asks on almost
# every hand after 2C P 2S P 2NT P 3S P, probes/strong2c-2S-2N-3S-opener.toml).
# Without 1430 or 0314 on the card, game in the fit.
after 2C (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) 3z (P) when y is H | y is S, z is H | z is S, z is not y, y is not H | !bust_2h, style is bba
  4N  "Keycard ask in {z}: four-card support"  shows z>=4
      when  rkcb
      sets  trump=z, ask=keycards(z)
      artificial
  4z  "Four-card support: game in {z}"          shows z>=4
      when  !rkcb
      sets  trump=z

# After the balanced positive, opener shows a suit or raises the notrump.
after 2C (P) 2N (P)
  3S  "Five or more spades"                   shows S>=5
  3H  "Five or more hearts"                   shows H>=5
  3D  "Five or more diamonds"                 shows D>=5
  3C  "Five or more clubs"                    shows C>=5
  3N  "Balanced 22, no suit to show"         shows balanced, hcp>=22   # 23+ bids 4NT or 6NT
      priority -1
  4N  "Quantitative: 23-24 balanced, invites 6NT"  shows balanced, hcp=23..24
      when  quant_4nt   # slam.quantitative_4nt.play (slam-entry.bid)
      sets  ask=quant
  6N  "Slam in notrump"            shows hcp>=25, balanced

# ── Responder's second call: the second negative ─────────────────────
# Having waited, responder shows a bust by bidding the cheapest minor;
# anything else is a positive and the auction is already game forcing.
# With the 2♥ bust (`parrish_bust`) the bust was shown at once: 2♦ has
# 3+ HCP and there is no second negative.
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 2H (P)
  3C  "Second negative: fewer than 3 HCP"  shows hcp<=2  when !bust_2h  artificial  priority 1
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 2S (P)
  3C  "Second negative: fewer than 3 HCP"  shows hcp<=2  when !bust_2h  artificial  priority 1
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 3C (P)
  3D  "Second negative: fewer than 3 HCP"  shows hcp<=2  when !bust_2h  artificial  priority 1

# ── Responder's second call over opener's major (2026-11-07) ─────────
# Rick, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #92: 2♣–2♦–2♥ (natural, Kokish
# off) had no responder rules but the second negative, so every other
# hand fell through to the base "Game in notrump" (3NT with six good
# spades, or with a heart fit too weak for slam-entry's raise). Standard
# practice: a five-card suit of my own is shown (2♠ over 2♥ at the two
# level, a minor at three, each denying a fit), a raise is slam-entry's
# or base.bid's game in the fit, and 2NT
# waits with no fit and nothing to show, leaving room below 3NT for
# opener's second suit or six-card major. With Kokish on, 2♥ is the
# relay (kokish.bid) and these are off.
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 2y (P) when y is S | !kokish, y is H | y is S, !bust_2h
  2S  "Five or more spades"               shows S>=5, hcp>=3, quality(S)>=fair, H<=2
      when  y is H
      priority 1
  3D  "Five or more diamonds"             shows D>=5, hcp>=3, quality(D)>=fair, y<=2
  2N  "No fit, nothing to show: waiting"  shows y<=2, hcp>=3
      priority -1

# Opener after the waiting 2NT: a six-card major rebids, a second suit
# is shown, 3NT with a five-card major and nothing more to say. Natural
# and forcing (the 2♣ game force).
after 2C (P) 2D (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) when y is S | !kokish, y is H | y is S, !bust_2h
  3y  "Six or more {y}"                     shows y>=6
      priority 1
  3S  "Four or more spades"                 shows S>=4
      when  y is H
  3D  "Four or more diamonds"               shows D>=4
  3C  "Four or more clubs"                  shows C>=4
  3N  "Five {y}, nothing more to show"     shows y=5
      priority -1

# ── Opener's new suit over responder's transfer (2026-11-07) ─────────
# Rick, bridge-classroom-bug-artifacts #94: 2♣–2♥(positive)–2NT, systems
# on (Rick, 2026-10-05), 3♦ transfer, and opener bid 4♦ instead of
# completing. Opener's 2NT denied three hearts, so it cannot be a
# super-accept: it is natural, five or more of the minor, slam interest
# (we are forced to game with 30+ between us). Before, nothing read it
# (base.bid's runout fallback), responder took it as an answer to the
# transfer and bid a quantitative 4NT, and the 5♣ that followed was
# passed. The completion stays opener's own call (priority 0): these are
# here so the 4m is read, and answered.
after 2C (P) 2H (P) 2N (P) 3D (P) | 2C (P) 2S (P) 2N (P) 3H (P) when style is not bba, !bust_2h
  4C  "Five or more clubs: slam interest, no fit"     shows C>=5
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -1
  4D  "Five or more diamonds: slam interest, no fit"  shows D>=5
      sets  forcing=game
      priority -1

# Responder: with three or more of opener's minor the fit is found, and
# with 30+ between us the keycard ask agrees it (0314 or 1430 as the
# card and rkcb-1430.bid say); without RKCB, slam in the fit. No fit:
# back to my major, which opener may pass or bid on over.
after 2C (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) 3x (P) 4m (P) when y is H | y is S, x is D | y is S, x is H | y is H, m is C | m is D, style is not bba, !bust_2h
  4N  "Keycard ask in {m}: three or more {m}"   shows m>=3
      when  rkcb
      sets  trump=m, ask=keycards(m)
      artificial
      priority 2
  6m  "Slam: three or more {m}"                 shows m>=3
      when  !rkcb
      sets  trump=m
      priority 2
  4y  "No fit for {m}: my {y}"                   shows m<=2
      priority 1

# ── The 2♥ bust (`two_level.parrish_bust.play`) ─────────────────
# 2♣–2♥ shows fewer than 3 HCP (2♦ is then waiting with 3+, game
# forcing). Opener describes naturally; a suit at the two level is
# forcing one round, 2NT (22-23) and a three-level suit may be passed.
# Hearts are bid at the three level (2♥ was artificial).
after 2C (P) 2H (P) when bust_2h
  2N  "22-23 HCP, balanced"            shows hcp=22..23, balanced
  3N  "24-25 HCP, balanced"            shows balanced, hcp>=24, hcp<=25 | (gambling, hcp<=27)
  4N  "28+ HCP, balanced"              shows hcp>=28, balanced
  2S  "5+ spades: forcing one round"   shows S>=5
      sets  forcing=round
  3H  "5+ hearts"                      shows H>=5
  3C  "5+ clubs"                       shows C>=5
  3D  "5+ diamonds"                    shows D>=5
after 2C (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) when bust_2h
  3S  "Three or more spades"           shows S>=3
      sets  trump=S
      priority 1
  2N  "No spade support"
after 2C (P) 2H (P) 3H (P) when bust_2h
  4H  "Raise to game: three or more hearts"   shows H>=3
      sets  trump=H
      priority 1
  P   "No support"
after 2C (P) 2H (P) 3C (P) | 2C (P) 2H (P) 3D (P) | 2C (P) 2H (P) 2N (P) when bust_2h
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 1
# Opener after the bust's 2NT (no spade support): game with it in hand.
after 2C (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) 2N (P) when bust_2h
  4S  "Game in hand: six or more spades"   shows S>=6, losers<=3
      priority 1
  3S  "Six or more spades: to play"        shows S>=6
  3H  "Five or more hearts too"            shows H>=5
  3D  "Four or more diamonds too"          shows D>=4
  3C  "Four or more clubs too"             shows C>=4
  P   "No further bid"
      priority -1
files.rules/base/transfer-walsh.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Transfer Walsh (Wikipedia, "Transfer Walsh"; convention-card
# bidding_conventions/transfer_walsh): over partner's 1♣,
#
#   1♦   four or more hearts (with four of each major too)
#   1♥   four or more spades (longer than hearts, or 5-5)
#   1♠   no four-card major: four or more diamonds, or a game force
#        with longer diamonds
#   1NT  natural, 6-10 balanced (responses.bid)
#
# Opener accepts with three of responder's major (or four and a
# minimum), raises to two with four and 16-18, to game with 19+, and
# otherwise rebids naturally, the rebid denying three of the major. The
# natural rules that read the response as a suit stand aside under this
# card (`tw(x)` in rebids.bid). See transfer-walsh.notes.md.

module transfer-walsh "Transfer Walsh responses to 1♣"
  kind   convention
  card   bidding_conventions/transfer_walsh
  needs  responder-rebids
  skill  bidding_conventions/transfer_walsh
  param  q4n = bidding_conventions/quantitative_4nt default true

# ── Responder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A game force with longer diamonds and a major starts with 1♠ (as Walsh
# bids 1♦ first with game values).
after 1C (P)
  1D  "Transfer: 4+ hearts, 6+ HCP"        alert
      shows H>=4, hcp>=6, H>=S, H>S | H=4, hcp<=11 | H>=D
      sets  forcing=round, ask=tw_accept(H)
      artificial
  1H  "Transfer: 4+ spades, 6+ HCP"        alert
      shows S>=4, hcp>=6, S>H | S>=5, S>=H, hcp<=11 | S>=D
      sets  forcing=round, ask=tw_accept(S)
      artificial
  1S  "Transfer Walsh: 4+ diamonds, no major unless 12+ HCP"   alert
      shows D>=4, hcp>=6, (H<=3, S<=3) | (hcp>=12, D>H, D>S)
      sets  forcing=round, ask=tw_nomajor
      artificial

# ── Opener after a transfer to a major ───────────────────────────────
when asked tw_accept(M)
  1{M}  "Accepts: three {M}, or four and a minimum"
        shows M>=3, M=3 | tp(M)<=15
        priority 3
  2{M}  "Raise: four {M}, 16-18"            shows M>=4, tp(M)=16..18   sets trump=M
        priority 3
  4{M}  "Game raise: four {M}, 19+"          shows M>=4, tp(M)>=19   sets trump=M
        priority 3
  # Without three of the major: natural, each denying the fit.
  1S    "4+ spades, not three hearts"        shows S>=4, H<=2, suit_points<=18
        when  M is H
        priority 2
  2H    "Reverse: 4+ hearts, longer clubs, 17+, not three spades"   shows H>=4, C>H, S<=2, suit_points>=17
        when  M is S
        sets  forcing=round
        priority 2
  1N    "12-14 HCP, balanced, not three {M}"   shows balanced | shape 5-4-2-2, hcp=12..14, M<=2
        priority 1
  2N    "18-19 HCP, balanced, not three {M}"   shows balanced, hcp=18..19, M<=2
        priority 1
  2C    "6+ clubs, minimum, not three {M}"     shows C>=6, suit_points<=15, M<=2
  3C    "6+ clubs, 16-18, not three {M}"       shows C>=6, suit_points=16..18, M<=2
  2D    "Reverse: 4+ diamonds, longer clubs, 17+, not three {M}"   shows D>=4, C>D, suit_points>=17, M<=2
        sets  forcing=round
  3N    "18-21 with six or more clubs, not three {M}"   shows C>=6, hcp=18..21, M<=2
        priority 1
  1N    "Minimum, not three {M}"            shows hcp<=14, M<=2
        priority -3
  2C    "5+ clubs, not three {M}"   shows C>=5, M<=2
        priority -4

# ── Opener after 1♠ (no major) ───────────────────────────────────────
when asked tw_nomajor
  1N  "12-14 HCP, balanced"                  shows balanced | shape 5-4-2-2, hcp=12..14
      priority 1
  2N  "18-19 HCP, balanced"                  shows balanced, hcp=18..19
      priority 1
  2D  "Raise: 4+ diamonds, minimum"          shows D>=4, tp(D)<=15   sets trump=D
  3D  "Jump raise: 4+ diamonds, 16+"         shows D>=4, tp(D)>=16   sets trump=D
  2C  "6+ clubs, minimum"                    shows C>=6, suit_points<=15
  3C  "6+ clubs, 16-18"                      shows C>=6, suit_points=16..18
  3N  "18-21 with six or more clubs"         shows C>=6, hcp=18..21
  1N  "Minimum"             shows hcp<=14
      priority -3
  2C  "5+ clubs"               shows C>=5
      priority -4

# ── Responder's second call ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Opener accepted: three (or four, minimum) in responder's major.
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1H (P) | 1C (P) 1H (P) 1S (P)
  P   "Weak: to play"                        shows points<=10
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 13+, four of the major"          shows points>=13
      priority -1
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                   shows points=11..12
      sets  ask=nt_invite
      priority -1
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1H (P)
  2H  "Five or more hearts, 8-10: competitive"   shows H>=5, points=8..10   sets trump=H, ask=signoff
  3H  "Invitational: five or more hearts, 11-12"  shows H>=5, tp(H)=11..12   sets trump=H, ask=invite(H)
  4H  "Game: five or more hearts, 13+"         shows H>=5, tp(H)>=13   sets trump=H
  1S  "Four spades as well, 6+"                 shows S>=4, H=4
      sets  forcing=round
      priority 1
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 1S (P)
  2S  "Five or more spades, 8-10: competitive"   shows S>=5, points=8..10   sets trump=S, ask=signoff
  3S  "Invitational: five or more spades, 11-12"  shows S>=5, tp(S)=11..12   sets trump=S, ask=invite(S)
  4S  "Game: five or more spades, 13+"         shows S>=5, tp(S)>=13   sets trump=S
  2H  "Four or more hearts as well, 8-10"      shows H>=4, S>=5, points=8..10   sets ask=signoff

# Opener raised to two (four, 16-18): game from 8.
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 2H (P) | 1C (P) 1H (P) 2S (P)
  P   "Weak: no game"                         shows points<=7
      priority -5
  4{trump}  "Game"                            shows points>=8

# Opener denied three of the major, or answered 1♠: natural.
# Slam and the second suit (2026-10-05, the self A/B against Walsh: every
# game force went 1NT-3NT, 19-21 HCP and a 4-4 fit in the other major
# included, -93 IMPs on 75 boards): a quantitative 4NT or 6NT, and the
# responder's reverses that natural Walsh has (responder-rebids.bid).
after 1C (P) 1x (P) 1N (P)
  P   "Weak: no game"                         shows points<=10
      priority -5
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                   shows points=11..12   sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+"                             shows points>=13
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT"
      shows balanced, points + partner.points.min >= 31, points + partner.points.min <= 32
      when  q4n
      sets  ask=quant
  6N  "Slam in notrump"                  shows balanced, points + partner.points.min >= 33
after 1C (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) | 1C (P) 1S (P) 2C (P)
  2H  "Game force: four hearts, longer diamonds"   shows H>=4, D>=5, D>S, points>=13   sets forcing=game
      priority 1
  2S  "Game force: four spades, longer diamonds"   shows S>=4, D>=5, H<=3, points>=13   sets forcing=game
      priority 1
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1N (P)
  2S  "Responder's reverse: 4+ spades, 5+ hearts, game forcing"   shows S>=4, H>=5, points>=13   sets forcing=game
      priority 1
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 1N (P)
  3H  "Four hearts, five spades, game forcing"   shows H>=4, S>=5, points>=13   sets forcing=game
      priority 1

# Opener over responder's major after 1♣-1♠-1NT: the 1NT rebid did not
# deny a four-card major (responder had denied one), so raise with four.
after 1C (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) 2M (P) | 1C (P) 1S (P) 2C (P) 2M (P)
  3{M} "Four {M}: the fit"                    shows M>=4   sets trump=M
      priority 2
  2S   "Four spades, not four hearts"        shows S>=4, H<=3
      when  M is H
      priority 1
  3N   "No fit in {M}"
after 1C (P) 1S (P) 1N (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) | 1C (P) 1S (P) 2C (P) 2H (P) 2S (P)
  4S   "Four spades as well: game"           shows S>=4
      priority 1
  3N   "Game in notrump"
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1N (P)
  2H  "Weak: six or more hearts"             shows H>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  3H  "Invitational: six or more hearts"     shows H>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(H)
  4H  "Game: six or more hearts"             shows H>=6, points>=13
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 1N (P)
  2S  "Weak: six or more spades"             shows S>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  3S  "Invitational: six or more spades"     shows S>=6, points=11..12   sets ask=invite(S)
  4S  "Game: six or more spades"             shows S>=6, points>=13

after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1S (P)
  P   "Weak: four spades too"                 shows S>=4, points<=10
      priority -4
  2S  "Raise: four spades, weak"              shows S>=4, points<=10   sets trump=S, ask=signoff
  3S  "Invitational raise: four spades"       shows S>=4, tp(S)=11..12   sets trump=S, ask=invite(S)
  4S  "Game: four spades"                     shows S>=4, tp(S)>=13   sets trump=S
  2H  "Weak: six or more hearts"              shows H>=6, points<=10   sets ask=signoff
  1N  "6-10, no spade fit"                    shows points<=10, S<=3   sets ask=signoff
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12, no spade fit"     shows points=11..12, S<=3   sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+, no spade fit"               shows points>=13, S<=3
  4N  "Quantitative: invites 6NT, no spade fit"
      shows balanced, S<=3, points + partner.points.min >= 31, points + partner.points.min <= 32
      when  q4n
      sets  ask=quant
  6N  "Slam in notrump, no spade fit"    shows balanced, S<=3, points + partner.points.min >= 33

after 1C (P) 1x (P) 2C (P)
  P   "Weak: no game"                         shows points<=10
      priority -5
  2N  "Invitational: 11-12"                   shows points=11..12   sets ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game: 13+"                             shows points>=13

# Opener's jump to 3♣ (six clubs, 16-18): game from 9 (2026-10-05, the
# self A/B: responder had no rule and passed it with 13-14).
after 1C (P) 1x (P) 3C (P)
  P   "Weak: no game"                         shows points<=8
      priority -5
  3N  "Game: 9+"                              shows points>=9
  5C  "Game in clubs: 9+, three clubs, a suit unstopped"   shows C>=3, points>=9, !balanced
      priority -1

after 1C (P) 1S (P) 2D (P)
  P   "Weak: no game"                         shows tp(D)<=10
      priority -5
  3D  "Invitational: 11-12"                   shows tp(D)=11..12   sets ask=invite(D)
  3N  "Game: 13+"                             shows points>=13

# Responder showed four spades as well after the heart transfer was
# accepted (1♣-1♦-1♥-1♠): opener raises with four, else describes.
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1H (P) 1S (P)
  2S  "Four spades, minimum"                  shows S>=4, tp(S)<=15   sets trump=S
  3S  "Four spades, 16-18"                    shows S>=4, tp(S)=16..18   sets trump=S
  4S  "Four spades, 19+"                      shows S>=4, tp(S)>=19   sets trump=S
  2H  "Four hearts, minimum"                  shows H>=4, S<=3, suit_points<=15   sets trump=H
  2C  "Six or more clubs, minimum"            shows C>=6, S<=3, H<=3, suit_points<=15
  2N  "18-19, balanced"                       shows balanced, hcp=18..19, S<=3
  1N  "Minimum, no four spades"               shows hcp<=14, S<=3
      priority -1
  3N  "15+, no four spades"                   shows hcp>=15, S<=3
      priority -2

# Opener reversed (17+, forcing one round) over the transfer.
after 1C (P) 1x (P) 2z (P) when we.forcing = round
  2N  "Forced: minimum, no fit"               shows points<=7
      priority -1
  3N  "Game: 8+"                              shows points>=8
      priority -2
  3C  "Three or more clubs, 8+: game forcing"  shows C>=3, points>=8   sets forcing=game
      priority -3
  3z  "Four {z}, 8+: game forcing"            shows z>=4, points>=8   sets forcing=game, trump=z
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 2z (P) when we.forcing = round
  2H  "Five or more hearts"                   shows H>=5   sets forcing=round
      when  z is D
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 2z (P) when we.forcing = round
  2S  "Five or more spades"                   shows S>=5   sets forcing=round
# Opener after responder's five-card major over the reverse.
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 2z (P) 2H (P) | 1C (P) 1H (P) 2z (P) 2S (P)
  2N  "No fit, minimum reverse"               shows hcp<=18
      priority -1
  3N  "No fit, 19+"                           shows hcp>=19
      priority -2
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 2z (P) 2H (P)
  3H  "Two hearts: the 5-2 fit"               shows H=2
after 1C (P) 1H (P) 2z (P) 2S (P)
  3S  "Two spades: the 5-2 fit"               shows S=2
files.rules/base/two-way-nmf.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Two-way New Minor Forcing (xyNT): after 1x-1y-1NT, 2C relays to 2D
# (every invitational hand starts here, and a weak hand with diamonds
# passes 2D); 2D is an artificial game force; 2NT relays to 3C (a weak
# hand with clubs passes); jumps to three are natural slam tries. Played
# instead of NMF. See two-way-nmf.notes.md.

module two-way-nmf "Two-way New Minor Forcing (xyNT)"
  kind   convention
  needs  responder-rebids
  skill  bidding_conventions/two_way_nmf
  # On with its own switch, or with XYZ (xyz.bid), which plays the same
  # structure after every one-level rebid, 1NT included.
  param  twoway = bidding_conventions/two_way_nmf default false
  param  xyz    = bidding_conventions/xyz default false

after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1N (P) when twoway | xyz, !tw(x)
  2C  "xyNT: relay to 2♦, invitational or a diamond sign-off"   alert
      shows nt_rebid_invite | (D>=6, nt_rebid_signoff, y is not D, x is not D)
      sets  forcing=round, ask=xy_relay
      artificial
      priority 1
  2D  "xyNT: artificial game force"   alert
      shows nt_rebid_game, y>=5 | (H>=4, S>=4) | !balanced
      sets  forcing=game, ask=xy_gf
      artificial
      priority 1
  2N  "xyNT: relay to 3♣, a club sign-off"   alert
      shows C>=6, nt_rebid_signoff
      when  x is not C, y is not C
      sets  forcing=round, ask=xy_clubs
      artificial
  3y  "Slam try: six or more {y}"
      shows y>=6, points + partner.hcp.min >= 28
      sets  forcing=game, trump=y

when asked xy_relay
  2D  "Forced relay"                       alert   artificial
when asked xy_clubs
  3C  "Forced relay"                       alert   artificial

# ── After the 2♦ relay: weak with diamonds passes, every other call invites
after 1x (P) 1M (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2D (P) when twoway | xyz, !tw(x)
  P   "To play in 2♦"                      shows D>=6, nt_rebid_signoff
  2M  "Invitational: five {M}"             shows M=5, nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=invite(M)
  3M  "Invitational: six {M}"              shows M>=6, nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=invite(M)
  2N  "Invitational, balanced"             shows nt_rebid_invite, M<=5   sets ask=nt_invite
      priority -1
after 1C (P) 1D (P) 1N (P) 2C (P) 2D (P) when twoway | xyz, !tw(C)
  P   "Weak"                               shows nt_rebid_signoff
      priority -5
  3D  "Invitational: six diamonds"         shows D>=6, nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=invite(D)
  2N  "Invitational, balanced"             shows nt_rebid_invite   sets ask=nt_invite
      priority -1
after 1x (P) 1y (P) 1N (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) when twoway | xyz, !tw(x)
  P   "To play in 3♣"                      shows C>=6

# ── After the 2♦ game force: opener shows three of responder's major,
# then four hearts after a 1♠ response, else 2NT.
when asked xy_gf
  2H  "Three hearts"                       shows H=3        when partner.H>=4
  2S  "Three spades"                       shows S=3        when partner.S>=4
  2H  "Four hearts, not three spades"      shows H>=4, S<=2  when partner.S>=4
  2N  "No fit to show"
      priority -1
when answered xy_gf
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"              shows H>=5 | (H>=4, partner.H.min>=4)   when partner.H>=3   sets trump=H
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"              shows S>=5 | (S>=4, partner.S.min>=4)   when partner.S>=3   sets trump=S
  4H  "Game: six hearts"                   shows H>=6
  4S  "Game: six spades"                   shows S>=6
  3N  "Game, no major fit"
      priority -1
files.rules/base/weak-jump-shifts.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Weak jump shifts: opener's continuations and responder's answers. The
# jumps themselves are in responses.bid (two level 2-5 HCP and six cards,
# three level 2-6 and seven). Bridge Bum: opener may pass, rebid his own
# suit (not forcing), raise (not forcing), bid a new suit (forcing, extra
# strength) or bid 2NT, a forcing game try that implies at least two cards
# in responder's suit. See weak-jump-shifts.notes.md.

module weak-jump-shifts "Weak jump shifts"
  kind   convention
  needs  responses
  skill  bidding_conventions/weak_jump_shifts
  param  weak2 = bidding_conventions/weak_jump_shifts:two_level default false
  param  weak2_nc = bidding_conventions/weak_jump_shifts:not_in_comp default false
  param  weak3 = bidding_conventions/weak_jump_shifts:three_level default false

# Weak jump shifts with no interference: the two-level box, or the
# "not in competition" box other card formats have (#74). The modules
# that give way to a weak jump shift read this too.
define wjs_on = weak2 | weak2_nc

# A response of 2x to 1y is a jump when x ranks above y (else a two over
# one). responder-rebids.bid reads it to keep its 2/1 continuations away
# from a weak jump shift.
define two_level_jump(x, y) = y is C | (y is D, x is H | x is S) | (y is H, x is S)

# ── Opener after a weak jump shift at the two level ────────────────────
after 1x (P) 2y (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x), partner.jumped
  P   "To play: two of {y}"          priority -5
  4y  "Game: 18+ with two or more {y}"           shows y>=2, hcp>=18
      when  y is H | y is S
  3y  "Raise: 3+ {y}, 16-17, invitational"       shows y>=3, hcp=16..17
  2N  "Forcing game try: asks for a feature"     alert
      shows y>=3, hcp>=16, hcp<=17 | y is C | y is D
      sets  forcing=round, ask=wjs_feature
      artificial
  3x  "Rebids {x}: seven or more, not forcing"   shows x>=7, y<=1, hcp<=17
  # 18-21 with a long minor: rebids.bid's 3NT is off here (the conv-ab
  # run, 2026-10-07: 3NT opposite 2-5 and a misfit rarely makes).
  3x  "Rebids {x}: six or more, 18+, not forcing"   shows x>=6, y<=1, hcp>=18
      when  x is C | x is D
  4x  "Game in my own major: seven, or six good ones, 18+"
      shows x>=7 | (x>=6, quality(x)>=good), y<=1, hcp>=18
      when  x is H | x is S
  cheapest(z)  "New suit: 4+ {z}, 17+, forcing"  shows z>=4, hcp>=17, y<=1
      when  z is not x, z is not y
      sets  forcing=round

# Responder answers the 2NT game try: three of his suit with a minimum,
# 3NT with a maximum and two of the top three honours, else a feature
# (an ace or king) with a maximum.
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  3N  "Maximum: 4-5, two of the top three honours"   shows hcp>=4, quality(y)>=good
  3z  "Maximum: 4-5, a feature in {z}"
      shows hcp>=4, has(A,z) | has(K,z)
      when  z is not y
      prefer 0 - z
  3y  "Minimum: 2-3, or no feature"
      priority -1

after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) 3y (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  P   "Minimum: to play"             priority -5
  4y  "Game"                              shows hcp>=17, y>=3
      when  y is H | y is S
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) 3z (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x), z is not y
  4y  "Game in {y}"                              shows y>=2
      when  y is H | y is S
  3N  "Game in notrump"                          when  y is C | y is D
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2N (P) 3N (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  P   "No further bid"                             priority -5

# Responder after opener rebids his suit (not forcing): pass.
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 3x (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  P   "Opener's suit: play here"                 priority -5

# Responder after opener's invitational raise: game with a maximum.
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 3y (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x)
  P   "Minimum: play three"                      priority -5
  4y  "Maximum: 4-5, game"                      shows hcp>=4
      when  y is H | y is S
# After opener's new suit (forcing): raise with four, else back to a
# known suit as cheaply as possible.
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2z (P) | 1x (P) 2y (P) 3z (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x), z is not x, z is not y
  3z  "Raise: four {z}"                          shows z>=4
  cheapest(y)  "Rebids {y}: no fit"              shows y>=6
      priority -1
  cheapest(x)  "Preference for {x}"              shows x>=2
      priority -2

# Opener after responder's answer to the new suit: game with a fit found
# (4 of a major, or 3NT), else stop.
after 1x (P) 2y (P) 2z (P) * (P) | 1x (P) 2y (P) 3z (P) * (P) when wjs_on, y is not x, two_level_jump(y, x), z is not x, z is not y
  P   "No game: stop here"                       priority -5
  4z  "Game in the fit"                          shows z>=4, hcp>=19
      when  partner.z>=4, z is H | z is S
  3N  "Game in notrump: 22+"                     shows hcp>=22
      priority -1

# ── Opener after a weak jump shift at the three level ──────────────────
after 1x (P) 3y (P) when weak3, y is not x, partner.jumped
  P   "No further bid"                           priority -5
  4y  "Game: 17+ with two or more {y}"           shows y>=2, hcp>=17
      when  y is H | y is S
  3N  "To play: 18+, a fit for {y}, side suits stopped"
      shows y>=2, hcp>=18
      when  y is C | y is D
  4x  "Game in my own major: seven, or six good ones, 16+"
      shows x>=7 | (x>=6, quality(x)>=good), hcp>=16, y<=1
      when  x is H | x is S
files.rules/base/weak-two-responses.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responses to a weak two, and opener's answer to 2NT. Two treatments
# (card `two_level.weak_two_2nt_response`): `feature`, where opener shows a
# side ace or king with a maximum, and `ogust`, where opener's answer shows
# minimum or maximum and the suit's quality.

module weak-two-responses "Responses to a weak two"
  kind   system
  needs  preempts
  skill  bidding_conventions/weak_2s
  skill  bidding_conventions/ogust
  param  ask2nt = two_level.weak_two_2nt_response default feature
  param  two_c  = two_level.two_clubs.meaning default strong
  param  style  = general.style
  param  rkcb   = bidding_conventions/roman_keycard default false
  param  aces   = bidding_conventions/blackwood default false

# Standard responder (the default until 2026-09-24): 2NT from 15, raises
# with four. The default is now BBA's, below: par preferred it (+453 IMPs
# on the corpus, +78 on Basic_*).
#
# The weak twos are 2♦, 2♥ and 2♠: 2♣ is the strong opening unless the
# card says it is natural. Without the guard, responder's 2NT over a
# strong 2♣ was read as the weak-two ask and opener answered with a
# feature (95 boards in the Basic_* scenarios, -478 IMPs).
after 2x (P) when weak_two_suit(x), x is not N, x is not C | two_c is natural, style is standard
  2N  "Asks: how good is the weak two?"   alert
      shows hcp>=15
      sets  forcing=round, ask=weak_two(x)
      artificial
  3x  "Preemptive raise: four-card support"    shows x>=4, hcp<=14
  4x  "Game in the fit"                        shows x>=4, hcp>=14
      when  x is H | x is S                    # with three, ask first
  P   "No interest"                            shows hcp<=14
      priority -5

# The default, and bba (probed 2026-09-24, weak-two-responses.notes.md). BBA reads a weak
# two as lighter when we are not vulnerable, and lightest at favourable:
# game with three-card support from 15 vulnerable, 16 at equal
# vulnerability not vulnerable (15 with four), 18 at favourable, 13 with
# five; 5D with three-card support and 18-20. The 2NT ask: over a major
# from 13 with support when vulnerable (and with four at love all), from
# 14 with a doubleton unless at favourable; otherwise from 15 with two or
# more, 18 with a singleton, and always with 20. The
# preemptive raise stops at 11. A new major is natural and forcing: over
# 2D six cards from 13, five with exactly 14; over 2H five
# spades from 13 with at most one heart (with two, 2NT).
after 2x (P) when weak_two_suit(x), x is not N, x is not C | two_c is natural, style is not standard
  2N  "Asks: how good is the weak two?"   alert
      shows hcp>=13
      when  hcp>=20 | (x>=2, hcp>=15) | (x<=1, hcp>=18) | (x is H | x is S, x=2, hcp>=14, vul | !they.vul) | (x is H | x is S, x>=3, vul) | (x is H | x is S, x>=4, !they.vul)
      sets  forcing=round, ask=weak_two(x)
      artificial
  # Probed 2026-09-24 (notes): flat 0-4 with four trumps raises only at
  # love all; with a singleton and four trumps, game unless vulnerable.
  3x  "Preemptive raise: four-card support"    shows x>=4, hcp<=11, hcp>=5 | shortest<=1
  3x  "Preemptive raise: four-card support"   shows x>=4, hcp<=4
      when  !vul, !they.vul
  4x  "Preemptive game raise: four trumps and a singleton"   shows x>=4, shortest<=1, hcp<=9
      when  !vul
  4x  "Game in the fit"                        shows x>=3, hcp=15..19
      when  x is H | x is S
      when  vul | (!they.vul, hcp>=16 | x>=4) | hcp>=18
  4x  "Game with five-card support"            shows x>=5, hcp=13..19
      when  x is H | x is S
  # 3NT before five of the minor (Rick, 2026-09-27, ticket
  # basic-weak-2-b104): nine tricks instead of eleven, and it scores
  # more even with an overtrick. Diamond help and the side suits held;
  # a six-card major is bid instead. From 16: with 15 the 2NT ask finds
  # the minimum (notes).
  3N  "To play: 16+, help in diamonds, the side suits stopped"
      shows hcp>=16, x>=2, stop(S), stop(H), stop(C), H<=5, S<=5
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  5x  "Game in diamonds: three-card support, 18-20"   shows x>=3, hcp=18..20
      when  x is D
  2H  "Natural, forcing: 5+ hearts, 13+"   shows H>=5, hcp>=13
      when  x is D, H>=6 | hcp=14
      sets  forcing=round
  2S  "Natural, forcing: 5+ spades, 13+"   shows S>=5, hcp>=13
      when  x is D, S>=6 | hcp=14
      sets  forcing=round
  2S  "Natural, forcing: 5+ spades, 13+"   shows S>=5, hcp>=13, H<=1
      when  x is H
      sets  forcing=round
  P   "No interest"                            shows hcp<=19
      priority -5

# Opener after a new suit (default and bba). Raise with three, else rebid the suit.
after 2x (P) 2y (P) when weak_two_suit(x), x is not C | two_c is natural, style is not standard
  4y  "Three-card support: game"   shows y>=3
      when  y is H | y is S
  3y  "Three-card support"                 shows y>=3
  3x  "No fit: rebid the suit"             shows y<=2

# Responder after opener rebids the suit (no three-card support).
# Probed 2026-09-25 (w2-2H-2S-3H, w2-2D-2H-3D, w2-2D-2S-3D): BBA passes
# up to about 18 unless it has seven of its major (game from 13), bids
# three of the major with six and 19+, and 3NT or four of opener's major
# from 20.
after 2x (P) 2y (P) 3x (P) when weak_two_suit(x), x is not C | two_c is natural, style is not standard, y is H | y is S
  4y  "To play: 7+ {y}"   shows y>=7
  4y  "To play: 6+ {y}, four top honours"      shows y>=6, top5(y)>=4, hcp>=16
  3y  "Six-card suit, 19+: forcing, asks for a doubleton"   shows y>=6, hcp>=19
      sets  forcing=round
  4x  "Game in partner's suit: 20+"   shows hcp>=20
