      priority 1
  3C  "Preemptive: seven clubs, 4-10"             shows C>=7, hcp=4..10
      priority 1

# ── Weak jump overcalls ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# The weak-two rules of preempts.bid: six cards and 4-10 HCP, and
# vulnerable two of the top three or three of the top five honours.
# A jump is only a jump where the suit was biddable more cheaply, so
# each rule names the openings it applies to.
after (1x) when jump is weak
  2D  "Weak jump overcall: six diamonds, 4-10"   shows D=6, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is not D, x is not H, x is not S
      when  !vul | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3
  2H  "Weak jump overcall: six hearts, 4-10"     shows H=6, hcp=4..10, S<=3
      when  x is not H, x is not S
      when  !vul | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  2S  "Weak jump overcall: six spades, 4-10"     shows S=6, hcp=4..10
      when  x is not S
      when  !vul | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3

# Seven-card suits jump to the three level, as they open at the three
# level uncontested.
after (1x) when jump is weak
  3C  "Jump overcall: seven clubs, 4-10"    shows C=7, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is not C
      when  !vul | quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=3
  3D  "Jump overcall: seven diamonds, 4-10" shows D=7, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is not D
      when  !vul | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3
  3H  "Jump overcall: seven hearts, 4-10"   shows H=7, hcp=4..10, S<=3
      when  x is not H
      when  !vul | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  3S  "Jump overcall: seven spades, 4-10"   shows S=7, hcp=4..10
      when  x is not S
      when  !vul | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3

# ── The sandwich seat: (1x) P (1y) ───────────────────────────────────
# Fourth hand after opener's partner has responded one of a suit
# (2026-10-07). Nothing was written here, so this hand always passed
# ("Defending: nothing more to say"): 78% of the positions where BBA
# acted and that rule passed were such first entries (total-tricks.notes.md),
# and conventions that answer this interference (support doubles and
# redoubles) never arose in our own auctions. The same overcalls as in
# the direct seat, in the suits they have not bid, and the same weak
# jumps; 1NT is natural and stops both their suits; the double is for
# takeout of the two unbid suits. BBA, 21GF-DEFAULT
# (probes/oc4-1D-P-1H.toml, oc4-1H-P-1S.toml): overcalls 8-17 total
# points at the one level and 12-17 at the two, 1NT 15-17, the double
# 12+ with three or more in both unbid suits, weak jumps as in the
# direct seat. Our double wants eight cards in the two suits (or 15+):
# BBA passes most 12-14 hands with four-three. A five-card suit
# overcalls first. Partner has passed, so there is no power double
# here: strong hands overcall (up to 18 HCP) or double. Not written:
# BBA's 2NT for the two lowest unbid suits and its natural bids in
# responder's suit (2H, 3H over 1D P 1H with six or seven hearts).
after (1x) P (1y) when y is not x
  1S  "Overcall: five spades, {one_min}-18 total points"
      shows S>=5, S>=H | x is H | y is H, S>=D | x is D | y is D, S>=C | x is C | y is C
      shows hcp+length_points>=one_min, hcp<=18
      when  x is not S, y is not S
      when  quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3 | hcp+length_points>=12
  1H  "Overcall: five hearts, {one_min}-18 total points"
      shows H>=5, H>S | x is S | y is S, H>=D | x is D | y is D, H>=C | x is C | y is C
      shows hcp+length_points>=one_min, hcp<=18
      when  x is not H, y is not H, y is not S
      when  quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3 | hcp+length_points>=12
  2C  "Overcall: five clubs, {two_min}-18 total points"
      shows C>=5, C>S | x is S | y is S, C>H | x is H | y is H, C>D | x is D | y is D
      shows hcp>=two_min | (C>=6, hcp>=two_min-1), hcp<=18
      when  x is not C, y is not C
      when  C>=6 | quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=4
  2D  "Overcall: five diamonds, {two_min}-18 total points"
      shows D>=5, D>S | x is S | y is S, D>H | x is H | y is H, D>=C | x is C | y is C
      shows hcp>=two_min | (D>=6, hcp>=two_min-1), hcp<=18
      when  x is not D, y is not D
      when  D>=6 | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=4
  2H  "Overcall: five hearts, {two_min}-18 total points"
      shows H>=5, H>S | x is S | y is S, H>=D | x is D | y is D, H>=C | x is C | y is C
      shows hcp>=two_min | (H>=6, hcp>=two_min-1), hcp<=18
      when  x is not H, y is S
      when  H>=6 | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=4
  1N  "{nt_min}-{nt_max} balanced, both their suits stopped"
      shows balanced, hcp>=nt_min, hcp<=nt_max, S<=4, H<=4
      when  stop(x), stop(y), !passed_hand, !sandwich   # Sandwich 1NT shows the two unbid suits
  # The takeout double of the two suits they have not bid.
  X   "Takeout: hearts and spades, 12+"   shows H>=3, S>=3, H+S>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is C, y is D
      priority -1
  X   "Takeout: diamonds and spades, 12+" shows D>=3, S>=3, D+S>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is C, y is H
      priority -1
  X   "Takeout: diamonds and hearts, 12+" shows D>=3, H>=3, D+H>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is C, y is S
      priority -1
  X   "Takeout: clubs and spades, 12+"    shows C>=3, S>=3, C+S>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is D, y is H
      priority -1
  X   "Takeout: clubs and hearts, 12+"    shows C>=3, H>=3, C+H>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is D, y is S
      priority -1
  X   "Takeout: both minors, 12+"         shows C>=3, D>=3, C+D>=8 | hcp>=15, hcp>=12
      when  x is H, y is S
      priority -1
  # With 15+, four or more in both and not balanced (1NT), the double
  # comes before an overcall.
  X   "Takeout: hearts and spades, 15+"     shows H>=4, S>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is C, y is D
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout: diamonds and spades, 15+"   shows D>=4, S>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is C, y is H
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout: diamonds and hearts, 15+"   shows D>=4, H>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is C, y is S
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout: clubs and spades, 15+"      shows C>=4, S>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is D, y is H
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout: clubs and hearts, 15+"      shows C>=4, H>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is D, y is S
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout: both minors, 15+"           shows C>=4, D>=4, hcp>=15, !balanced
      when  x is H, y is S
      priority 1
  P   "No overcall"  priority -10

after (1x) P (1y) when y is not x, jump is weak
  2S  "Weak jump overcall: six spades, 4-10"   shows S=6, hcp=4..10
      when  x is not S, y is not S
      when  !vul | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3
  2H  "Weak jump overcall: six hearts, 4-10"   shows H=6, hcp=4..10, S<=3
      when  x is not H, y is not H, y is not S
      when  !vul | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  3C  "Jump overcall: seven clubs, 4-10"    shows C=7, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is not C, y is not C
      when  !vul | quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=3
  3D  "Jump overcall: seven diamonds, 4-10" shows D=7, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is not D, y is not D
      when  !vul | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3
  3H  "Jump overcall: seven hearts, 4-10"   shows H=7, hcp=4..10, S<=3
      when  x is not H, y is not H
      when  !vul | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  3S  "Jump overcall: seven spades, 4-10"   shows S=7, hcp=4..10
      when  x is not S, y is not S
      when  !vul | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3

# ── Over their raise: (1x) P (2x), (1x) P (3x) ─────────────────────
# Direct seat after opener's partner raised (2026-10-20, Brill daily
# board 4: 1C P 2C with AKQJ85.QT8732.5.- passed twice, every other
# entrant bid). Nothing was written here, so the seat fell through to
# advances.bid's "Defending: nothing more to say". Standard practice,
# the direct-seat overcalls one level up: a natural suit at the cheapest
# level, five or more (a good suit or six) with 10+ total points at the
# two level; at the three level six cards from 10 HCP, or five with 14+
# and not balanced (the tripwire: five-card 3C overcalls on 11-13, and a
# balanced 15, went down where the pass defended); up to 16 HCP;
# a jump with six (seven at the four level is not written) and 4-10,
# weak as over their opening. The takeout double of the raise is
# takeout-double.bid's, the cue bid and 2NT two-suiters
# two-suited-overcalls.bid's. Higher of equal-length suits, as above.
after (1x) P (2x)
  2S  "Overcall over their raise: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H | x is H, S>=D | x is D, S>=C | x is C
      shows hcp+length_points>=10, hcp<=one_max
      when  x is not S
      when  S>=6 | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3
  2H  "Overcall over their raise: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D | x is D, H>=C | x is C
      shows hcp+length_points>=10, hcp<=one_max
      when  x is C | x is D
      when  H>=6 | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  2D  "Overcall over their raise: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C | x is C
      shows hcp+length_points>=10, hcp<=one_max
      when  x is C
      when  D>=6 | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3
  3H  "Overcall over their raise: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>=D, H>=C
      shows (H>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is S
      when  H>=6 | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=4
  3D  "Overcall over their raise: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S | x is S, D>H | x is H, D>=C
      shows (D>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is H | x is S
      when  D>=6 | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=4
  3C  "Overcall over their raise: five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, C>S | x is S, C>H | x is H, C>D | x is D
      shows (C>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is not C
      when  C>=6 | quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=4
  P   "No overcall over their raise"  priority -10

after (1x) P (2x) when jump is weak
  3S  "Weak jump over their raise: six spades, 4-10"   shows S=6, hcp=4..10
      when  x is not S
      when  !vul | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3
  3H  "Weak jump over their raise: six hearts, 4-10"   shows H=6, hcp=4..10, S<=3
      when  x is C | x is D
      when  !vul | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3
  3D  "Weak jump over their raise: six diamonds, 4-10" shows D=6, hcp=4..10, H<=3, S<=3
      when  x is C
      when  !vul | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3

# Over the jump raise only the three level is left below game: a natural
# suit with the three-level overcall's values; four of a suit is not
# written.
after (1x) P (3x)
  3S  "Overcall over their jump raise: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H | x is H, S>=D | x is D, S>=C | x is C
      shows (S>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is not S
      when  S>=6 | quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=4
  3H  "Overcall over their jump raise: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D | x is D, H>=C | x is C
      shows (H>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is C | x is D
      when  H>=6 | quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=4
  3D  "Overcall over their jump raise: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C | x is C
      shows (D>=6, hcp>=two_min-2) | (hcp>=14, !balanced), hcp<=one_max
      when  x is C
      when  D>=6 | quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=4
  P   "No overcall over their jump raise"  priority -10

# ── Nothing to say ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# An explicit pass, so that the seat is covered and partner can draw the
# negative inference that we had no overcall.
# A strong hand doubles first (takeout-double.bid), so the pass caps the
# hand at the one-level overcall maximum. A trap pass is not assumed until
# it shows (Rick, ticket b400, 2026-10-02): BBA's direct-seat passers
# over a one-level opening, vanilla set, 99% at most 14-16 HCP.
after (1x)
  P   "No overcall"  shows hcp<=one_max  priority -10

# Penalty doubles by judgment (docs/JUDGMENT-LAYER.md, Phase 3).
#
# Draft: see penalty-doubles.notes.md.

module penalty-doubles "Penalty doubles: they are too high"
  kind   judgement
  needs  base
  skill  competitive_bidding/penalty_doubles

# The contract is theirs and undoubled: RHO has just bid (direct), or LHO
# bid and both partner and RHO have passed since (passed round to me).
define direct = !rho.last=P, !rho.last=X, !rho.last=XX
define passed_round = rho.last=P, partner.last=P, !lho.last=P, !lho.last=X, !lho.last=XX

# Their suit, natural, and not one we have shown (a bid in our suit is a
# cue bid; Stayman, a strong 2C or a transfer shows no length in the suit).
define natural_theirs(x) = they.strain is x, they.fit(x).min>=4, partner.x.min<=2, shown.x.min<=2

# Where they will play: passed round to me, or a fit found, or game.
# Directly over a new suit the auction may be forcing.
define settled(x) = passed_round | they.fit(x).min>=7 | they.game_reached

# Rick's penalty-double standard (2026-09-23): four or more with two of
# the top three, or three of the top five.
define good_trumps(x) = x>=4, quality(x)>=good | top5(x)>=3

# They have bid game and I hold 17 or more: they have 23 at most between
# them, whatever partner's silence hides (2026-10-02; 18 doubles fewer
# contracts that make but gains less, notes).
define big_hand_vs_game = they.game_reached, hcp>=17

# What I hold in their suit against what we have shown between us
# (we.hcp.min: my HCP and the bottom of partner's range). Good four at
# 17 and any four at 20 since partner's floor is known more often
# (2026-10-03, after PRs #44/#45; notes, "Retuned on the higher floors").
# The big hand doubles their game on strength, but not short in their
# suit (a void or a singleton) with six or more of its own: that hand
# declares (vs-preempts.bid; Brill daily 2026-10-14 board 4, 5D doubled
# with a void and six hearts made, 6H on; 2026-10-15). A void and five
# still doubles (2026-10-14 board 7, 4S doubled went down). The
# takeout doubler keeps the old count: his pass of their game still
# denies 17+ (else the advancer loses the shape the double showed).
define pen_suit(x) = (good_trumps(x), we.hcp.min>=17) | (x>=4, we.hcp.min>=20) | (x>=3, we.hcp.min>=21) | we.hcp.min>=22 | (big_hand_vs_game, x>=2 | longest<=5 | me.last=X)

# Responder's first call over their overcall: the double is negative.
define responder_first = partner.opened, me.bids=0, !passed_hand, !me.last=X, !me.last=XX

# Partner need not have shown values: with 22 known in my own hand (or
# 17-21 with their trumps) the double stands alone. A condition that
# partner had shown 4+ was a par artefact: it lost on the errors
# yardstick on all three sets (penalty-doubles.notes.md, 2026-10-01).

# Not over partner's notrump opening (one bid, a range of four points or
# less): they came in with shape against a balanced hand, and the double
# lost (21GF random set, 2026-10-01).
define partner_nt = partner.opened, partner.bids=1, partner.hcp.min>=12, partner.hcp.max - partner.hcp.min <= 3

define pen_spot(x) = natural_theirs(x), settled(x), !partner_nt

when they.bid, direct | passed_round, !asked, they.level>=2, !responder_first
  X   "Penalty double of their spades"
      shows pen_suit(S)
      when  pen_spot(S)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their hearts"
      shows pen_suit(H)
      when  pen_spot(H)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their diamonds"
      shows pen_suit(D)
      when  pen_spot(D)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their clubs"
      shows pen_suit(C)
      when  pen_spot(C)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6

# Their notrump after they have both bid (not an opening 1NT or 2NT,
# which vs-1nt.bid and the defences answer).
when they.bid, passed_round | (direct, they.game_reached), !asked, !responder_first, they.strain is N, lho.bids + rho.bids >= 2
  X   "Penalty double of their notrump"
      shows we.hcp.min>=21 | big_hand_vs_game
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6

# They bid over our game: the side that bid game owns the hand, so the
# player with values (12+ in my hand, or 20 known between us) and two of
# their trumps doubles (2026-10-02). After partner's signoff too: the
# signoff's "nothing to add" pass (rebids.bid, priority -5) would
# otherwise sell out, so this double sits at -5.
define our_game_bid = me.last=3N | me.last=4H | me.last=4S | me.last=5C | me.last=5D | me.last=5H | me.last=5S | partner.last=3N | partner.last=4H | partner.last=4S | partner.last=5C | partner.last=5D | partner.last=5H | partner.last=5S
define over_our_game(x) = x>=2, hcp>=12 | we.hcp.min>=20

when they.bid, direct | passed_round, !asked | asked signoff, our_game_bid, they.level>=4, they.strain is not N
  X   "Penalty double of their spades"
      shows over_our_game(S)
      when  natural_theirs(S), !partner_nt
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -5
  X   "Penalty double of their hearts"
      shows over_our_game(H)
      when  natural_theirs(H), !partner_nt
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -5
  X   "Penalty double of their diamonds"
      shows over_our_game(D)
      when  natural_theirs(D), !partner_nt
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -5
  X   "Penalty double of their clubs"
      shows over_our_game(C)
      when  natural_theirs(C), !partner_nt
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -5

# They ran from our redouble or from partner's penalty double
# (2026-10-09): the redouble said we hold the balance (10+ opposite an
# opening), a penalty double the same, and what they bid now is a
# rescue, not forcing. The hand behind the rescuer doubles it with four
# or more of their suit (penalty-doubles.notes.md, "Doubling errors
# after the convention batches").
# The redouble is mine, of their takeout double of partner's opening
# (not a support, SOS or McCabe redouble: those show a holding), and
# the doubler has run from it, directly in front of me. Opener's double
# of the advance (1x X XX 1y/2y X) and mine of a forced one-level
# advance passed round to me lost on the random sets: left out.
define we_redoubled = me.last=XX, partner.opened, me.bids=0, partner.hcp.min>=10, direct
define they_ran = we_redoubled | asked nt_penalty | asked penalty
# After partner's penalty double of their suit, a run is a new suit:
# the runner's partner has not bid it. A raise of the doubled suit is
# not a rescue (Brill daily 2026-10-08 board 2: 1NT 2D 2H (X) 4H,
# doubled on T764 and made; 2026-10-15). After our redouble or a
# penalty double of their notrump every bid of theirs is a run (the
# doubler's side raising the rescue included).
define ran_to(x) = !(asked penalty) | (direct, !lho.named(x)) | (passed_round, !rho.named(x))
define ran_into(x) = x>=4

when they.bid, direct | passed_round, they_ran
  X   "Penalty: four or more spades"
      shows ran_into(S)
      when  natural_theirs(S), ran_to(S)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority 0
  X   "Penalty: four or more hearts"
      shows ran_into(H)
      when  natural_theirs(H), ran_to(H)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority 0
  X   "Penalty: four or more diamonds"
      shows ran_into(D)
      when  natural_theirs(D), ran_to(D)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority 0
  X   "Penalty: four or more clubs"
      shows ran_into(C)
      when  natural_theirs(C), ran_to(C)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority 0

# Partner preempted (a weak two or a three-level opening) and they
# overcalled: partner's hand is described and has little defence, so my
# double is for penalty (Berkowitz-Cohen, low-level doubles: penalty
# "after 2♦, 2M openings"), on my own strength and their trumps
# (2026-10-09, notes).
define partner_preempted = partner.opened, partner.bids=1, partner.hcp.max<=11
define vs_overcall_of_preempt(x) = (x>=2, hcp>=15) | (x>=4, hcp>=12) | (x>=3, hcp>=12, quality(x)>=good | top5(x)>=3) | (x>=5, hcp>=9)

when they.bid, direct | passed_round, !asked, partner_preempted, me.bids=0
  X   "Penalty double of their spades"
      shows vs_overcall_of_preempt(S)
      when  natural_theirs(S)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their hearts"
      shows vs_overcall_of_preempt(H)
      when  natural_theirs(H)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their diamonds"
      shows vs_overcall_of_preempt(D)
      when  natural_theirs(D)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their clubs"
      shows vs_overcall_of_preempt(C)
      when  natural_theirs(C)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6

# Their one-level overcall after we have both bid, passed round to me:
# opener's pass denied a fit and extras, so the hand is a misfit for
# them and ours on strength; the double is for penalty (2026-10-09,
# notes).
define one_level_pen(x) = (x>=3, we.hcp.min>=19) | (x>=2, we.hcp.min>=22)

when they.bid, passed_round, !asked, they.level=1, me.has_bid, partner.has_bid
  X   "Penalty double of their spades"
      shows one_level_pen(S)
      when  natural_theirs(S)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their hearts"
      shows one_level_pen(H)
      when  natural_theirs(H)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6
  X   "Penalty double of their diamonds"
      shows one_level_pen(D)
      when  natural_theirs(D)
      sets  ask=penalty
      priority -6

# Partner sits when RHO passed; when they run, the double of the
# runout above answers it (2026-10-09).
when asked penalty, rho.last=P
  P   "Leaves the double in"  priority -1

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Rubensohl (convention-card competitive_bidding/rubensohl; Wikipedia,
# "Rubinsohl"; Larry Cohen, "Transfer Lebensohl"): a transfer version of
# Lebensohl. Every bid from 2NT up is a transfer to the next strain.
#
# 1. After a natural two-level overcall of our 1NT (2♦, 2♥, 2♠;
#    `notrump.rubensohl.play`, which switches Lebensohl off):
#
#    - two of a suit: natural, to play; the double: as the card says
#      (nt-interference.bid);
#    - 2NT clubs, 3♣ diamonds, 3♦ hearts, 3♥ spades, 3♠ notrump;
#    - the transfer to their suit is Stayman: game values, four cards in
#      an unbid major;
#    - the transfer to notrump (3♠, or 3♠ over 2♠: their suit) is game
#      values with no stopper and no four-card major; 3NT is game with a
#      stopper;
#    - a transfer to a minor: six or more, weak (to play) or with game
#      values (then 3NT); to a major: five or more, invitational or
#      better (Wikipedia: "at least invitational").
#
#    Opener completes a transfer with a minimum; with a maximum (17) and
#    three-card support for the major he bids game, with a maximum and
#    no fit 3NT. He answers Stayman with the major, else 3NT with a
#    stopper, else completes to their suit. Responder then places it.
#
# 2. After partner's takeout double of their weak two
#    (`competitive.rubensohl_after_double.play`, which switches
#    Lebensohl there off: vs-preempts.bid): the same transfers from 2NT
#    up (Wikipedia: "the same transfer structure applies"), with the
#    doubler in opener's place. A transfer shows four or more (five in
#    a major below their suit when it jumps past two of it) and either a
#    weak hand to play at three or 9+; the transfer to their suit is
#    Stayman-like (game values, four of an unbid major), the transfer to
#    notrump game values without a stopper.
#
# Notes: rubensohl.notes.md.

module rubensohl "Rubensohl: transfers after interference over 1NT and after doubling a weak two"
  kind   convention
  needs  nt-interference
  needs  vs-preempts
  skill  competitive_bidding/rubensohl
  param  over_nt  = competitive_bidding/rubensohl:over_1nt_interference default false
  param  after_x  = competitive_bidding/rubensohl:after_double default false

define rub_nt(y) = over_nt, rho.y>=4, (maybe rho.H<=3) | (maybe rho.S<=3)
define rub_nt_opener(y) = over_nt, lho.y>=4, (maybe lho.H<=3) | (maybe lho.S<=3)

# ════ 1. After they overcall our 1NT ═════════════════════════════════

# ── Responder over 2♦ ───────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1N (2D) when rub_nt(D)
  2N  "Rubensohl: transfer to clubs, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=6, C>D, H<=3, S<=3
      priority 3
  3C  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, a four-card major"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, H=4 | S=4, H<=4, S<=4
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: transfer to hearts, invitational or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, H>=S, hcp>=8
      priority 3
  3H  "Rubensohl: transfer to spades, invitational or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, S>H, hcp>=8
      priority 3
  3S  "Rubensohl: game values, no stopper in {y}"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, !stop(D), H<=3, S<=3
      priority 3
  3N  "Game with a stopper in diamonds"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(D), H<=3, S<=3
      priority 3

# ── Responder over 2♥ ───────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1N (2H) when rub_nt(H)
  2N  "Rubensohl: transfer to clubs, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=6, C>=D, S<=3
      priority 3
  3C  "Rubensohl: transfer to diamonds, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=6, D>C, S<=3
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, four spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, S=4
      priority 3
  3H  "Rubensohl: transfer to spades, invitational or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, hcp>=8
      priority 3
  3S  "Rubensohl: game values, no stopper in hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, !stop(H), S<=3
      priority 3
  3N  "Game with a stopper in hearts"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(H), S<=3
      priority 3

# ── Responder over 2♠ ───────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1N (2S) when rub_nt(S)
  2N  "Rubensohl: transfer to clubs, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=6, C>=D, H<=3
      priority 3
  3C  "Rubensohl: transfer to diamonds, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=6, D>C, H<=3
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: transfer to hearts, invitational or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, hcp>=8
      priority 3
  3H  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, four hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, H=4
      priority 3
  3S  "Rubensohl: game values, no stopper in spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=10, !stop(S), H<=3
      priority 3
  3N  "Game with a stopper in spades"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(S), H<=3
      priority 3

# ── Opener ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1N (2y) 2N (P) when rub_nt_opener(y)
  3C  "Completes the transfer to clubs"           artificial
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3C (P) when rub_nt_opener(y), y is not D
  3D  "Completes the transfer to diamonds"        artificial
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3D (P) when rub_nt_opener(y), y is not H
  4H  "A maximum and three or more hearts: game"  shows H>=3, hcp>=17
      priority 4
  3N  "A maximum, two hearts"                     shows H<=2, hcp>=17
      priority 4
  3H  "Completes the transfer: a minimum"         artificial
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3H (P) when rub_nt_opener(y), y is not S
  4S  "A maximum and three or more spades: game"  shows S>=3, hcp>=17
      priority 4
  3N  "A maximum, two spades"                     shows S<=2, hcp>=17
      priority 4
  3S  "Completes the transfer: a minimum"         artificial
      priority 3
# Stayman (the transfer to their suit): the major, else 3NT with a
# stopper, else their suit (no stopper, no major).
after 1N (2D) 3C (P) when rub_nt_opener(D)
  3H  "Four hearts"                               shows H>=4
      priority 4
  3S  "Four spades"                               shows S>=4, H<=3
      priority 4
  3N  "No four-card major, diamonds stopped"      shows stop(D)
      priority 3
  3D  "No four-card major, no stopper"            artificial
      priority 2
after 1N (2H) 3D (P) when rub_nt_opener(H)
  3S  "Four spades"                               shows S>=4
      priority 4
  3N  "No four spades, hearts stopped"            shows stop(H)
      priority 3
  3H  "No four spades, no stopper"                artificial
      priority 2
after 1N (2S) 3H (P) when rub_nt_opener(S)
  4H  "Four hearts"                               shows H>=4
      priority 4
  3N  "No four hearts, spades stopped"            shows stop(S)
      priority 3
  3S  "No four hearts, no stopper"                artificial
      priority 2
# Game values without a stopper.
after 1N (2y) 3S (P) when rub_nt_opener(y)
  3N  "A stopper in {y}"                          shows stop(y)
      priority 3
  4C  "No stopper: clubs"                         shows C>=D
      priority 2
  4D  "No stopper: diamonds"                      shows D>C
      priority 2

# ── Responder after the completion ──────────────────────────────────
after 1N (2y) 2N (P) 3C (P) when rub_nt(y)
  P   "Weak: to play in clubs"                    shows hcp<=9
      priority 3
  3N  "Game values with clubs"                    shows hcp>=10
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3C (P) 3D (P) when rub_nt(y), y is not D
  P   "Weak: to play in diamonds"                 shows hcp<=9
      priority 3
  3N  "Game values with diamonds"                 shows hcp>=10
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3D (P) 3H (P) when rub_nt(y), y is not H
  P   "Invitational: no more"                     shows hcp<=9
      priority 3
  4H  "Game: six or more hearts"                  shows H>=6, hcp>=10
      priority 3
  3N  "Game: five hearts, choice of games"        shows H=5, hcp>=10
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3H (P) 3S (P) when rub_nt(y), y is not S
  P   "Invitational: no more"                     shows hcp<=9
      priority 3
  4S  "Game: six or more spades"                  shows S>=6, hcp>=10
      priority 3
  3N  "Game: five spades, choice of games"        shows S=5, hcp>=10
      priority 3
after 1N (2y) 3D (P) 3H (P) 3N (P) when rub_nt_opener(y), y is not H
  4H  "Three hearts: the major"                   shows H>=3
      priority 3
  P   "Two hearts: notrump"                       priority 2
after 1N (2y) 3H (P) 3S (P) 3N (P) when rub_nt_opener(y), y is not S
  4S  "Three spades: the major"                   shows S>=3
      priority 3
  P   "Two spades: notrump"                       priority 2
# After the Stayman answer.
after 1N (2D) 3C (P) 3H (P) | 1N (2D) 3C (P) 3S (P) | 1N (2H) 3D (P) 3S (P) | 1N (2S) 3H (P) 4H (P) when over_nt
  4H  "The heart fit: game"                       shows H>=4
      when  partner.H>=4
      priority 3
  4S  "The spade fit: game"                       shows S>=4
      when  partner.S>=4
      priority 3
  3N  "No fit: notrump"
      priority 2
  P   "Game reached"
      priority 1
after 1N (2D) 3C (P) 3D (P) | 1N (2H) 3D (P) 3H (P) | 1N (2S) 3H (P) 3S (P) when over_nt
  4C  "No stopper: clubs"              shows C>=4, C>=D
      priority 2
  4D  "No stopper: diamonds"           shows D>=4, D>C
      priority 2
  3N  "To play in 3NT"
      priority 1

# ════ 2. After partner doubles their weak two ═══════════════════════
# Advancer. Their suit x is 2♦, 2♥ or 2♠. Two of a suit is natural and
# weak (vs-preempts.bid).
after (2x) X (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) when after_x, x is not C
  2N  "Rubensohl: transfer to clubs, to play or invite"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, C>=D, hcp<=12 | C>=5, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      priority 3
  3C  "Rubensohl: transfer to diamonds, to play or invite"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=4, D>C, hcp<=12 | D>=5, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not D
      priority 3
  3C  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, a four-card major"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, H=4 | S=4, H<=4, S<=4
      when  x is D
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: transfer to hearts, four or more"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=4, H>=S | x is S, hcp<=12
      when  x is S
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: transfer to hearts, five or more, 9-12"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, H>=S, hcp>=9, hcp<=12
      when  x is D
      priority 3
  3D  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, four spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, S=4
      when  x is H
      priority 3
  3H  "Rubensohl: transfer to spades, five or more, 9-12"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, hcp>=9, hcp<=12
      when  x is D | x is H
      priority 3
  3H  "Rubensohl: Stayman, game values, four hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, H=4
      when  x is S
      priority 3
  3S  "Rubensohl: game values, no stopper in {x}, no four-card major"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, !stop(x), H<=3 | x is H, S<=3 | x is S
      priority 3
  3N  "Game with {x} stopped"
      shows hcp>=13, stop(x), H<=3 | x is H, S<=3 | x is S
      priority 3

# The doubler completes the transfer (with 17+ and four-card support for
# a major he bids game); answers the Stayman transfer with a major, else
# 3NT with a stopper, else their suit; over 3♠, 3NT with a stopper.
# With 19+ and their suit stopped the doubler bids 3NT instead, as over
# Lebensohl's relay (vs-preempts.bid); the self A/B (2026-10-05) lost
# the games that relay found, partner's transfer passed with 20-22.
after (2x) X (P) 2N (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2N (P) when after_x, x is not C
  3N  "19+ with {x} stopped: game"               shows hcp>=19, stop(x)
      priority 4
  3C  "Completes the transfer"                    artificial
      priority 3
after (2x) X (P) 3C (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3C (P) when after_x, x is not C, x is not D
  3N  "19+ with {x} stopped: game"               shows hcp>=19, stop(x)
      priority 4
  3D  "Completes the transfer"                    artificial
      priority 3
after (2x) X (P) 3D (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3D (P) when after_x, x is not C, x is not H
  4H  "17+ and four hearts: game"                 shows H>=4, hcp>=17
      priority 5
  3N  "19+ with {x} stopped, two hearts or fewer: game"   shows hcp>=19, stop(x), H<=2
      priority 4
  3H  "Completes the transfer"                    artificial
      priority 3
after (2x) X (P) 3H (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3H (P) when after_x, x is not C, x is not S
  4S  "17+ and four spades: game"                 shows S>=4, hcp>=17
      priority 5
  3N  "19+ with {x} stopped, two spades or fewer: game"   shows hcp>=19, stop(x), S<=2
      priority 4
  3S  "Completes the transfer"                    artificial
      priority 3
after (2x) X (P) 3C (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3C (P) when after_x, x is D
  3H  "Four hearts"                               shows H>=4
      priority 4
  3S  "Four spades"                               shows S>=4, H<=3
      priority 4
  3N  "No four-card major, diamonds stopped"      shows stop(D)
      priority 3
  3D  "No four-card major, no stopper"            artificial
      priority 2
after (2x) X (P) 3D (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3D (P) when after_x, x is H
  3S  "Four spades"                               shows S>=4
      priority 4
  3N  "No four spades, hearts stopped"            shows stop(H)
      priority 3
  3H  "No four spades, no stopper"                artificial
      priority 2
after (2x) X (P) 3H (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3H (P) when after_x, x is S
  4H  "Four hearts"                               shows H>=4
      priority 4
  3N  "No four hearts, spades stopped"            shows stop(S)
      priority 3
  3S  "No four hearts, no stopper"                artificial
      priority 2
after (2x) X (P) 3S (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3S (P) when after_x, x is not C
  3N  "A stopper in {x}"                          shows stop(x)
      priority 3
  4C  "No stopper: clubs"                         shows C>=D
      priority 2
  4D  "No stopper: diamonds"                      shows D>C
      priority 2

# Advancer after the completion: pass when weak, else game.
after (2x) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) | (2x) X (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) when after_x, x is not C
  P   "Weak: to play"                             shows hcp<=8
      priority 3
  3N  "9+ with {x} stopped"                       shows hcp>=9, stop(x)
      priority 3
  P   "To play"                            priority 1
after (2x) X (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) when after_x, x is not C, x is not H
  4H  "Game: 11+ with five, or 12+"               shows hcp>=11, H>=5 | hcp>=12
      priority 3
  P   "Weak or invitational: no more"             priority 1
after (2x) X (P) 3H (P) 3S (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3H (P) 3S (P) when after_x, x is not C, x is not S
  4S  "Game: 11+ with five, or 12+"               shows hcp>=11, S>=5 | hcp>=12
      priority 3
  P   "Invitational: no more"                     priority 1

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Takeout doubles of a one-level opening, and advancer's replies
# (Rick, 2026-09-22):
#
# - a takeout double is 12 total points with three or more cards in every
#   unbid suit;
# - it is also the call with 17+ HCP and any shape, including a long
#   strong suit: too strong to overcall is double first, then bid the suit
#   (overcalls.bid stops at 16 HCP). In HCP since 2026-09-27: BBA's power
#   doubles step up at 17 HCP (takeout-double.notes.md), and an HCP
#   threshold lets the deck and the auction rule the power hand out;
# - advancer answers on the standard ladder: a suit at the cheapest level
#   is 0-8, a jump 9-11, and the cue bid of their suit 12+;
# - advancer bids his longest suit, majors first, and the cheaper of two
#   equal suits.
#
# Not written yet: responsive doubles (off on this card), advancer over
# RHO's bid, and doubles of anything but a one-level suit opening.

module takeout-double "Takeout doubles"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  needs  overcalls
  skill  competitive_bidding/takeout_doubles
  param  oc_max = overcalls.one_level_max default 16

# ── The double ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after (1x)
  X   "Takeout: the unbid suits and 12+, or any 18+"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      shows ((S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C)) | hcp>=oc_max+1
      # A queen or jack, alone, in a doubleton of their suit is marked
      # down: 12 with Qx or Jx there passes, 13 doubles. BBA does this at
      # every vulnerability (probes/td-1S-shape.toml; ticket b60); we only
      # at unfavourable, the one where it gains on both yardsticks (notes).
      shows hcp+length_points>=13 | x>=3 | has(A,x) | has(K,x) | (!has(Q,x), !has(J,x)) | !vul | they.vul

# ── Advancer, when RHO passes ────────────────────────────────────────
# The double is forcing: advancer names his suit however weak he is.
# A suit at the cheapest level says nothing beyond 0-8 total points.
after (1x) X (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P)
  1H  "0-8 total points, four or more hearts"   shows H>=4, H>=S | x is S, hcp+length_points<=8 | (H=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not H, x is not S
  1S  "0-8 total points, four or more spades"   shows S>=4, S>H | x is H, hcp+length_points<=8 | (S=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not S
  1D  "0-8 total points, four or more diamonds" shows D>=4, D>C, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H, hcp+length_points<=8 | (D=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not D, x is not H, x is not S
  2C  "0-8 total points, four or more clubs"    shows C>=4, C>=D, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H, hcp+length_points<=8 | (C=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not C
  2D  "0-8 total points, four or more diamonds" shows D>=4, D>C, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H, hcp+length_points<=8 | (D=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not D, x is not C
  2H  "0-8 total points, four or more hearts"   shows H>=4, H>=S | x is S, hcp+length_points<=8 | (H=4, hcp<=9)
      when  x is not H, x is not D, x is not C
  1N  "7-10 HCP, balanced, a stopper in {x}"
      shows balanced, hcp>=7, hcp<=10
      when  stop(x)

# Jumps invite: 9-11 total points with the same suits.
after (1x) X (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P)
  2H  "9-11 total points, four or more hearts"   shows H>=4, H>=S | x is S, hcp+length_points=9..11, H>=5 | hcp>=10
      when  x is not H, x is not S
  2S  "9-11 total points, four or more spades"   shows S>=4, S>H | x is H, hcp+length_points=9..11, S>=5 | hcp>=10
      when  x is not S
  3C  "9-11 total points, four or more clubs"    shows C>=4, C>=D, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H, hcp+length_points=9..11, C>=5 | hcp>=10
      when  x is not C
  3D  "9-11 total points, four or more diamonds" shows D>=4, D>C, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H, hcp+length_points=9..11, D>=5 | hcp>=10
      when  x is not D, x is not C
  3H  "9-11 total points, four or more hearts"   shows H>=4, H>=S | x is S, hcp+length_points=9..11, H>=5 | hcp>=10
      when  x is not H, x is not D, x is not C
  2N  "11-12 total points, balanced, a stopper in {x}"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points=11..12
      when  stop(x)

# BBA (probes/advance-1S-X.toml, 2026-09-25): 12+ with their suit held
# and no four-card unbid major bids 3NT; with no four-card suit to name,
# the cheapest three-card suit.
after (1x) X (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P)
  3N  "Game: 12+, a stopper in {x}"  shows hcp>=12, stop(x), (H<=3 | x is H), (S<=3 | x is S)
      priority 2
  1D  "0-8, no four-card suit to show: three diamonds"  shows D>=3, H<=3, S<=3, hcp<=8
      when  x is C
      priority -2
  1H  "0-8, no four-card suit to show: three hearts"   shows H>=3, S<=3, hcp<=8
      when  x is not H, x is not S
      priority -3
  2C  "0-8, no four-card suit to show: three clubs"    shows C>=3, H<=3, S<=3, hcp<=8
      when  x is not C
      priority -2
  2D  "0-8, no four-card suit to show: three diamonds" shows D>=3, H<=3, S<=3, hcp<=8
      when  x is not D, x is not C
      priority -3

# The cue bid is the only game force: 12+ with no clear suit to jump in.
after (1x) X (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P)
  2{x} "Cue bid: 12+ total points, asks for a description"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp+length_points>=12
      sets   forcing=game
      priority 1

# ── The doubler's rebid ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Advancer's cheapest suit said 0-8, so a minimum double passes. The
# hands too strong to overcall show themselves now: 18+ total points
# bids its own suit, raises with support, or bids notrump with a
# stopper. This is the second half of "double first, then bid the suit".
after (1x) X (P) 1y (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P) 1y (P)
  P   "Minimum takeout double"
      shows hcp<=16
      priority -5
  2{y} "18-19 total points, four-card support"
      shows y>=4, hcp+length_points=17..19
  3{y} "20-21 total points, four-card support"
      shows y>=4, hcp+length_points=20..21
  4{y} "22+ total points, four-card support for partner's major"
      shows y>=4, hcp+length_points>=22
      when  y is H | y is S
  1N  "18-19 balanced with a stopper in {x}"
      shows balanced, hcp=17..19
      when  stop(x)
  cheapest(S) "18+ total points and a five-card spade suit"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "18+ total points and a five-card heart suit"
      shows H>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "18+ total points and a five-card diamond suit"
      shows D>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "18+ total points and a five-card club suit"
      shows C>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not C, y is not C

after (1x) X (P) 2y (P) | (1x) P (P) X (P) 2y (P)
  P   "Minimum takeout double"
      shows hcp<=16
      priority -5
  3{y} "Strong raise: four-card support, 18+"
      shows y>=4, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
  3{y} "Strong raise: three-card support, 20+"
      shows y=3, hcp>=20
  cheapest(S) "18+ total points and a five-card spade suit"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "18+ total points and a five-card heart suit"
      shows H>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "18+ total points and a five-card diamond suit"
      shows D>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "18+ total points and a five-card club suit"
      shows C>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not C, y is not C
  2N  "18-19 balanced with a stopper in {x}"
      shows balanced, hcp=17..19
      when  stop(x)

# The doubler again when they compete (2026-09-25; no rules before). BBA:
# after (1x) X (2x) P P a five-card suit with 16+, or double again with
# 12+ short in their suit; when opener competes over the advance, raise
# with four and 16+, or show a five-card suit with 16+ (+645 with the
# suit bids). The second double first cost ~1,500 IMPs against par
# because advancer had no answer and left it in; with the takeout
# answers below it gains (2026-09-27, ticket b89, notes).
after (1x) X (2x) P (P)
  cheapest(S) "16+ and five spades"                 shows S>=5, hcp>=16
      when  x is not S
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "16+ and five hearts"                 shows H>=5, S<=4, hcp>=16
      when  x is not H
      priority 1
  X   "Takeout again: short in {x}"                 shows x<=1, hcp>=12
  P   "No further bid"                                priority -5

# Advancer after the second double: it is still for takeout. Bid the
# longest unbid suit, a major first; pass only with a trump stack.
after (1x) X (2x) P (P) X (P)
  cheapest(S) "Takeout: four or more spades"        shows S>=4, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C
      when  x is not S
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Takeout: four or more hearts"        shows H>=4, H>=D, H>=C
      when  x is not H
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Takeout: my longest, diamonds"       shows D>=C
      when  x is not D
  cheapest(C) "Takeout: my longest, clubs"          shows C>=3
      when  x is not C
      priority -1
  P   "Penalty: five of their suit"                 shows x>=5, hcp>=5
      priority 2

after (1x) X (P) 1y (2x) | (1x) X (P) 2y (2x)
  3{y} "16+, four-card support"                     shows y>=4, hcp+length_points>=16
  cheapest(C) "16+ and five clubs"                  shows C>=5, hcp>=16, y<=3
      when  x is not C, y is not C
  cheapest(D) "16+ and five diamonds"               shows D>=5, D>C, hcp>=16, y<=3
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  # The strong balanced double, as without their bid (2026-10-05, the
  # Raptor self A/B: 1♣ X P 1♥ 2♣ passed with 18 HCP; BBA bids 2NT).
  2N  "18-19 balanced with a stopper in {x}"       shows balanced, hcp=17..19
      when  stop(x)
  P   "No further bid"                                priority -5

# The doubler when their responder bid over the double, partner passed
# and opener bid again (2026-09-25: 1H (X) 1S (P) 1NT, where 18+ with a
# long suit passed). The strong double shows its suit now.
after (1x) X (1y) P (*) | (1x) X (2y) P (*) when y is not x, !rho.last=P
  cheapest(S) "18+ total points and five spades"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "18+ total points and five hearts"
      shows H>=5, S<=4, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "18+ total points and five diamonds"
      shows D>=5, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "18+ total points and five clubs"
      shows C>=5, D<=4, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=18 | hcp>=17
      when  x is not C, y is not C

# The doubler after advancer's cue bid when opener bids again
# (2026-09-27; Basic_Takeout_Double 193, 1H (X) P (2H) 3H). The cue bid
# forced to game and asked for a description. The power double (17+
# HCP) doubles; anything less describes itself, or passes where the
# force allows it. So not doubling denies the power hand, and partner can
# count the double's shape (the Law of Total Tricks, total-tricks.bid).
after (1x) X (P) 2x (*) when !rho.last=P
  X   "Power double: 17+ HCP"
      shows hcp>=17
      priority 1
  P   "No extras: 16 or less"                   shows hcp<=16
      priority -5
  # Below the pass: where the game force rules the pass out, the
  # minimum describes itself; a pass (BBA's forcing pass) denies only
  # the power hand, not every four-card suit.
  cheapest(S) "Four or more spades, no extras"   shows S>=4, hcp<=16
      when  x is not S
      priority -6
  cheapest(H) "Four or more hearts, no extras"   shows H>=4, S<=3, hcp<=16
      when  x is not H
      priority -6
  cheapest(N) "A stopper in {x}, no extras"     shows stop(x), hcp<=16
      priority -7
  # Four-card minors up the line (Rick, ticket b455): clubs with 4-4.
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds, no extras" shows D>=4, D>C | x is C, hcp<=16
      when  x is not D
      priority -8
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs, no extras"    shows C>=4, C>=D | x is D, hcp<=16
      when  x is not C
      priority -8

# ── Advancer when RHO does not pass ──────────────────────────────────
# The double is no longer forcing: advancer passes with nothing and bids
# his own suit freely. Over a one-level bid a four-card major is enough;
# higher up he needs five cards and more values.
after (1x) X (1y) | (1x) P (P) X (1y)
  1S  "Free bid: 6+ total points, four or more spades"
      shows S>=4, hcp+length_points>=6
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "Free bid: 6+ total points, five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, hcp+length_points>=6
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "Free bid: 6+ total points, five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, S<=3, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=6
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "Free bid: 6+ total points, five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, S<=3, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=6
      when  x is not C, y is not C
  1N  "8-11 total points, balanced, a stopper in both their suits"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points>=8, hcp+length_points<=11
      when  stop(x), stop(y)
  2{x} "Cue bid: 12+ total points"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp+length_points>=12
      sets   forcing=game
      priority 1
  P   "No free bid"  priority -10

after (1x) X (2y) | (1x) P (P) X (2y)
  cheapest(S) "Free bid: 8+ total points, five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "Free bid: 8+ total points, five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, S<=4, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  x is not H, y is not H
  cheapest(D) "Free bid: 8+ total points, five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  x is not D, y is not D
  cheapest(C) "Free bid: 8+ total points, five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  x is not C, y is not C
  2N  "11-12 total points, balanced, a stopper in {x}"
      shows balanced, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp+length_points<=12
      when  stop(x)
  P   "No free bid"  priority -10

# RHO redoubled: partner still wants to hear a suit, so advancer names
# his cheapest four-card suit however weak he is.
after (1x) X (XX) | (1x) P (P) X (XX)
  cheapest(S) "Four or more spades"   shows S>=4, S>H
      when  x is not S
  cheapest(H) "Four or more hearts"   shows H>=4, H>=S
      when  x is not H
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds" shows D>=4, D>C, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not D
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs"    shows C>=4, C>=D, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not C
  P   "No four-card suit to name"  priority -10

# The doubler when advancer passed the redouble (2026-09-27, ticket b197:
# 1S X XX P P P was -520). Advancer had no four-card suit to name, so the
# doubler runs to his cheapest four-card suit and advancer corrects;
# leaving it in needs four of their suit.
after (1x) X (XX) P (P)
  cheapest(C) "Rescue: four or more clubs, the cheapest"     shows C>=4
      when  x is not C
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Rescue: four or more diamonds, the cheapest"  shows D>=4, C<=3 | x is C
      when  x is not D
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Rescue: four or more hearts, the cheapest"    shows H>=4, C<=3 | x is C, D<=3 | x is D
      when  x is not H
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Rescue: four or more spades"                  shows S>=4, C<=3 | x is C, D<=3 | x is D, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not S
      priority 1
  P   "Leaves it in: four or more of their suit"             shows x>=4
      priority 2


# ── The double of their raise (2026-10-05) ───────────────────────────
# (1x) P (2x) X: they have found a fit, so the double is for takeout,
# not penalty (penalty-doubles.bid read it as penalty, priority -6):
# a singleton or void in their suit, three or more in each unbid suit,
# 13+ HCP (BBA mostly passes there: a first try at 12+ total points
# with a doubleton doubled on 95 of the tripwire's boards, BBA agreed
# on 14; scrambling-2nt.notes.md). Written with Scrambling 2NT (scrambling-2nt.bid), whose
# scenario starts here (PBS btn/Scrambling_2NT.btn: 13+, 4-4-4-1 or
# 5-4-4-0 short in their major).
after (1x) P (2x)
  X   "Takeout of their raise: short in {x}, the unbid suits, 13+ HCP"
      shows hcp>=13, x<=1
      shows (S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C)

# Advancer must bid (they have a fit; partner is short there): his
# longest unbid suit, majors first; four of a major or 3NT with game
# values opposite the double; a pass only with their suit stacked.
after (1x) P (2x) X (P)
  4S  "Game: four or more spades, 11+"
      shows S>=4, S>=H | x is H, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is not S
      priority 1
  4H  "Game: four or more hearts, 11+"
      shows H>=4, H>S | x is S, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is not H
      priority 1
  3N  "Game: 11+ with {x} stopped"
      shows hcp>=11, stop(x), S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      priority 1
  P   "Penalty: five or more {x} with two top honours"
      shows x>=5, quality(x)>=good
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Four or more spades"     shows S>=4, S>=H | x is H
      when  x is not S
  cheapest(H) "Four or more hearts"     shows H>=4, H>S | x is S
      when  x is not H
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds"   shows D>=4, D>C, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not D
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs"      shows C>=4, C>=D, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not C
  # No four-card suit: the longest unbid suit, cheapest first.
  cheapest(C) "No four-card suit: clubs"    when x is not C, C>=D | x is D
      priority -5
  cheapest(D) "No four-card suit: diamonds" when x is not D, D>C | x is C
      priority -5
  cheapest(H) "No four-card suit: hearts"   when x is not H
      priority -6
  cheapest(S) "No four-card suit: spades"   when x is not S
      priority -7
files.rules/competitive/their-1nt-overcall.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responder after RHO overcalls partner's one-level opening with 1NT.
#
# `after-interference.bid` writes every one-level context as `after 1x (1y)`,
# and `1y` binds a suit, so nothing there fires over a notrump overcall and
# responder passed whatever he held. `1D (1N)` and `1C (1N)` were the two
# largest no-rule points in the corpus.
#
# Their 1NT is 15-18 balanced with a stopper, so partner's opening plus our
# own hand locates the rest of the deck: with 10+ total points we own the
# balance and double for penalty. Otherwise it is a competitive auction one
# level up, and the calls are natural. Nine total points is the floor for
# bidding a suit of our own: they have 15-18 and a stopper, so entering at
# the two level on less runs into their strength. BBA declares the bid as
# 7-12 but only makes it from 9 up (366 of the 406 `Opps_Overcall_1NT`
# decisions match at 9; the declared 7 matches 344).
#
# See their-1nt-overcall.notes.md for the BBA meanings this is built from.

module their-1nt-overcall "Responder over their 1NT overcall"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  skill  competitive_bidding/notrump_overcalls

after 1x (1N)
  X   "Penalty: 10+ total points, no long suit of our own"
      shows hcp+length_points>=10
      when  (S<=4 | x is S), (H<=4 | x is H)
      when  C<=5, D<=5
      priority 1

  2{x} "Raise: 6-9 total points, support for partner's suit"
      shows x>=3, tp(x)>=6, tp(x)<=9
      when  x is H | x is S | x>=5
      priority 1                      # a fit first, even holding a suit of our own

  2H  "9+ total points, five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
      when  x is not H

  2S  "9+ total points, five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
      when  x is not S

  2C  "9+ total points, six or more clubs"
      shows C>=6, hcp+length_points>=9
      when  x is not C

  2D  "9+ total points, six or more diamonds"
      shows D>=6, hcp+length_points>=9
      when  x is not D

  # Seven cards and too little to bid them at the two level and be
  # raised: jump instead and take the room away. At nine total points
  # both this and the 2-level bid fit, and the seven-card suit says more.
  3C  "Preemptive: seven or more clubs, 5-9 total points"
      shows C>=7, hcp+length_points>=5, hcp+length_points<=9
      when  x is not C
  3D  "Preemptive: seven or more diamonds, 5-9 total points"
      shows D>=7, hcp+length_points>=5, hcp+length_points<=9
      when  x is not D

  # No preemptive jump raise: BBA's 4M over their 1NT is a shapely 11
  # count, not a weak five-card raise, and jumping to game on a raise
  # this side of their 15-18 loses contracts.

  P   "No suitable bid"  priority -10

# Opener after partner's penalty double of their 1NT (2026-09-27, ticket
# b160: no rule). With 10+ opposite and an opening here, the double is
# theirs to escape: sit, and pull only a minimum with a six-card suit and
# a singleton, where 1NT doubled may make on our missing entries. When
# advancer runs, partner doubled and acts next: pass.
after 1x (1N) X (P)
  2{x} "Pulls: six or more {x}, a minimum with a singleton or void"
       shows x>=6, hcp<=13, shortest<=1
  P    "Leaves the double in"
       priority -5
after 1x (1N) X (*) when !rho.last=P
  P    "No further bid"
       priority -5

# Opener after partner's preemptive jump over their 1NT (2026-09-27,
# ticket b326: 1H 1NT 3D P 3H with a singleton diamond). Partner has
# seven cards and 5-9: that is the trump suit. Pass, and bid game in it
# only with 19+ and support. (BBA plays 3D here as 13-14 and forcing,
# so it never passes: probes/pull-preempt-1H-1N-3D.toml.)
after 1x (1N) 3z (P) when z is C | z is D, z is not x
  5{z} "Game in partner's suit: 19+ and support"   shows z>=2, hcp>=19
       priority 3
  P    "No game"
       priority 2
files.rules/competitive/total-tricks.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# The Law of Total Tricks (Rick, 2026-09-27; Basic_Takeout_Double 193).
# When both sides are bidding and the hand is not clearly ours, compete
# to the level where the tricks needed equal our trumps: eight trumps,
# the two level; nine, three; ten, four. No higher.
#
# Our trumps are my length plus what partner has shown. A takeout double
# of a major counts as four in the unbid suits once it is known to be the
# shape double (the power branch collapses when the deck or the auction
# rules out 17 HCP): BBA's doubler holds four of the other major 68% of
# the time and four of a minor 73% (probes/tools/takeout_shape.py).
# Elsewhere partner counts for what he has shown.
#
# At unfavourable vulnerability we hedge a trick: one level lower.
#
# Three rules, one per level: the doubler's bonus and the hedge are terms
# in the count (a condition counts 1 when it holds). Until 2026-09-30 the
# file spelled each combination out, twelve rules (docs/JUDGMENT-LAYER.md,
# Phase 0).
#
# A fallback: below every rule that describes a hand, above the passes
# that only say "nothing more to say".

module total-tricks "The Law of Total Tricks"
  kind   judgement
  needs  base
  skill  competitive_bidding/law_of_total_tricks

# Partner's three cards in x count as four when his takeout double of
# their major is known to be the shape double.
define doubler_four(x) = ((lho.H>=5 | rho.H>=5), partner.S>=3, partner.D>=3, partner.C>=3) | ((lho.S>=5 | rho.S>=5), partner.H>=3, partner.D>=3, partner.C>=3), partner.x.min = 3

# Raises of opener's minor in competition count the trumps the same way.
# One of a minor promises three (the engine reads 1♣ as 1+, so the test is
# what partner opened): a raise needs five for eight trumps, a preemptive
# jump six for nine. BBA on bare SAYC raises 1m over an overcall with five
# and jumps with six, not five; counting opener's minor as four (raising
# with four) lost 158 IMPs over 1♣ (2026-10-02). A major opening is raised
# with three as before (in third seat it may be four cards).
define opened_minor(x)  = (x is C | x is D), partner.opened, partner.x.min <= 3
define minor_raise(x)   = !opened_minor(x) | x >= 5
define minor_preempt(x) = !opened_minor(x) | x >= 6

# Advancer's weak jump raise of a one-level overcall: the overcall is
# often a bare five, and a weak hand has no defence to spare, so it jumps
# with five trumps, or four at favourable. BBA on bare SAYC raises to two
# with four and 5-9 HCP (169 hands where we jumped) and jumps mostly with
# five or at favourable (2026-10-02).
define weak_jump_raise(y) = y >= 5 | favourable

# Our trumps as the Law counts them, a trick fewer at unfavourable.
define lott_trumps(x) = we.fit(x).min + doubler_four(x) - unfavourable

# They are competing: the last bid or double at the table is theirs, made
# over our side's last bid (RHO's call, or LHO's when partner and RHO have
# both passed since). A lone overcall or opening that we have bid over,
# and that neither of them has backed, is not competition (2026-10-02).
define they_compete = !rho.last=P | (partner.last=P, !lho.last=P)

when they.bid, they.still_bidding, !game_reached   # not once we have bid game (ticket b100)
  2x  "Competes: to play"
      shows lott_trumps(x) = 8
      when  doubler_four(x) | !doubler_four(x)       # known either way: not while the double may be the strong one
      when  partner.x>=3, hcp>=5, we.hcp.min <= 24   # not clearly our hand
      when  they_compete                             # the weak raise to two only against a bid (2026-10-02)
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -4
  3x  "Competes: to play"
      shows lott_trumps(x) = 9
      when  doubler_four(x) | !doubler_four(x)
      when  partner.x>=3, hcp>=5, we.hcp.min <= 24
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -4
  4x  "Competes: to play"
      shows lott_trumps(x) >= 10
      when  doubler_four(x) | !doubler_four(x)
      when  partner.x>=3, hcp>=5, we.hcp.min <= 24
      sets  ask=signoff
      priority -4
files.rules/competitive/transfers-after-double:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Transfer responses after their takeout double of our major
# (`vs_to_double.new_suit_forcing_tfr`; convention-card
# bidding_conventions/transfers_after_double; Robert S. Todd, "1-Major
# (X) Transfers", Adventures in Bridge 598; PBS btn/Transfers_after_1M_X.btn,
# after the ACBL Bulletin, June 2025, p. 66). Over 1M (X), from 1NT up
# to the suit below opener's major, each bid transfers to the next suit:
#
#   over 1♥: 1♠ natural (as before), 1NT clubs, 2♣ diamonds, 2♦ hearts
#   over 1♠: 1NT clubs, 2♣ diamonds, 2♦ hearts, 2♥ spades
#
# - a transfer to a new suit: five or more cards (six when weak), fewer
#   than three of opener's major, a weak two or better;
# - the transfer to opener's major: a constructive raise, three trumps,
#   8-10; the direct raise to 2M is 4-7 with three;
# - the jump to three of the suit below the major (1♥-3♦, 1♠-3♥): four
#   trumps, 8-10; 3M stays preemptive (vs-takeout-double.bid);
# - 2NT: a fit (three or more) and 11+ (Jordan 2NT, extended to three
#   trumps);
# - the redouble: 10+ without three trumps.
#
# Opener completes the transfer (with the raise: 2M on a minimum, 3M
# with 15-16, game with 17+); responder then passes when weak, raises
# his suit to invite, or bids 3NT with game values. Notes:
# transfers-after-double.notes.md. Only after a major: transfers over
# 1m (X) (Todd 599) are not written.

module transfers-after-double "Transfer responses after their takeout double"
  kind   convention
  needs  base
  needs  after-interference
  needs  vs-takeout-double
  skill  bidding_conventions/transfers_after_double
  card   bidding_conventions/transfers_after_double

after 1M (X)
  XX  "Redouble: 10+, fewer than three {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp+length_points>=10, M<=2
      priority 2
  2N  "A fit and 11+: three or more {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=3, tp(M)>=11
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      priority 3
  1N  "Transfer to clubs: five or more, a weak two or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, C>=D, M<=2, hcp>=5, hcp>=8 | C>=6, S<=4 | M is S, H<=4
      priority 2
  2C  "Transfer to diamonds: five or more, a weak two or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, D>C, M<=2, hcp>=5, hcp>=8 | D>=6, S<=4 | M is S, H<=4
      priority 2
  2D  "Transfer to hearts: a constructive raise, three hearts, 8-10"
      alert  artificial
      shows H=3, tp(H)>=8, tp(H)<=10
      when  M is H
      priority 2
  2D  "Transfer to hearts: five or more, a weak two or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S<=2, hcp>=5, hcp>=8 | H>=6
      when  M is S
      priority 2
  2H  "Transfer to spades: a constructive raise, three spades, 8-10"
      alert  artificial
      shows S=3, tp(S)>=8, tp(S)<=10
      when  M is S
      priority 2
  2{M} "Raise: three {M}, 4-7"
      shows M=3, tp(M)>=4, tp(M)<=7
      priority 2
  3D  "Four hearts, 8-10"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=4, tp(H)>=8, tp(H)<=10
      when  M is H
      priority 3
  3H  "Four spades, 8-10"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=4, tp(S)>=8, tp(S)<=10
      when  M is S
      priority 3

# Opener completes; over the constructive raise he values his hand.
after 1H (X) 2D (P)
  4H  "Game: 17+"   shows tp(H)>=17
      priority 1
  3H  "Invites game: 15-16"                        shows tp(H)>=15, tp(H)<=16
      priority 1
  2H  "Minimum: completes the transfer"
after 1S (X) 2H (P)
  4S  "Game: 17+"   shows tp(S)>=17
      priority 1
  3S  "Invites game: 15-16"                        shows tp(S)>=15, tp(S)<=16
      priority 1
  2S  "Minimum: completes the transfer"
after 1M (X) 1N (P)
  2C  "Completes the transfer"                      artificial
after 1M (X) 2C (P)
  2D  "Completes the transfer"                      artificial
after 1S (X) 2D (P)
  2H  "Completes the transfer"                      artificial
after 1H (X) 3D (P)
  4H  "Game: 15+"     shows tp(H)>=15
  3H  "Minimum"                                    priority -1
after 1S (X) 3H (P)
  4S  "Game: 15+"     shows tp(S)>=15
  3S  "Minimum"                                    priority -1

# Responder after the completion of a transfer to a new suit: pass when
# weak, three of his suit to invite, 3NT with game values.
after 1M (X) 1N (P) 2C (P)
  P   "Weak: to play"                               shows hcp<=9
  3C  "Invites: 10-12, six or more clubs"           shows C>=6, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  3N  "Game values: 13+"                            shows hcp>=13
  P   "No further bid"                                priority -5
after 1M (X) 2C (P) 2D (P)
  P   "Weak: to play"                               shows hcp<=9
  3D  "Invites: 10-12, six or more diamonds"        shows D>=6, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  3N  "Game values: 13+"                            shows hcp>=13
  P   "No further bid"                                priority -5
after 1S (X) 2D (P) 2H (P)
  P   "Weak: to play"                               shows hcp<=9
  3H  "Invites: 10-12, six or more hearts"          shows H>=6, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  4H  "Game: six or more hearts, 13+"               shows H>=6, hcp>=13
  3N  "Game values: 13+, five hearts"               shows hcp>=13
  P   "No further bid"                                priority -5
files.rules/competitive/two-suited-overcalls.b:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Michaels cue bids and the Unusual 2NT: two-suited overcalls of a
# one-level suit opening on our right (Rick, 2026-09-28).
#
# - Michaels: (1m) 2m shows five-five or longer in the majors; (1M) 2M
#   five of the other major and five of a minor. Played where the card
#   says so: Bridge-Classroom's direct cue bid matrix
#   (`direct_cuebids.nat_minors_michaels`, `quasi_michaels`,
#   `nat_majors_michaels`) or its catalog switch
#   (`competitive.michaels.play`, both kinds). BBA's key maps onto the
#   matrix.
# - The Unusual 2NT: the jump to 2NT shows the two lowest unbid suits,
#   five-five: over a major the minors, over 1♣ diamonds and hearts, over
#   1♦ clubs and hearts (`competitive.unusual_2nt.play`, or
#   Bridge-Classroom's `nt_overcalls.jump_2nt_lowest_unbid`); once both
#   opponents have bid, 2NT shows the two suits they have not bid.
# - Strength (`competitive.michaels.strength`): wide_range, as BBA plays
#   it (probes/michaels-*.toml: from about 7 HCP with five-five at
#   favourable or equal vulnerability, from about 11 vulnerable (we: 9),
#   up to 17 HCP; stronger hands double first), or weak_or_strong (mini-maxi):
#   weak, or 16+ and bids again; an intermediate hand overcalls in its
#   higher suit. The Unusual 2NT is always wide range (BBA: 9+ total
#   points at any vulnerability, no upper limit).
#
# The same rules read the opponents' two-suiters with their card, and
# the last part of the file is the opening side's answer to them. Those
# contexts test what the overcall showed (`rho.S>=5`), not our card: our
# card cannot say what their cue bid means.
#
# Also, each on its card switch (notes, "Two-suiters over preempts and
# at the four level"):
# - the Unusual 1NT (`competitive.unusual_1nt.play`): by a passed hand,
#   the two lowest unbid suits over their opening, the two unbid suits
#   once they have bid two (the sandwich seat);
# - the Unusual 4NT (`competitive.unusual_4nt.play`): a jump to 4NT over
#   their opening, or over their raise, shows the two lowest unbid
#   suits, six-five or a strong five-five; over a preempt also in the
#   balancing seat and over their raise of it;
# - Michaels over their preempt, as BBA plays it with Michaels on: the
#   cue bid of a weak two (direct or balancing) or of a three-level
#   preempt;
# - Leaping Michaels (`competitive.leaping_michaels.play`) over a weak
#   two and Non-Leaping Michaels (`competitive.non_leaping_michaels.play`)
#   over a three-level preempt: four of a minor shows that minor and a
#   major (Neil Rosen, English Bridge, August 2013);
# - direct jump cue bids (`competitive.direct_jump_cuebid_major`,
#   `_minor`): gambling or strong (a solid suit, asking for a stopper),
#   majors (five-five, preemptive), preempt (seven of their minor).
#
# Advancer: preference at the cheapest level, a jump preference to
# invite (10-12), game in the fit (or a preemptive game with four-card
# support), the cue bid of their suit with 16+ (game or slam interest,
# forcing; after a major-suit Michaels a raise of partner's major), 2NT
# asking for the minor after a major-suit Michaels (whenever advancer
# wants to play in it), three of a minor natural (his own six-card
# suit), and 3NT with their suit held and no fit. That is
# `competitive.michaels.minor_advance = ask_2nt` (the default); with
# `pass_or_correct` (Larry Cohen) 3♣ is pass or correct to partner's
# minor (up to 9 HCP) and 2NT the ask with 10+. Notes:
# two-suited-overcalls.notes.md.

module two-suited-overcalls "Michaels cue bids and the Unusual 2NT"
  kind   convention
  needs  base
  needs  overcalls
  skill  competitive_bidding/unusual_vs_unusual
  skill  competitive_bidding/leaping_michaels
  skill  competitive_bidding/non_leaping_michaels
  param  mich_play   = competitive_bidding/michaels default false
  param  mich_minors = competitive_bidding/michaels:over_minor default false
  param  mich_quasi  = competitive_bidding/michaels:over_short_minor default false
  param  mich_majors = competitive_bidding/michaels:over_major default false
  param  strength    = competitive_bidding/michaels:strength default wide_range
  param  mich_adv    = competitive_bidding/michaels:minor_advance default ask_2nt
  param  u2n_play    = competitive_bidding/unusual_notrump:at_2nt default false
  param  u2n_jump    = competitive_bidding/unusual_notrump:at_2nt default false
  param  uvu         = competitive_bidding/unusual_vs_unusual default false
  param  u1n_play    = competitive_bidding/unusual_notrump:at_1nt default false
  param  u4n_play    = competitive_bidding/unusual_notrump:at_4nt default false
  param  leaping     = competitive_bidding/leaping_michaels default false
  param  nlm         = competitive_bidding/non_leaping_michaels default false
  param  djc_major   = competitive.direct_jump_cuebid_major
  param  djc_minor   = competitive.direct_jump_cuebid_minor
  param  ghestem     = competitive_bidding/ghestem default false
  param  sandwich    = competitive_bidding/sandwich_nt default false

# ── Michaels over a minor: both majors ───────────────────────────────
# Wide range (BBA, probes/michaels-1C.toml and -1D): not vulnerable from
# 9 total points with our count (7 HCP five-five), vulnerable from 11
# (9 HCP five-five). BBA waits for about 11 HCP vulnerable; 11 rather
# than 13 gained on both yardsticks (+93 IMPs par distance, +231 to the
# overcalling side; notes). Up to 17 HCP: with more, the power double
# (takeout-double.bid).
# Ghestem (ghestem.bid) replaces the one-level cue bids; its 2NT is this
# file's Unusual 2NT.
# The Michaels box alone is Michaels over every opening. A card that also
# says where (over a major, over a minor) plays it only there.
define mich_all = mich_play, !(mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_majors)

after (1m) when mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_all, !ghestem
  2{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, !vul
  2{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, vul
  2{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, !vul
  2{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, vul
  2{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp>=16
      when  strength is weak_or_strong

# ── Michaels over a major: the other major and a minor ───────────────
after (1H) when mich_majors | mich_all, !ghestem
  2H  "Michaels: five or more spades and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, !vul
  2H  "Michaels: five or more spades and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, vul
  2H  "Michaels: spades and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, !vul
  2H  "Michaels: spades and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, vul
  2H  "Michaels: spades and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp>=16
      when  strength is weak_or_strong

after (1S) when mich_majors | mich_all, !ghestem
  2S  "Michaels: five or more hearts and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, !vul
  2S  "Michaels: five or more hearts and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  strength is wide_range, vul
  2S  "Michaels: hearts and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, !vul
  2S  "Michaels: hearts and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=11
      when  strength is weak_or_strong, vul
  2S  "Michaels: hearts and a minor, five-five, weak or 16+"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp>=16
      when  strength is weak_or_strong

# ── The Unusual 2NT: the two lowest unbid suits ──────────────────────
# BBA (probes/unusual-2n-*.toml): 9+ total points at every
# vulnerability, and no upper limit (it bids 2NT on 19 HCP too).
after (1H) | (1S) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more in each minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
after (1C) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more diamonds and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
after (1D) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more clubs and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=9

# ── Over their raise: (1m) P (2m) 3m, (1x) P (2x) 2NT ───────────────
# The same two-suiters once responder has raised (2026-10-20, Brill
# daily board 4: 1C P 2C, AKQJ85.QT8732.5.- passed; the field's 3C
# was the cue for the majors). Standard practice, not yet cited: the cue
# of their raised minor shows both majors, 2NT the two lowest unbid
# suits, with the wide-range values of the direct cue bid at either
# card strength (weak_or_strong has no strong rebid this high). The cue
# of a raised major (the other major and a minor) is not written.
after (1m) P (2m) when mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_all, !ghestem
  3{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=17
      when  !vul
  3{m} "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  vul
after (1M) P (2M) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more in each minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
after (1C) P (2C) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more diamonds and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=9
after (1D) P (2D) when u2n_play | u2n_jump | ghestem
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more clubs and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=9

# Advancer: the longer major at the three level (spades with equal
# length); game with four-card support (preemptive) or three and 10+;
# 3NT with their minor held and no major fit. When RHO bids, a
# preference only with three cards, else pass.
after (1m) P (2m) 3m (P) | (1m) P (2m) 3m (X) when partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  3H  "Preference: more hearts than spades"
      shows H>S
      priority -1
  3S  "Preference: spades, at least as many as hearts"
      shows S>=H
      priority -1
  4H  "Game in hearts: four-card support, or three and 10+"
      shows H>S, H>=4 | (H>=3, hcp>=10)
  4S  "Game in spades: four-card support, or three and 10+"
      shows S>=H, S>=4 | (S>=3, hcp>=10)
  3N  "To play: 13+, {m} held, no major fit"
      shows hcp>=13, H<=2, S<=2, stop(m)
after (1m) P (2m) 3m (*) when partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5, !rho.last=P, !rho.last=X
  cheapest(H) "Competes: three or more hearts, more than spades"
      shows H>=3, H>S
      priority -2
  cheapest(S) "Competes: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3, S>=H
      priority -2
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10
