# The cue bidder: a minimum passes the preference; 16+ or a playing
# hand (four losers or fewer: six-six, six-five) bids the game.
after (1m) P (2m) 3m (*) 3y (*) when y is H | y is S
  P    "Minimum: no further bid"                  priority -5
  4{y} "Game: 16+ or four losers or fewer"            shows hcp>=16 | losers<=4

# After the Unusual 2NT over their raise: the preference at the three
# level (the higher with equal length, as after the direct 2NT), game in
# hearts with four, or three and 10+; five of a minor with four-card
# support and 12+.
after (1M) P (2M) 2N (P) | (1M) P (2M) 2N (X) when partner.C>=5, partner.D>=5
  3C  "Preference: more clubs than diamonds"   shows C>D
      priority -1
  3D  "Preference: diamonds, at least as many as clubs"   shows D>=C
      priority -1
  5C  "Game in clubs: 12+ with four-card support"   shows C>=4, C>D, hcp>=12
  5D  "Game in diamonds: 12+ with four-card support"   shows D>=4, D>=C, hcp>=12
after (1C) P (2C) 2N (P) | (1C) P (2C) 2N (X) when partner.D>=5, partner.H>=5
  3D  "Preference: more diamonds than hearts"   shows D>H
      priority -1
  3H  "Preference: hearts, at least as many as diamonds"   shows H>=D
      priority -1
  4H  "Game in hearts: four-card support, or three and 10+"
      shows H>=D, H>=4 | (H>=3, hcp>=10)
after (1D) P (2D) 2N (P) | (1D) P (2D) 2N (X) when partner.C>=5, partner.H>=5
  3C  "Preference: more clubs than hearts"   shows C>H
      priority -1
  3H  "Preference: hearts, at least as many as clubs"   shows H>=C
      priority -1
  4H  "Game in hearts: four-card support, or three and 10+"
      shows H>=C, H>=4 | (H>=3, hcp>=10)
after (1x) P (2x) 2N (*) when partner.longest>=5, partner.second_longest>=5, !rho.last=P, !rho.last=X
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10
# The 2NT bidder: a minimum passes; 16+ or four losers bids game in
# hearts.
after (1x) P (2x) 2N (*) 3y (*) when y is not x
  P    "Minimum: no further bid"                  priority -5
  4{y} "Game in hearts: 16+ or four losers or fewer"  shows hcp>=16 | losers<=4
      when  y is H

# ── After opener and responder have both bid: (1x) P (1y) 2NT ────────
# 2026-10-30, from Brill's convention files (Rusty had no rule: 1H P 1NT
# 2NT, 1C P 1H 2NT, 1C P 1D 2NT, ...). Bridge Bum ("Unusual 2NT"): the
# Unusual 2NT "is also in effect if both opponents have bid up to 2♠",
# showing the two unbid suits (1H 2D 2NT: clubs and spades), and after
# their two-over-one it promises extra length or strength. So 2NT, jump
# or not, shows the two suits they have not bid: over 1H P 1S the
# minors, over 1C P 1D the majors, over 1C P 1H diamonds and spades,
# over 1H P 2C diamonds and spades. After a 1NT response only one suit
# is bid: the two lowest unbid, as over the opening (Wikipedia, "Unusual
# notrump": the two lowest unbid suits). Five-five, 12+ total points
# after a new suit (responder is unlimited), 11+ after 1NT, which limits
# him: two more than first written (10 and 9, by analogy with the direct
# 2NT), measured on the whole corpus 2026-10-31 (notes). A jump shift by
# responder (strong) is not covered. Above the takeout double with 15+
# (overcalls.bid, priority 1): the five-five shape is the more exact
# description. With the Sandwich 1NT on (sandwich-nt.bid, five-four or
# five-five, 8-15) the one-level sandwich seat is that module's, and
# 2NT is not bid there; so for a passed hand with the Unusual 1NT on
# (GIB_Sandwich_NT_BPH: 2NT took 30 of its 1NT boards).
# Balancing after their raise, (1x) P (2x) P (P) 2NT, is the same
# two-suiter as the direct 2NT over the raise (standard practice, not
# yet cited: notes).
after (1x) P (1y) when u2n_play | u2n_jump, y is not x, !sandwich, !passed_hand | !u1n_play
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five-five in the two suits they have not bid"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5 | x is C | y is C, D>=5 | x is D | y is D
      shows H>=5 | x is H | y is H, S>=5 | x is S | y is S
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      priority 2
after (1x) P (2y) when u2n_play | u2n_jump, y is not x, !rho.jumped
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five-five in the two suits they have not bid"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5 | x is C | y is C, D>=5 | x is D | y is D
      shows H>=5 | x is H | y is H, S>=5 | x is S | y is S
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      priority 2
after (1x) P (1N) | (1x) P (2x) P (P) when u2n_play | u2n_jump, x is not N
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more in each minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is H | x is S
      priority 2
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more diamonds and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is C
      priority 2
  2N  "Unusual 2NT: five or more clubs and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, H>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is D
      priority 2

# Advancer: the longer of partner's two suits at the cheapest level
# (the lower with equal length), game in a major with four-card support
# and 10+ HCP, five of a minor with four and 13+. When RHO bids, the
# cheapest preference with four-card support, else pass.
define auction u2n_two_bid = (1x) P (1y) 2N (*) | (1x) P (2y) 2N (*)   when y is not x
  (1x) P (1N) 2N (*) | (1x) P (2x) P (P) 2N (*)

after u2n_two_bid when u2n_play | u2n_jump, partner.longest>=5, partner.second_longest>=5, rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  cheapest(C) "Preference: clubs"
      prefer C + 0
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(D) "Preference: diamonds"
      prefer D + 0
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2
  4H  "Game in hearts: four-card support, 10+"   shows H>=4, hcp>=10   when partner.H>=5   priority 3
  4S  "Game in spades: four-card support, 10+"   shows S>=4, hcp>=10   when partner.S>=5   priority 3
  5C  "Game in clubs: four-card support, 13+"    shows C>=4, hcp>=13   when partner.C>=5, partner.H<=4, partner.S<=4   priority 3
  5D  "Game in diamonds: four-card support, 13+" shows D>=4, hcp>=13   when partner.D>=5, partner.H<=4, partner.S<=4   priority 3
after u2n_two_bid when u2n_play | u2n_jump, partner.longest>=5, partner.second_longest>=5, !rho.last=P, !rho.last=X
  cheapest(C) "Competes: four or more clubs"     shows C>=4   when partner.C>=5   priority -2
  cheapest(D) "Competes: four or more diamonds"  shows D>=4   when partner.D>=5   priority -2
  cheapest(H) "Competes: four or more hearts"    shows H>=4   when partner.H>=5   priority -2
  cheapest(S) "Competes: four or more spades"    shows S>=4   when partner.S>=5   priority -2
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10
# The 2NT bidder after a three-level preference: a minimum passes; 16+
# or four losers bids game in a major.
after u2n_two_bid 3z (*) when u2n_play | u2n_jump, shown.z>=5
  P    "Minimum: no further bid"                    priority -5
  4{z} "Game: 16+ or four losers or fewer"          shows hcp>=16 | losers<=4
      when  z is H | z is S

# ── Advancer after Michaels over a minor ─────────────────────────────
# Partner has both majors. BBA never passes the cue (probes/
# michaels-adv-1C.toml). With equal length it prefers spades, as BBA
# does. The simple preference promises nothing: it is the fallback for
# every hand that has no better call.
after (1m) 2m (P) | (1m) 2m (X) when partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  2H  "Preference: more hearts than spades"
      shows H>S
      priority -1
  2S  "Preference: spades, at least as many as hearts"
      shows S>=H
      priority -1
  3H  "Jump preference: invitational, 10-12 with three hearts"
      shows H>S, H>=3, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  3S  "Jump preference: invitational, 10-12 with three spades"
      shows S>=H, S>=3, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  4H  "Game in hearts: weak with four, or 13-15"
      shows H>S
      shows (H>=4, hcp<=9) | (H>=3, hcp>=13, hcp<=15)
  4S  "Game in spades: weak with four, or 13-15"
      shows S>=H
      shows (S>=4, hcp<=9) | (S>=3, hcp>=13, hcp<=15)
  3{m} "Cue bid: 16+, game or slam interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=16
      sets  forcing=round
  3N  "To play: 13+, their suit held, no major fit"
      shows hcp>=13, H<=2, S<=2, stop(m)
  2D  "Natural: six or more diamonds, no major fit"
      shows D>=6, H<=2, S<=2, hcp<=12
      when  m is C

# RHO has bid: preference only with a fit worth competing with.
after (1m) 2m (*) when partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  cheapest(H) "Competes: three or more hearts, more than spades"
      shows H>=3, H>S, hcp<=12
      priority -2
  cheapest(S) "Competes: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3, S>=H, hcp<=12
      priority -2
  4H  "Game in hearts over their bid"
      shows H>=4, H>S
      priority -3
  4S  "Game in spades over their bid"
      shows S>=4, S>=H
      priority -3
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10

# ── Advancer after Michaels over a major ─────────────────────────────
# Partner has the other major and an unknown minor (Rick, 2026-10-13:
# "If partner wants to play in the cue bidder's minor, they bid 2NT to
# ask 'which minor'. Normally bidding the minor says 'I have a 6+ card
# suit of my own'."):
# - 2NT asks for the minor, at any strength, with a doubleton or less in
#   partner's major: a weak hand passes the answer, a better one invites
#   or bids the game after it (BBA: "to the partner's longer",
#   probes/michaels-adv-1H.toml).
# - Three of a minor is natural: six or more of my own, no fit for
#   partner's major, to play.
# - The cue bid is the strong raise of partner's major: three-card
#   support, 16+ over 1♥ (game or slam interest), 12+ over 1♠ (game
#   interest; there is no invitational jump to 3♥).
# - 3NT direct: 13+ with their suit held and no fit for partner's major
#   nor for both minors (with three of each, 2NT finds the minor first).
# - pass_or_correct (`competitive.michaels.minor_advance`; Larry Cohen,
#   "Michaels Cue Bid"): 3♣ is pass or correct, up to 9 HCP; 2NT asks
#   with 10+; 3♦ stays natural; there is no natural 3♣.
after (1H) 2H (P) | (1H) 2H (X) when partner.S>=5
  2S  "Preference: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3
      priority -1
  2N  "Asks for your minor, to play: at most two spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows S<=2
      sets  forcing=round
      when  mich_adv is ask_2nt
      priority -1
  3C  "Natural: six or more clubs, to play"
      shows C>=6, S<=2, hcp<=12
      when  mich_adv is ask_2nt
  2N  "Asks for your minor: 10+, at most two spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows S<=2, hcp>=10
      sets  forcing=round
      when  mich_adv is pass_or_correct
      priority -1
  3C  "Pass or correct: your minor, up to 9"
      alert  artificial
      shows S<=2, hcp<=9
      when  mich_adv is pass_or_correct
      priority -1
  3D  "Natural: six or more diamonds, to play"
      shows D>=6, S<=2, hcp<=12
  3S  "Jump preference: invitational, 10-12 with three spades"
      shows S>=3, hcp>=10, hcp<=12
  4S  "Game in spades: weak with four, or 13-15"
      shows (S>=4, hcp<=9) | (S>=3, hcp>=13, hcp<=15)
  3H  "Cue bid: a strong spade raise, 16+, game or slam interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=3, hcp>=16
      sets  forcing=round
  3N  "To play: 13+, hearts held, no spade fit"
      shows hcp>=13, S<=2, stop(H)
      when  C<=2 | D<=2

# Over 1S (2S) partner's hearts can only be shown at the three level, so
# there is no invitational jump: 3H is any preference, and the cue bid
# is the raise with 12+ (game interest).
after (1S) 2S (P) | (1S) 2S (X) when partner.H>=5
  3H  "Preference: three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3
      priority -1
  2N  "Asks for your minor, to play: at most two hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows H<=2
      sets  forcing=round
      when  mich_adv is ask_2nt
      priority -1
  3C  "Natural: six or more clubs, to play"
      shows C>=6, H<=2, hcp<=12
      when  mich_adv is ask_2nt
  2N  "Asks for your minor: 10+, at most two hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows H<=2, hcp>=10
      sets  forcing=round
      when  mich_adv is pass_or_correct
      priority -1
  3C  "Pass or correct: your minor, up to 9"
      alert  artificial
      shows H<=2, hcp<=9
      when  mich_adv is pass_or_correct
      priority -1
  3D  "Natural: six or more diamonds, to play"
      shows D>=6, H<=2, hcp<=12
  4H  "Game in hearts: weak with four, or 13-15"
      shows (H>=4, hcp<=9) | (H>=3, hcp>=13, hcp<=15)
  3S  "Cue bid: a heart raise, 12+, game interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=3, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
  3N  "To play: 13+, spades held, no heart fit"
      shows hcp>=13, H<=2, stop(S)
      when  C<=2 | D<=2

after (1M) 2M (*) when partner.S>=5 | partner.H>=5
  cheapest(S) "Competes: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3, hcp<=12
      when  M is H
      priority -2
  cheapest(H) "Competes: three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3, hcp<=12
      when  M is S
      priority -2
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10

# The Michaels bidder passes advancer's own suit (with pass_or_correct
# only 3♦ is advancer's own).
after (1M) 2M (*) 3m (*) when mich_adv is ask_2nt | m is D
  P   "Partner's own suit: to play"  priority -1

# pass_or_correct (Larry Cohen, "Michaels Cue Bid"): 3♣ asks the
# Michaels bidder to pass with clubs and correct to 3♦ with diamonds.
# Over a double the same; when RHO bids, the force is off as over the
# 2NT ask: the minor at the four level with 13+ or a six-card minor.
after (1M) 2M (*) 3C (P) | (1M) 2M (*) 3C (X) when mich_adv is pass_or_correct
  P   "My minor is clubs: to play"   shows C>=5, C>=D
  3D  "My minor is diamonds"         shows D>=5, D>C
after (1M) 2M (*) 3C (*) when mich_adv is pass_or_correct, they.bid
  cheapest(C)  "Competes: my minor is clubs, 13+ or six"
      shows C>=5, C>=D, hcp>=13 | C>=6
  cheapest(D)  "Competes: my minor is diamonds, 13+ or six"
      shows D>=5, D>C, hcp>=13 | D>=6
  P   "A minimum over their bid"   priority -1
# Advancer chose a partscore: he passes the correction.
after (1M) 2M (*) 3C (*) 3D (*) when mich_adv is pass_or_correct
  P   "To play in partner's minor"   priority -1

# The Michaels bidder names the minor, also when they double the ask
# (2NT is no place to play: Brill round robin 2026-10-09, board
# 90000102, where a doubled cue bid was passed out). When RHO bids over
# the ask the force is off: he names the minor at the four level with
# 13+ or a six-card minor, else passes (the corpus: the free four-level
# answer with a minimum lost 23 IMPs on 14 boards).
after (1M) 2M (*) 2N (P) | (1M) 2M (*) 2N (X)
  3C  "My minor is clubs"      shows C>=5, C>=D
  3D  "My minor is diamonds"   shows D>=5, D>C
after (1M) 2M (*) 2N (*) when they.bid
  cheapest(C)  "Competes: my minor is clubs, 13+ or six"
      shows C>=5, C>=D, hcp>=13 | C>=6
  cheapest(D)  "Competes: my minor is diamonds, 13+ or six"
      shows D>=5, D>C, hcp>=13 | D>=6
  P   "A minimum over their bid"   priority -1

# Advancer places the contract in partner's minor: pass with less than
# 10 HCP, raise to four to invite (10-12 HCP), 3NT with their suit held
# or five of the minor with 13+ (12 with four trumps), and with 17+ and
# four-card support a slam try: the cue of their major. HCP, not
# support points: shortness in partner's major is no value (the corpus:
# a void in it made two 4m invitations go down). Over a bid by RHO the
# same calls compete; a pass is the weak hand's.
after (1M) 2M (*) 2N (*) 3m (*) | (1M) 2M (*) 2N (*) 4m (*)
  P    "To play in partner's minor"                        priority -1
  4{m} "Invites game in partner's minor: 10-12, three-card support"
      shows hcp>=10, hcp<=12, m>=3
      when  m<=3 | hcp<=11
  3N   "Game: 13+, {M} held"                               shows hcp>=13, stop(M)
  5{m} "Game in partner's minor: 13+, or 12 with four"
      shows (hcp>=13, m>=3) | (hcp>=12, m>=4)
      priority -1
  4{M} "Slam try in partner's minor: 17+, four-card support"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=17, m>=4
      sets  forcing=round
# The Michaels bidder answers: accepts the invitation with 14+ (or 12+
# and a sixth card in the minor); over the slam try, six with 13+, else
# five.
after (1M) 2M (*) 2N (*) 3m (*) 4m (*)
  5{m} "Accepts: 14+, or 12+ with six of the minor"   shows hcp>=14 | (hcp>=12, m>=6)
  P    "Declines: a minimum"                priority -5
after (1M) 2M (*) 2N (*) 3m (*) 4M (*)
  6{m} "Accepts the slam try: 13+"          shows hcp>=13
  5{m} "Declines: a minimum"                priority -1

# ── Advancer after the Unusual 2NT ───────────────────────────────────
# BBA (probes/unusual-2n-adv-1H.toml): the preference at the three
# level (with equal length diamonds, as BBA; Bridgebum says the cheaper),
# a jump to the four level preemptive (four-card support, up to 8), five
# of a minor to play, 3NT with both majors held, the cue bid 16+.
after (1M) 2N (P) | (1M) 2N (X) when partner.C>=5, partner.D>=5
  3C  "Preference: more clubs than diamonds"   shows C>D
      priority -1
  3D  "Preference: diamonds, at least as many as clubs"   shows D>=C
      priority -1
  4C  "Preemptive: four or more clubs, up to 8"   shows C>=4, C>D, hcp<=8
  4D  "Preemptive: four or more diamonds, up to 8"   shows D>=4, D>=C, hcp<=8
  5C  "Game in clubs: 12+ with four-card support"   shows C>=4, C>D, hcp>=12
  5D  "Game in diamonds: 12+ with four-card support"   shows D>=4, D>=C, hcp>=12
  3N  "To play: 13+, both majors held"   shows hcp>=13, stop(H), stop(S)
  3{M} "Cue bid: 16+, game or slam interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=16
      sets  forcing=round
after (1C) 2N (P) | (1C) 2N (X) when partner.D>=5, partner.H>=5
  3D  "Preference: more diamonds than hearts"   shows D>H
      priority -1
  3H  "Preference: hearts, at least as many as diamonds"   shows H>=D
      priority -1
  4D  "Preemptive: four or more diamonds, up to 8"   shows D>=4, D>H, hcp<=8
  4H  "Game in hearts: weak with four, or 12-15"
      shows H>=D
      shows (H>=4, hcp<=8) | (H>=3, hcp>=12, hcp<=15)
  3N  "To play: 13+, clubs and spades held"   shows hcp>=13, stop(C), stop(S)
  3C  "Cue bid: 16+, game or slam interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=16
      sets  forcing=round
after (1D) 2N (P) | (1D) 2N (X) when partner.C>=5, partner.H>=5
  3C  "Preference: more clubs than hearts"   shows C>H
      priority -1
  3H  "Preference: hearts, at least as many as clubs"   shows H>=C
      priority -1
  4C  "Preemptive: four or more clubs, up to 8"   shows C>=4, C>H, hcp<=8
  4H  "Game in hearts: weak with four, or 12-15"
      shows H>=C
      shows (H>=4, hcp<=8) | (H>=3, hcp>=12, hcp<=15)
  3N  "To play: 13+, diamonds and spades held"   shows hcp>=13, stop(D), stop(S)
  3D  "Cue bid: 16+, game or slam interest"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=16
      sets  forcing=round

after (1x) 2N (*) when partner.longest>=5, partner.second_longest>=5
  P   "No fit worth competing with"  priority -10

# ── The two-suiter's rebid ───────────────────────────────────────────
# Advancer's preference said nothing about strength beyond "no jump",
# so a minimum passes. The top of the range bids again: 15-16 invites,
# 17+ bids the game (with weak_or_strong the strong variety is 16+, and
# it bids again the same way).
after (1x) 2x (P) 2y (P) | (1x) 2x (P) 3y (P) when y is not x, y is H | y is S, !partner.jumped
  P    "Minimum: no further bid"       priority -5
  3{y} "Strong two-suiter: invites game"   shows hcp>=15, hcp<=16
  4{y} "Strong two-suiter: game"           shows hcp>=17
# After the jump preference (10-12): accept with 11+.
after (1x) 2x (P) 3y (P) when y is not x, y is H | y is S, partner.jumped
  4{y} "Accepts the invitation"            shows hcp>=11
  P    "Declines: a minimum"               priority -5
# After the cue bid (forcing, 16+): a minimum names its longer (or only
# known) major at the cheapest level; 13+ bids the game in it. The cue
# is artificial, so when RHO doubles it the Michaels bidder still
# describes: a pass would leave partner in their suit (Brill round robin
# 2026-10-09, board 90000102: 1S 2S X 3S X P P P, -1,700). Only when RHO
# bids over the cue is the force off.
after (1m) 2m (*) 3m (P) | (1m) 2m (*) 3m (X)
  cheapest(S) "Minimum: spades"   shows S>=H, hcp<=12
  cheapest(H) "Minimum: hearts"   shows H>S, hcp<=12
  4S  "Maximum: game in spades"   shows S>=H, hcp>=13
  4H  "Maximum: game in hearts"   shows H>S, hcp>=13

# After the cue of a major (2026-10-13: the raise of partner's major,
# three-card support) the fit is known and the minor is not. Over
# 1H (2H) 3H (16+) a minimum (up to 12) bids 3S, a maximum names the
# minor at the four level, below 4S (a slam try), or bids 4S with six.
# Over 1S (2S) 3S (12+) a minimum bids the game, 4H; a maximum names the
# minor at the four level, still below 4H.
after (1H) 2H (*) 3H (P) | (1H) 2H (*) 3H (X)
  3S  "Minimum: spades"                     shows hcp<=12
  4C  "Maximum: my minor is clubs"          shows C>=5, C>=D, hcp>=13
  4D  "Maximum: my minor is diamonds"       shows D>=5, D>C, hcp>=13
  4S  "Maximum: six or more spades"         shows S>=6, hcp>=13
      priority 1
after (1S) 2S (*) 3S (P) | (1S) 2S (*) 3S (X)
  4H  "Minimum: game in hearts"             shows hcp<=12
  4C  "Maximum: my minor is clubs"          shows C>=5, C>=D, hcp>=13
  4D  "Maximum: my minor is diamonds"       shows D>=5, D>C, hcp>=13

# The cue bidder, with the fit in partner's major, bids its game once
# partner has named the minor (slam is a gap: notes).
after (1M) 2M (*) 3M (*) 4m (P) | (1M) 2M (*) 3M (*) 4m (X)
  4H   "Game in hearts: the fit the cue bid showed"
      when  M is S
      priority 1
  4S   "Game in spades: the fit the cue bid showed"
      when  M is H
      priority 1
# After the minimum at the three level: the cue bidder (16+) bids the
# game, in the major with three or more, else 3NT with their suit held.
after (1x) 2x (*) 3x (*) 3y (*) when y is H | y is S, y is not x
  4{y} "Game: three or more {y}"   shows y>=3
  3N   "Game: {x} held, no {y} fit"                     shows stop(x)
      priority -1
  4{y} "Game in the best fit"
      priority -2

# The Unusual 2NT after a preference: a minimum passes; 17+ bids the
# game in hearts or 3NT with their suit held.
after (1x) 2N (P) 3y (P) when y is not x
  P    "Minimum: no further bid"       priority -5
  4{y} "Strong: game in hearts"            shows hcp>=17
      when  y is H
  3N   "Strong: 17+, {x} held"             shows hcp>=17, stop(x)
# After the cue bid: the cheaper of the two suits with a minimum.
after (1x) 2N (P) 3x (P)
  cheapest(C) "Minimum: clubs"      shows C>=5, C>=D, hcp<=12
      when  x is H | x is S
  cheapest(D) "Minimum: diamonds"   shows D>=5, D>C, hcp<=12
      when  x is H | x is S
  3N  "Maximum: 13+, {x} held"      shows hcp>=13, stop(x)
  cheapest(H) "Hearts"              shows H>=5
      when  x is C | x is D
      priority -1

# ── Our side, when they make a two-suited overcall ───────────────────
# Written against what their call showed, so it holds whatever card
# they play. BBA (probes/vs-michaels-1H.toml, vs-michaels-1C.toml,
# vs-unusual-2n-1H.toml; its cards play no Unusual vs Unusual): the cue
# of their known suit is a limit raise or better (10+, three-card
# support; four over a minor), the raise itself is competitive, a jump
# to game with four trumps is preemptive, a new suit is natural, 2NT
# and 3NT natural with their suit held.
#
# BBA also doubles to show a 6-9 raise (after Michaels) or values for
# penalty (after 2NT); neither double is written: opener would need
# rules for it (gap, in the notes).
after 1H (2H) when rho.S>=5
  2S  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=3, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(H)
      priority 1
  3H  "Competitive raise: 6-9, three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3, hcp+length_points>=6, hcp+length_points<=9
  4H  "Preemptive raise: four or more hearts, under 10"
      shows H>=4, hcp+length_points<=9
  2N  "11-12, spades held, no fit"   shows hcp>=11, hcp<=12, stop(S), H<=2
  3N  "13+, spades held, no fit"      shows hcp>=13, stop(S), H<=2
  3C  "Natural: five or more clubs, 12+, forcing"
      shows C>=5, H<=2, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
  3D  "Natural: five or more diamonds, 12+, forcing"
      shows D>=5, H<=2, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
  P   "Nothing to say over their Michaels"  priority -10
after 1S (2S) when rho.H>=5
  3H  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=3, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(S)
      priority 1
  3S  "Competitive raise: 6-9, three or more spades"
      shows S>=3, hcp+length_points>=6, hcp+length_points<=9
  4S  "Preemptive raise: four or more spades, under 10"
      shows S>=4, hcp+length_points<=9
  2N  "11-12, hearts held, no fit"   shows hcp>=11, hcp<=12, stop(H), S<=2
  3N  "13+, hearts held, no fit"      shows hcp>=13, stop(H), S<=2
  3C  "Natural: five or more clubs, 12+, forcing"
      shows C>=5, S<=2, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
  3D  "Natural: five or more diamonds, 12+, forcing"
      shows D>=5, S<=2, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
  P   "Nothing to say over their Michaels"  priority -10
after 1m (2m) when rho.H>=5, rho.S>=5
  2H  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in {m}"
      alert  artificial
      shows m>=4, hcp+length_points>=11
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(m)
      priority 1
  3{m} "Competitive raise: 6-9, four or more {m}"
      shows m>=4, hcp+length_points>=6, hcp+length_points<=9
  2D  "Natural: five or more diamonds, 8+"
      shows D>=5, hcp+length_points>=8
      when  m is C
  3C  "Natural: five or more clubs, 10+"
      shows C>=5, hcp+length_points>=10
      when  m is D
  2N  "11-12, both majors held"   shows hcp>=11, hcp<=12, stop(H), stop(S)
  3N  "13+, both majors held"      shows hcp>=13, stop(H), stop(S)
  P   "Nothing to say over their Michaels"  priority -10

# Over 1M (2NT). Without Unusual vs Unusual (BBA's cards): 3♣ is the
# limit raise, 3♦ a game force without a fit. With it (Bridgebum,
# "Unusual vs. Unusual"): 3♣ is a game force in the other major, 3♦ the
# limit raise.
after 1M (2N) when rho.C>=5, rho.D>=5
  3{M} "Competitive raise: 7-10, three or more {M}"
      shows M>=3, hcp+length_points>=7, hcp+length_points<=10
  4{M} "Preemptive raise: four or more {M}, under 10"
      shows M>=4, hcp+length_points<=9
  3N  "13+, both minors held, no fit"   shows hcp>=13, stop(C), stop(D), M<=2
  P   "Nothing to say over their 2NT"  priority -10
after 1M (2N) when rho.C>=5, rho.D>=5, !uvu
  3C  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=3, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      priority 1
  3D  "Cue bid: game force without a fit"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, M<=2
      sets  forcing=game
  3S  "Natural: five or more spades, 12+, forcing"
      shows S>=5, H<=2, hcp>=12
      sets  forcing=round
      when  M is H
after 1M (2N) when rho.C>=5, rho.D>=5, uvu
  3D  "Unusual vs Unusual: limit raise or better in {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=3, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      priority 1
  3C  "Unusual vs Unusual: game force with five of the other major"
      alert  artificial
      shows hcp>=13, M<=2, S>=5 | M is S, H>=5 | M is H
      sets  forcing=game
  3S  "Natural: five or more spades, 7-10"
      shows S>=5, H<=2, hcp+length_points>=7, hcp+length_points<=10
      when  M is H

# Over 1m (2NT): they have hearts and the other minor.
after 1C (2N) when rho.D>=5, rho.H>=5
  3D  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in clubs"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(C)
      priority 1
  3C  "Competitive raise: 6-9, five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, hcp+length_points>=6, hcp+length_points<=9
  3S  "Natural: five or more spades, 10+, forcing"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round
  3N  "13+, diamonds and hearts held"   shows hcp>=13, stop(D), stop(H)
  P   "Nothing to say over their 2NT"  priority -10
after 1D (2N) when rho.C>=5, rho.H>=5
  3C  "Cue bid: limit raise or better in diamonds"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=4, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(D)
      priority 1
  3D  "Competitive raise: 6-9, four or more diamonds"
      shows D>=4, hcp+length_points>=6, hcp+length_points<=9
  3S  "Natural: five or more spades, 10+, forcing"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=10
      sets  forcing=round
  3N  "13+, clubs and hearts held"   shows hcp>=13, stop(C), stop(H)
  P   "Nothing to say over their 2NT"  priority -10

# Opener after responder's competitive raise: game in a major with 17+
# support points, else let it go.
after 1m (2m) 3m (P) | 1M (2M) 3M (P) | 1M (2N) 3M (P) when they.bid
  4{M}  "Game: 17+ opposite the competitive raise"   shows tp(M)>=17
  P     "No game"          priority -5
# Opener after responder's natural notrump (11-12): 3NT with 14+.
after 1x (2x) 2N (P) when they.bid
  3N  "Accepts: 14+"                     shows hcp>=14
  P   "Minimum: no game"           priority -5

# Opener once responder has raised or bid notrump and they have bid on:
# responder described his hand, so opener passes, or doubles with 15+
# (2026-09-28: 210 no-rule
# positions in the Michaels scenarios, such as 1H (2H) 4H (4S) and
# 1S (2S) 4S (5H)).
after 1x (2x) 3x (*) | 1x (2x) 4x (*) | 1x (2N) 3x (*) | 1x (2N) 4x (*) | 1x (2x) 2N (*) | 1x (2x) 3N (*) | 1x (2N) 3N (*) when they.bid
  X   "Penalty: 15+ HCP"
      shows hcp>=15
      priority -19
  P   "No further bid"  priority -20
# Responder after opener's penalty double: leave it in.
after 1x (2x) 3x (*) X (P) | 1x (2x) 4x (*) X (P) | 1x (2N) 3x (*) X (P) | 1x (2N) 4x (*) X (P) | 1x (2x) 2N (*) X (P) | 1x (2x) 3N (*) X (P) | 1x (2N) 3N (*) X (P) when they.bid
  P   "Leaves the double in"  priority -20

# Opener answers the limit raise: game in a major with 14+ support
# points; in a minor 3NT with 14+ (their suits are shown, so no stopper
# test), five of the minor with 16+; else sign off in the suit.
when asked limit_raise(t)
  4{t} "Accepts: game in {t}"            shows tp(t)>=14
      when  t is H | t is S
  3N   "Accepts: 14+, game in notrump"   shows hcp>=14
      when  t is C | t is D
  5{t} "Accepts: 16+, game in {t}"       shows hcp>=16, t>=5
      when  t is C | t is D
      priority -1
  cheapest(t) "Minimum: signs off"
      priority -2

# ── The Unusual 1NT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A passed hand cannot hold a natural 1NT overcall, so it shows two
# suits (Wikipedia, "Unusual notrump": "an unusual 1NT overcall by a
# passed hand"). Over their opening, the two lowest unbid suits; once
# they have bid two suits, the other two (BBA's only use of it: the
# passed hand in the sandwich seat, five-four, 10 HCP). Five-four or
# better, a hand that did not open.
after (1x) when u1n_play, passed_hand
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: diamonds and hearts, five-four or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=4, H>=4, D>=5 | H>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is C
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: clubs and hearts, five-four or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, H>=4, C>=5 | H>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: both minors, five-four or better"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, D>=4, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is H | x is S
      priority 1
# BBA bids rarely: it overcalls 1S with five spades, five-five
# included, and passes most other five-four and five-five hands
# (GIB_Sandwich_NT_BPH). We bid the convention as defined (notes).
after (1x) P (1y) when u1n_play, passed_hand, y is not x
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, hearts and spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=4, S>=4, H>=5 | S>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is C, y is D
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, diamonds and spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=4, S>=4, D>=5 | S>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is C, y is H
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, diamonds and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=4, H>=4, D>=5 | H>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is C, y is S
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, clubs and spades"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, S>=4, C>=5 | S>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is D, y is H
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, clubs and hearts"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, H>=4, C>=5 | H>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is D, y is S
      priority 1
  1N  "Unusual 1NT: the two unbid suits, both minors"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=4, D>=4, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp>=6
      when  x is H, y is S
      priority 1

# Advancer: the longer of partner's two suits at the cheapest level (with
# equal length the lower), a jump with four-card support and 11+ to
# invite. Above the systems-on notrump responses (overcalls.bid), which
# read a natural 1NT.
after (1x) 1N (P) | (1x) 1N (X) | (1x) P (1y) 1N (P) | (1x) P (1y) 1N (X) when u1n_play | sandwich
  cheapest(C) "Preference: clubs"
      prefer C + 0
      when  partner.C>=4
      priority 2
  cheapest(D) "Preference: diamonds"
      prefer D + 0
      when  partner.D>=4
      priority 2
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=4
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=4
      priority 2
  jump(C) "Invitational: four or more clubs, 11+"      shows C>=4, hcp>=11   when partner.C>=4   priority 2
  jump(D) "Invitational: four or more diamonds, 11+"   shows D>=4, hcp>=11   when partner.D>=4   priority 2
  jump(H) "Invitational: four or more hearts, 11+"     shows H>=4, hcp>=11   when partner.H>=4   priority 2
  jump(S) "Invitational: four or more spades, 11+"     shows S>=4, hcp>=11   when partner.S>=4   priority 2

# ── The Unusual 4NT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A jump to 4NT over their opening, or over their raise, shows the two
# lowest unbid suits (Wikipedia, "Unusual notrump"; BBA bids it with
# six-five or six-six from 7 HCP over a one-level opening, and with
# strong five-five or better over a weak two). Over a one-level opening
# or their raise: six-six or seven-five (the Unusual 2NT, which has no
# upper limit, takes the six-five hands, as BBA bids them). Over
# a preempt: five-five with four losers at most (five over four of a
# major, where it is also a two-suited takeout).
after (1x) | (1x) P (2x) | (1x) P (3x) | (1x) P (4x) when u4n_play
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: both minors, six-six or seven-five"
      alert  artificial
      shows (C>=6, D>=6) | (C>=7, D>=5) | (C>=5, D>=7)
      when  x is H | x is S
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: diamonds and hearts, six-six or seven-five"
      alert  artificial
      shows (D>=6, H>=6) | (D>=7, H>=5) | (D>=5, H>=7)
      when  x is C
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: clubs and hearts, six-six or seven-five"
      alert  artificial
      shows (C>=6, H>=6) | (C>=7, H>=5) | (C>=5, H>=7)
      when  x is D
      priority 1
after (2x) | (3x) when u4n_play, x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.x>=5
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: both minors, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is H | x is S
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: clubs and hearts, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, H>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: diamonds and hearts, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, H>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is C
      priority 1
after (4M) when u4n_play, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.M>=5
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: both minors, five-five"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, losers<=5
      priority 1
# The same in the balancing seat and over their preempt raised
# (2026-10-30, from Brill's convention files: 4H P P 4NT, 3H P P 4NT,
# 3H P 4H 4NT had no rule). Over their opening a 4NT overcall shows the
# same two suits as 2NT would (Wikipedia, "Unusual notrump", which asks
# for an extreme two-suiter, usually six-five; over a preempt we take a
# good five-five, as the direct rules above, notes). Partner has not
# bid, so it cannot be Blackwood:
# over three of a suit, balancing or after a raise to three, as the
# direct jump (five-five, four losers); over four of a major, balancing
# or after a raise to game, the minors, five-five with five losers.
# Over a minor preempt raised to four of a major, the two unbid suits.
after (3x) P (P) | (2x) P (3x) when u4n_play, x is not N, lho.hcp.max <= 12, lho.x>=5
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: both minors, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is H | x is S
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: clubs and hearts, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, H>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: diamonds and hearts, five-five, strong"
      alert  artificial
      shows D>=5, H>=5, losers<=4
      when  x is C
      priority 1
after (4M) P (P) | (3M) P (4M) | (2M) P (4M) | (3M) P (4M) P (P) | (2M) P (4M) P (P) when u4n_play, lho.M>=5 | rho.M>=5
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: both minors, five-five"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, losers<=5
      priority 1
after (3m) P (4M) when u4n_play, lho.m>=5
  4N  "Unusual 4NT: five-five in the two suits they have not bid"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5 | m is C, D>=5 | m is D, H>=5 | M is H, S>=5 | M is S
      shows losers<=5
      priority 1

# Advancer: the longer of partner's suits (the lower with equal length)
# at the five level.
after (1x) 4N (P) | (2x) 4N (P) | (3x) 4N (P) | (4x) 4N (P) | (1x) P (2x) 4N (P) | (1x) P (3x) 4N (P) | (1x) P (4x) 4N (P) | (1x) 4N (X) | (2x) 4N (X) | (3x) 4N (X) | (4x) 4N (X) | (3x) P (P) 4N (P) | (3x) P (P) 4N (X) | (2x) P (3x) 4N (P) | (2x) P (3x) 4N (X) | (4x) P (P) 4N (P) | (4x) P (P) 4N (X) | (3x) P (4y) 4N (P) | (3x) P (4y) 4N (X) | (2x) P (4x) 4N (P) | (2x) P (4x) 4N (X) | (3x) P (4x) P (P) 4N (P) | (2x) P (4x) P (P) 4N (P) when u4n_play
  cheapest(C) "Preference: clubs"
      prefer C + 0
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(D) "Preference: diamonds"
      prefer D + 0
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2

# ── Michaels over their preempt ──────────────────────────────────────
# BBA with Michaels on (Leaping_Michaels, Non_Leaping_Michaels_After_2-Bid
# and _3-Bid: 293 + 94 + 219 "Michaels Cuebid" notes) cue-bids a weak two
# directly or in the balancing seat, a weak two raised to three, and a
# three-level preempt: over a minor both majors, over a major the other
# major and a minor, five-five. Strength is ours (not probed): 13 total
# points direct over a weak two, 11 balancing, 14 over the raise, 16 at
# the four level. With Leaping Michaels the direct cue of a weak two is
# not Michaels (Rosen: it asks for a stopper; not written).
after (2x) when mich_play | mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_majors | nlm, x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.x>=5, !leaping
  3{x} "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is C | x is D
      priority 1
  3{x} "Michaels: five or more spades and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  3{x} "Michaels: five or more hearts and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is S
      priority 1
after (2x) P (P) | (2x) P (3x) when mich_play | mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_majors | nlm, x is not N, lho.hcp.max <= 12, lho.x>=5
  cheapest(x) "Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is C | x is D
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Michaels: five or more spades and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Michaels: five or more hearts and a five-card minor"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is S
      priority 1
after (3x) when mich_play | mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_majors | nlm, x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.x>=5
  4{x} "Michaels: both majors, game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is C | x is D
      priority 1
  4{x} "Michaels: spades and a five-card minor, game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows S>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  4{x} "Michaels: hearts and a five-card minor, game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, C>=5 | D>=5, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is S
      priority 1

# ── Leaping Michaels over their weak two ─────────────────────────────
# Neil Rosen (English Bridge, August 2013) and Bridge Bum: over 2♦, 4♣
# clubs and a major, 4♦ both majors; over 2♥ or 2♠, 4♣ / 4♦ that minor
# and the other major. Five-five, a good hand: four or five losers.
after (2x) when leaping, x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.x>=5
  4C  "Leaping Michaels: five or more clubs and a five-card major"
      alert
      shows C>=5, H>=5 | S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  4D  "Leaping Michaels: five or more in each major"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  4C  "Leaping Michaels: five or more clubs and spades"
      alert
      shows C>=5, S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  4D  "Leaping Michaels: five or more diamonds and spades"
      alert
      shows D>=5, S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  4C  "Leaping Michaels: five or more clubs and hearts"
      alert
      shows C>=5, H>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is S
      priority 1
  4D  "Leaping Michaels: five or more diamonds and hearts"
      alert
      shows D>=5, H>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is S
      priority 1

# ── Non-Leaping Michaels over their three-level preempt ──────────────
# Rosen (as above): four of a minor (not a jump) shows that minor and a
# major, the cue of a minor both majors (the Michaels rules above). Not
# forcing (Rosen: "not remotely close to being forcing"), so a little
# lighter than the leap: five-five, five losers.
after (3x) when nlm, x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12, rho.x>=5
  4D  "Non-Leaping Michaels: diamonds and a major, five-five"
      alert
      shows D>=5, H>=5 | S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is C
      priority 1
  4C  "Non-Leaping Michaels: clubs and a major, five-five"
      alert
      shows C>=5, H>=5 | S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is D
      priority 1
  4C  "Non-Leaping Michaels: five or more clubs and spades"
      alert
      shows C>=5, S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  4D  "Non-Leaping Michaels: five or more diamonds and spades"
      alert
      shows D>=5, S>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is H
      priority 1
  4C  "Non-Leaping Michaels: five or more clubs and hearts"
      alert
      shows C>=5, H>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is S
      priority 1
  4D  "Non-Leaping Michaels: five or more diamonds and hearts"
      alert
      shows D>=5, H>=5, losers<=5
      when  x is S
      priority 1

# ── Advancer after a two-suiter over their preempt ───────────────────
# Partner's two suits are known, or one of them is (a major and an
# unknown minor, a minor and an unknown major). Game in a known major
# with three-card support and 8+ HCP (or four trumps), else the cheapest
# preference with three; an unknown suit is found by pass or correct;
# 3NT with their suit held and no major fit.
after (2x) 3x (P) | (2x) P (P) 3x (P) | (2x) P (3x) 4x (P) | (3x) 4x (P) when x is not N, mich_play | mich_minors | mich_quasi | mich_majors | nlm
  4H  "Game in hearts: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows H>=3, hcp>=8 | H>=4
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 3
  4S  "Game in spades: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows S>=3, hcp>=8 | S>=4
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 3
  3N  "To play: {x} held, no major fit, 10+"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(x)
      when  H<=2 | maybe partner.H<=4, S<=2 | maybe partner.S<=4
      priority 3
  cheapest(H) "Preference: three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2
  4H  "Pass or correct: play in partner's major"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_major
      when  maybe partner.H<=4, maybe partner.S<=4, maybe partner.H>=5, maybe partner.S>=5
      when  maybe partner.C<=4 | C<=2, maybe partner.D<=4 | D<=2
      priority 2
  cheapest(C) "Pass or correct: play in partner's minor"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_minor
      when  maybe partner.C<=4, maybe partner.D<=4, maybe partner.C>=5, maybe partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(C) "Partner's clubs"
      shows C>=3
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Partner's diamonds"
      shows D>=3
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5

# The same after Leaping Michaels.
after (2x) 4y (P) when leaping, x is not N, y is C | y is D, y is not x
  4H  "Game in hearts: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows H>=3, hcp>=8 | H>=4
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 3
  4S  "Game in spades: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows S>=3, hcp>=8 | S>=4
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 3
  3N  "To play: {x} held, no major fit, 10+"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(x)
      when  H<=2 | maybe partner.H<=4, S<=2 | maybe partner.S<=4
      priority 3
  cheapest(H) "Preference: three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2
  4H  "Pass or correct: play in partner's major"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_major
      when  maybe partner.H<=4, maybe partner.S<=4, maybe partner.H>=5, maybe partner.S>=5
      when  maybe partner.C<=4 | C<=2, maybe partner.D<=4 | D<=2
      priority 2
  cheapest(C) "Pass or correct: play in partner's minor"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_minor
      when  maybe partner.C<=4, maybe partner.D<=4, maybe partner.C>=5, maybe partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(C) "Partner's clubs"
      shows C>=3
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Partner's diamonds"
      shows D>=3
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5

# The same after Non-Leaping Michaels.
after (3x) 4y (P) when nlm, x is not N, y is C | y is D, y is not x
  4H  "Game in hearts: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows H>=3, hcp>=8 | H>=4
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 3
  4S  "Game in spades: four or more, or three and 8+ HCP"
      shows S>=3, hcp>=8 | S>=4
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 3
  3N  "To play: {x} held, no major fit, 10+"
      shows hcp>=10, stop(x)
      when  H<=2 | maybe partner.H<=4, S<=2 | maybe partner.S<=4
      priority 3
  cheapest(H) "Preference: three or more hearts"
      shows H>=3
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Preference: three or more spades"
      shows S>=3
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.S>=5
      priority 2
  4H  "Pass or correct: play in partner's major"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_major
      when  maybe partner.H<=4, maybe partner.S<=4, maybe partner.H>=5, maybe partner.S>=5
      when  maybe partner.C<=4 | C<=2, maybe partner.D<=4 | D<=2
      priority 2
  cheapest(C) "Pass or correct: play in partner's minor"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_minor
      when  maybe partner.C<=4, maybe partner.D<=4, maybe partner.C>=5, maybe partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(C) "Partner's clubs"
      shows C>=3
      when  partner.C>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Partner's diamonds"
      shows D>=3
      when  partner.D>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
      when  partner.H>=5, partner.S>=5

# The two-suiter answers pass or correct.
when asked poc_major
  P   "Hearts: my major"            shows H>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Spades: my major"    shows S>=5
when asked poc_minor
  P   "Clubs: my minor"             shows C>=5
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Diamonds: my minor"  shows D>=5

# ── Direct jump cue bids ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# The ACBL card's "direct jump cuebid" box; the meanings as Practice-
# Bidding-Scenarios defines them (Jump_Cuebid_Strong, Jump_Cuebid_Weak;
# BBA plays neither). Gambling: a solid suit of seven or more (A-K-Q),
# asking partner for 3NT with their suit stopped. Strong: the same with
# six or more controls. Majors (over a minor): five-five or better in the
# majors, preemptive. Preempt (over a minor): seven or more of their
# minor, up to 10 HCP, two of the top three honours. The `minor` option
# over a major is not written (its meaning is not defined: a question
# for Rick).
after (1M) when djc_major is gambling | djc_major is strong
  3{M} "Jump cue bid: a solid seven-card suit, asks for a {M} stopper"
      alert  artificial
      shows (C>=7, quality(C)>=excellent) | (D>=7, quality(D)>=excellent) | (M is H, S>=7, quality(S)>=excellent) | (M is S, H>=7, quality(H)>=excellent)
      sets  forcing=round, ask=jump_cue_stopper
      when  !stop(M)
      when  djc_major is gambling | controls>=6
      priority 1
after (1m) when djc_minor is gambling
  3{m} "Jump cue bid: a solid seven-card suit, asks for a {m} stopper"
      alert  artificial
      shows (C>=7, quality(C)>=excellent, m is D) | (D>=7, quality(D)>=excellent, m is C) | (H>=7, quality(H)>=excellent) | (S>=7, quality(S)>=excellent)
      sets  forcing=round, ask=jump_cue_stopper
      when  !stop(m)
      priority 1
after (1m) when djc_minor is majors
  3{m} "Jump cue bid: five or more in each major, preemptive"
      alert  artificial
      shows H>=5, S>=5, hcp<=10
      priority 1
after (1m) when djc_minor is preempt
  3{m} "Jump cue bid: a preempt in {m}, seven or more, up to 10 HCP"
      alert
      shows m>=7, hcp<=10, quality(m)>=good
      priority 1

# Advancer: 3NT with their suit held; else 4♣, pass or correct.
when asked jump_cue_stopper
  3N  "Their suit is held: to play"    shows stop(they.strain)
      priority 1
  4C  "No stopper: pass or correct"
      alert
      sets  ask=poc_long
when asked poc_long
  P   "Clubs: my suit"                 shows C>=7
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Diamonds: my suit"      shows D>=7
  cheapest(H) "Hearts: my suit"        shows H>=7
  cheapest(S) "Spades: my suit"        shows S>=7
# After the majors: the better major, game with a fit and values.
after (1m) 3m (P) when djc_minor is majors
  cheapest(H) "Preference: hearts"
      prefer H + 0
  cheapest(S) "Preference: spades"
      prefer S + 0
  4H  "Game in hearts: four or more, or three and 12+"
      shows H>=4 | (H>=3, hcp>=12)
      prefer H + 0
      priority 1
  4S  "Game in spades: four or more, or three and 12+"
      shows S>=4 | (S>=3, hcp>=12)
      prefer S + 0
      priority 1
