# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Over their 1NT opening: what every defence shares (vs-1nt.notes.md).
#
# The convention the card plays for `defence_to_1nt.strong` is the
# defence, and each has its own module for the calls that differ:
# natural (overcalls.bid), Cappelletti and Modified Cappelletti
# (cappelletti.bid), DONT (dont.bid), Meckwell (meckwell.bid), Landy and
# Multi-Landy (multi-landy.bid). Their calls say what they show and set
# a question for partner (`sets ask=...`); the answers that are the same
# whichever defence asked are written here, once, against the question:
#
#   nt_majors       partner has both majors: pick one, invite or bid game
#   nt_mm(M)        partner has five M and a four-card minor
#   nt_which_minor  I asked for that minor: partner names it
#   nt_minors       partner has both minors: pick one
#   nt_pc(x)        partner has x and another suit: pass, or ask which
#   nt_other        I asked for the other suit: partner names it
#   nt_one(x)       partner has shown one long suit x
#   nt_penalty      partner doubled for penalties
#
# Advancer's strength is measured in support points (tp) once a major
# fits. BBA (21GF-DEFAULT, probes/vs-1N-capp-*-adv.toml) raises a
# five-card major with 3+ support: to three with 8-14 total points and
# to game from about 11. The overcaller has 9-17, so we invite with 10-12
# support points and bid game from 13.

module vs-1nt "Over their 1NT: what every defence shares"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  skill  competitive_bidding/defense_vs_1nt
  param  def = defence_to_1nt.strong

# ── Preempts and the pass ────────────────────────────────────────────
# With a conventional defence a seven-card suit jumps to the three level
# only when it is too weak for the one-suited call: BBA on 21GF-DEFAULT
# preempts with 6-8 HCP and bids 2♣ (Cappelletti) from 9 with seven cards
# (probes/vs-1N-capp.toml). We preempt up to 11 counting a point a card
# beyond four, one below the one-suiter's 12: 4-8 HCP with seven cards.
# The natural defence keeps its own 4-10 (overcalls.bid).
after (1N) when !(def is none)
  3S  "Preemptive: seven spades"                  shows S>=7, hcp>=4, hcp+length_points<=11
      priority 1
  3H  "Preemptive: seven hearts"                  shows H>=7, hcp>=4, hcp+length_points<=11
      priority 1
  3D  "Preemptive: seven diamonds"                shows D>=7, hcp>=4, hcp+length_points<=11
      priority 1
  3C  "Preemptive: seven clubs"                   shows C>=7, hcp>=4, hcp+length_points<=11
      priority 1
after (1N) | (1N) P (P)
  P   "No overcall"             priority -10

# ── Partner has both majors ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Cappelletti 2♦, Landy and Multi-Landy 2♣, DONT 2♥, Meckwell X then 2♥.
# Preference to the longer major (hearts when equal, as BBA and GIB),
# a jump to invite with four, game from 13 support points; a long minor
# with at most two cards in either major plays there.
when asked nt_majors, rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  P   "Hearts: to play"                  shows H>=S
      when  partner.last=2H
  2H  "Preference: hearts"               shows H>=S
  2S  "Preference: spades"               shows S>H
  3H  "Invitational: four hearts"        shows H>=4, H>=S, tp(H)=10..12
  3S  "Invitational: four spades"        shows S>=4, S>H, tp(S)=10..12
  4H  "Game in hearts"                   shows H>=3, H>=S, tp(H)>=13
  4S  "Game in spades"                   shows S>=3, S>H, tp(S)>=13
  P   "Long clubs: to play"              shows C>=6, H<=2, S<=2
      when  partner.last=2C
  P   "Long diamonds: to play"           shows D>=6, H<=2, S<=2
      when  partner.last=2D
  3C  "Long clubs: to play"              shows C>=6, H<=2, S<=2
      when  !partner.last=2C
  3D  "Long diamonds: to play"           shows D>=6, H<=2, S<=2
      when  !partner.last=2D

# ── Partner has five of a major and a four-card minor ────────────────
# Cappelletti and Multi-Landy 2♥/2♠, Modified Cappelletti 2♣ then 2♥/2♠.
# Pass with two or more; raise with three; 2NT asks for the minor with a
# singleton or void; a six-card suit of my own is to play.
when asked nt_mm(M), rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  P    "{M} to play"                            shows M>=2
  3{M} "Invitational raise"                     shows M>=3, tp(M)=10..12
  4{M} "Game in {M}"                            shows M>=3, tp(M)>=13
  2N   "Which is your minor?"                   alert  artificial
       shows M<=1
       sets  ask=nt_which_minor
  2S   "Six or more spades: to play"            shows S>=6, M<=2
       when  M is H
  3H   "Six or more hearts: to play"            shows H>=6, M<=2
       when  M is S
  3C   "Six or more clubs: to play"             shows C>=6, M<=1
  3D   "Six or more diamonds: to play"          shows D>=6, M<=1

when asked nt_which_minor, rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  3C  "My minor is clubs"                       shows C>=4, C>=D
  3D  "My minor is diamonds"                    shows D>=4, D>C

# ── Partner has both minors ──────────────────────────────────────────
# 2NT in Cappelletti, Meckwell and Multi-Landy. The longer minor, and
# diamonds when equal (BBA, probes/vs-1N-capp-2N-adv.toml: 98 of 98);
# game with a fit and 14 support points.
when asked nt_minors, rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  3C  "Preference: clubs"                       shows C>D
  3D  "Preference: diamonds"                    shows D>=C
  5C  "Game in clubs"                           shows C>=4, C>D, tp(C)>=14
  5D  "Game in diamonds"                        shows D>=4, D>=C, tp(D)>=14
  3H  "Six or more hearts: to play"             shows H>=6, C<=2, D<=2
  3S  "Six or more spades: to play"             shows S>=6, C<=2, D<=2

# ── Partner has a known suit and another ─────────────────────────────
# DONT 2♣/2♦ (and a higher suit), Meckwell 2♣/2♦ (and a major). Pass
# with three of the known suit; otherwise the next step asks for the
# other one, which partner passes or corrects.
when asked nt_pc(x), rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  P   "Support for {x}: to play"                shows x>=3
  2D  "Which is your other suit?"               alert
      shows x<=2
      when  x is C
      sets  ask=nt_other
  2H  "Pass or correct: which is your other suit?"   alert
      shows x<=2
      when  x is D
      sets  ask=nt_other

when asked nt_other, rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  P   "My other suit is diamonds"               shows D>=4
      when  partner.last=2D
  P   "My other suit is hearts"                 shows H>=4
      when  partner.last=2H
  2H  "My other suit is hearts"                 shows H>=4
  2S  "My other suit is spades"                 shows S>=4

# ── Partner has shown one long suit ──────────────────────────────────
# After a relay answer, a natural 2♥/2♠ (Meckwell, DONT 2♠) or the
# Multi-Landy 2♦. Raise a major with two or more: invite with 11-12,
# game from 13.
when asked nt_one(x), rho.last=P | rho.last=X
  3{x} "Invitational raise"                     shows x>=2, hcp=11..12
       when  x is H | x is S
  4{x} "Game in {x}"                            shows x>=2, hcp>=13
       when  x is H | x is S
  P    "No further bid"                    priority -5

# ── Partner doubled for penalties ────────────────────────────────────
# Cappelletti and Modified Cappelletti: 15+ HCP. Sit with five or more
# HCP, or with nowhere to go; run to a five-card suit with less.
when asked nt_penalty, rho.last=P | rho.last=XX
  P   "Leaves the double in"          priority -1
  2C  "Weak: five or more clubs"                shows C>=5, hcp<=4
  2D  "Weak: five or more diamonds"             shows D>=5, hcp<=4
  2H  "Weak: five or more hearts"               shows H>=5, hcp<=4
  2S  "Weak: five or more spades"               shows S>=5, hcp<=4
files.rules/competitive/vs-preempts.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Defence against their preempts (2026-09-27). The par attribution
# (probes/tools/par_blame.py) showed our side passing out their weak twos
# and three-level preempts: over anything but a one-level opening there
# were no rules at all.
#
# Natural, as the Basic-Bridge card plays it, and as BBA bids it there
# (probes/vs-w2-2D.toml, vs-w2-2H.toml, vs-w2-2S.toml): the one-level
# structure a level higher.
#
# - a takeout double: 12+ total points, two or fewer of theirs and three
#   or more in each unbid suit, or 17+ HCP with three or fewer of theirs
#   (the power double, then bid again);
# - a new suit: five or more, 12-16 HCP; at the three level 13 total
#   points; a suit worth bidding (two of the top three, three of the top
#   five, six cards, or an opening hand of 13 total points);
# - a jump to three of a major: six or more, 15-16;
# - 2NT: 15-17 balanced, their suit stopped, no five-card major;
# - four of a major: seven or more, game;
# - otherwise pass.
#
# A weak two is told from a strong 2C by what the opener has shown: at
# most 12 HCP.

module vs-preempts "Defence against preempts"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  skill  competitive_bidding/defense_vs_preempts
  skill  competitive_bidding/takeout_doubles
  skill  competitive_bidding/lebensohl
  param  leb = competitive_bidding/lebensohl:after_weak_two_double default false
  param  rub = competitive_bidding/rubensohl:after_double default false

# ── Direct seat over their weak two ──────────────────────────────────
after (2x) when x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Takeout: the unbid suits and 12+, or any 17+"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      shows ((S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=2) | (hcp>=17, x<=3)
  cheapest(S) "Overcall: five or more spades, 12-16"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=16
      when  x is not S
      when  quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3 | S>=6 | hcp+length_points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(S) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(H) "Overcall: five or more hearts, 12-16"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D, H>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=16
      when  x is not H
      when  quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3 | H>=6 | hcp+length_points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(H) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(D) "Overcall: five or more diamonds, 12-16"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=16
      when  x is not D
      when  quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3 | D>=6 | hcp+length_points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(D) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(C) "Overcall: five or more clubs, 12-16"
      shows C>=5, C>S, C>H, C>D, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=16
      when  x is not C
      when  quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=3 | C>=6 | hcp+length_points>=13
      when  cheapest_rank(C) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=13
  jump(S) "Strong jump overcall: six or more spades, 15-16"
      shows S>=6, hcp=15..16
      when  x is not S
  jump(H) "Strong jump overcall: six or more hearts, 15-16"
      shows H>=6, H>S, hcp=15..16
      when  x is not H, x is not S
  cheapest(N) "15-17 balanced, {x} stopped, no five-card major"
      shows balanced, hcp=15..17, S<=4, H<=4
      when  stop(x)
  4S  "Seven or more spades: game"
      shows S>=7, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is not S
  4H  "Seven or more hearts: game"
      shows H>=7, H>S, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is not H
  P   "No overcall"
      priority -10

# ── Balancing over their weak two: (2x) P (P) ───────────────────────
# BBA (probes/vs-w2-2H-bal.toml): lighter than direct. A reopening double
# with two or fewer of theirs and 12+; a new suit from 9 total points at
# the two level, 11 at the three; 2NT 16-18; a jump to three of a major
# with six and 15+.
after (2x) P (P) when x is not N, lho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Reopening double: 12+, short in {x}, the unbid suits"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      shows ((S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=2) | (hcp>=17, x<=3)
  cheapest(S) "Balancing: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=16
      when  x is not S
      when  cheapest_rank(S) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=11
  cheapest(H) "Balancing: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D, H>=C, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=16
      when  x is not H
      when  cheapest_rank(H) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=11
  cheapest(D) "Balancing: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=16
      when  x is not D
      when  cheapest_rank(D) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=11
  cheapest(C) "Balancing: five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, C>S, C>H, C>D, hcp+length_points>=9, hcp<=16
      when  x is not C
      when  cheapest_rank(C) <= 13 | hcp+length_points>=11
  jump(S) "Six or more spades, 15-16"
      shows S>=6, hcp=15..16
      when  x is not S, cheapest_rank(S) <= 13
  jump(H) "Six or more hearts, 15-16"
      shows H>=6, H>S, hcp=15..16
      when  x is not H, cheapest_rank(H) <= 13, !rub | cheapest_rank(x) > 18
  cheapest(N) "16-18 balanced, {x} stopped"
      shows balanced, hcp=16..18, S<=4, H<=4
      when  stop(x)
  P   "Nothing to reopen with"
      priority -10

# ── Direct seat over their three-level preempt ───────────────────────
# BBA (probes/vs-p3-3{C,D,H,S}.toml): a takeout double from 12; a new
# suit at the three level from 12 total points, at the four level from
# 14; 3NT 17-21 with their suit stopped; four of a major with seven.
after (3x) when x is not N, rho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Takeout: 12+, short in {x}, the unbid suits, or 17+"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      shows ((S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=2) | (hcp>=17, x<=3)
  cheapest(S) "Overcall: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=17
      when  x is not S
      when  quality(S)>=good | top5(S)>=3 | S>=6 | hcp+length_points>=14
      when  cheapest_rank(S) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=14
  cheapest(H) "Overcall: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D, H>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=17
      when  x is not H
      when  quality(H)>=good | top5(H)>=3 | H>=6 | hcp+length_points>=14
      when  cheapest_rank(H) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=14
  cheapest(D) "Overcall: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=17
      when  x is not D
      when  quality(D)>=good | top5(D)>=3 | D>=6 | hcp+length_points>=14
      when  cheapest_rank(D) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=14
  cheapest(C) "Overcall: five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, C>S, C>H, C>D, hcp+length_points>=12, hcp<=17
      when  x is not C
      when  quality(C)>=good | top5(C)>=3 | C>=6 | hcp+length_points>=14
      when  cheapest_rank(C) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=14
  3N  "17-21 with {x} stopped"
      shows hcp=17..21, S<=4, H<=4
      when  stop(x)
  4S  "Seven or more spades: game"
      shows S>=7, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is not S
  4H  "Seven or more hearts: game"
      shows H>=7, H>S, hcp+length_points>=13
      when  x is not H
  P   "No overcall"
      priority -10

# ── Balancing over their three-level preempt: (3x) P (P) ─────────────
# BBA (probes/vs-p3-3H-bal.toml): a reopening double with 12+ and at most
# one of theirs; a new suit at the three level from 11 total points, at
# the four from 13; 3NT 17-20 with their suit stopped.
after (3x) P (P) when x is not N, lho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Reopening double: 12+, short in {x}, the unbid suits"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12
      shows ((S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=1) | (hcp>=17, x<=3)
  cheapest(S) "Balancing: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  x is not S
      when  cheapest_rank(S) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(H) "Balancing: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, H>=D, H>=C, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  x is not H
      when  cheapest_rank(H) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(D) "Balancing: five or more diamonds"
      shows D>=5, D>S, D>H, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  x is not D
      when  cheapest_rank(D) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(C) "Balancing: five or more clubs"
      shows C>=5, C>S, C>H, C>D, hcp+length_points>=11, hcp<=17
      when  x is not C
      when  cheapest_rank(C) <= 18 | hcp+length_points>=13
  3N  "17-20 with {x} stopped"
      shows hcp=17..20, S<=4, H<=4
      when  stop(x)
  P   "Nothing to reopen with"
      priority -10

# ── Their four-level preempt ─────────────────────────────────────────
# BBA (probes/vs-p4-4H.toml, vs-p4-4S.toml, vs-p4-4H-bal.toml). Over 4H a
# takeout double from 14 and 4S with five from 14 total points; over 4S
# the double is for penalty, 17+ (values: partner leaves it in unless
# his shape says otherwise); five of a minor from 16. Balancing over 4H:
# the double from 12 with no hearts, 4S from 13, five of a minor from 15.
after (4x) when x is H, rho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Takeout: 14+, short in hearts"
      shows hcp+length_points>=14, x<=2, S>=3
  4S  "Five or more spades, 14+"
      shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=14
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, 16+"   shows D>=5, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=16
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs, 16+"      shows C>=5, C>D, hcp+length_points>=16
  P   "No overcall"
      priority -10
after (4x) when x is S, rho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Values: 17+, for penalty"
      shows hcp>=17, x>=2
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, 16+"   shows D>=5, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=16
  cheapest(H) "Five or more hearts, 16+"     shows H>=5, H>=D, H>=C, hcp+length_points>=16
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs, 16+"      shows C>=5, C>D, hcp+length_points>=16
  P   "No overcall"
      priority -10
after (4x) P (P) when x is H, lho.hcp.max <= 12
  X   "Reopening double: 12+, no hearts"
      shows hcp+length_points>=12, x<=1
  4S  "Five or more spades, 13+"             shows S>=5, hcp+length_points>=13
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, 15+"   shows D>=5, D>=C, hcp+length_points>=15
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs, 15+"      shows C>=5, C>D, hcp+length_points>=15
  P   "Nothing to reopen with"
      priority -10
# Advancer after our double of their four-level preempt: over 4H take
# it out into five or more spades; otherwise leave it in.
after (4x) X (P) | (4x) P (P) X (P) when x is H | x is S
  4S  "Five or more spades"                  shows S>=5
      when  x is H
  P   "Leaves the double in"
      priority -5

# ── Their four-level minor preempt (2026-10-15) ──────────────────────
# Brill daily 2026-10-14 board 5: (4C) passed round with 16 HCP,
# 4-2-4-3; there was no rule over 4C or 4D. Standard practice (doubles
# of preempts below 4S are for takeout, Bridge World Standard; partner
# converts with length in their suit): the double is takeout of the
# minor, short in it with both majors, or 16+ with any shape (at the
# four level it is the strong hand's only call); four of a major is
# natural, five or more; a five-card other minor from 16. As over 4H,
# a little more than over a three-level preempt: 14 total points. A 4m
# opening no rule reads (cards without one) counts as natural; Namyats
# is artificial and stays out.
after (4x) when x is C | x is D, rho.hcp.max <= 12 | rho.named(x)
  X   "Takeout: 14+, short in {x}, or 16+"
      shows ((S>=3, H>=3, (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=2, hcp+length_points>=14) | (hcp>=16, x<=3))
  4S  "Five or more spades, 14+"             shows S>=5, S>=H, hcp+length_points>=14
  4H  "Five or more hearts, 14+"             shows H>=5, H>S, hcp+length_points>=14
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds, 16+"   shows D>=5, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is C
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs, 16+"      shows C>=5, S<=4, H<=4, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is D
  P   "No overcall"
      priority -10
after (4x) P (P) when x is C | x is D, lho.hcp.max <= 12 | lho.named(x)
  X   "Reopening double: 12+, short in {x}, or 16+"
      shows ((S>=3, H>=3, (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C), x<=2, hcp+length_points>=12) | (hcp>=16, x<=3))
  4S  "Five or more spades, 13+"             shows S>=5, S>=H, hcp+length_points>=13
  4H  "Five or more hearts, 13+"             shows H>=5, H>S, hcp+length_points>=13
  P   "Nothing to reopen with"
      priority -10
# Advancer: a four-card major, the longer (hearts with four of each:
# the cheaper), a five-card other minor, else leave it in.
after (4x) X (P) | (4x) P (P) X (P) when x is C | x is D
  4H  "Four or more hearts"                  shows H>=4, H>=S
  4S  "Four or more spades"                  shows S>=4, S>H
  cheapest(D) "Five or more diamonds"        shows D>=5, S<=3, H<=3, x<=2
      when  x is C
  cheapest(C) "Five or more clubs"           shows C>=5, S<=3, H<=3, x<=2
      when  x is D
  P   "Leaves the double in"
      priority -5

# ── Their preempt raised to the four or five level (2026-10-15) ──────
# Brill daily 2026-10-14 board 4: (2D) P (5D) with AQJ7.AKQT94.-.K84;
# the "they are too high" penalty double (penalty-doubles.bid) was the
# only call, and 5DX made with 6H/6S on. With a void in their suit and
# a long suit the hand is for declaring: bid it; the double is takeout
# (as over their four-level preempt, a level higher). The long suit
# first: its own strain is the one partner cannot find.
after (2x) P (4x) | (2x) P (5x) | (3x) P (4x) | (3x) P (5x) when x is not N, lho.hcp.max <= 12
  cheapest(S) "Six or more spades, 16+"
      shows S>=6, S>=H, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is not S
      when  cheapest_rank(S) <= 23 | hcp+length_points>=18
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Six or more hearts, 16+"
      shows H>=6, H>S, hcp+length_points>=16
      when  x is not H
      when  cheapest_rank(H) <= 23 | hcp+length_points>=18
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Six or more diamonds, 18+"
      shows D>=6, D>S, D>H, hcp+length_points>=18
      when  x is not D
  cheapest(C) "Six or more clubs, 18+"
      shows C>=6, C>S, C>H, C>D, hcp+length_points>=18
      when  x is not C
  X   "Takeout: 16+, short in {x}"
      shows hcp+length_points>=16, x<=1
      shows (S>=3 | x is S), (H>=3 | x is H), (D>=3 | x is D), (C>=3 | x is C)
# Advancer: the double is takeout but high; pull it only with a
# five-card major and at most one of theirs, else leave it in.
after (2x) P (4x) X (P) | (2x) P (5x) X (P) | (3x) P (4x) X (P) | (3x) P (5x) X (P) when x is not N
  cheapest(S) "Five or more spades and no defence"   shows S>=5, S>=H, x<=1
      when  x is not S
  cheapest(H) "Five or more hearts and no defence"   shows H>=5, H>S, x<=1
      when  x is not H
  P   "Leaves the double in"
      priority -5

# ── Advancer after our double of their weak two ──────────────────────
# BBA (probes/vs-w2-2H-X-adv.toml, vs-w2-2S-X-adv.toml): the cheapest
# suit with four, 0-10 (majors first); a jump in a major with five, 8-11;
# 2NT 11-12 and 3NT 12+ with their suit stopped; the cue bid of their
# suit, 13+, forcing to game; four of a major with four and game values;
# a pass with length and strength in their suit.
after (2x) X (P) | (3x) X (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) | (3x) P (P) X (P) when x is not C
  P   "Penalty: five of their suit with two top honours"
      shows x>=5, quality(x)>=good | top5(x)>=3
      priority 2
  P   "Penalty: four of their suit, a flat hand and 10+"
      shows x=4, hcp>=10, stop(x), S<=4, H<=4, D<=4, C<=4
      priority 2
  cheapest(x) "Cue bid: 13+, forcing to game"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp+length_points>=13
      sets   forcing=game
      when   !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18
  4S  "Game: four or more spades, 11+"
      shows S>=4, S>=H, hcp+length_points=11..12
      when  x is not S
  4H  "Game: four or more hearts, 11+"
      shows H>=4, H>S, hcp+length_points=11..12
      when  x is not H
  jump(S) "Invitational: five or more spades, 8-10"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, hcp+length_points=8..10
      when  x is not S, cheapest_rank(S) <= 13, !rub | cheapest_rank(x) > 18     # a jump to three, not to game; Rubensohl transfers there
  jump(H) "Invitational: five or more hearts, 8-10"
      shows H>=5, H>S, hcp+length_points=8..10
      when  x is not H, cheapest_rank(H) <= 13, !rub | cheapest_rank(x) > 18
  cheapest(N) "11-12 with {x} stopped"
      shows hcp+length_points=11..12, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  stop(x), cheapest_rank(x) < 14, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18
      sets  ask=nt_invite
  3N  "Game with {x} stopped, no four-card major"
      shows hcp+length_points>=13 | (hcp+length_points>=11, cheapest_rank(x) >= 14), S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  stop(x), !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18
  cheapest(S) "Four or more spades, 0-10"
      shows S>=4, S>=H, hcp+length_points<=10
      when  x is not S, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(S) <= 13
  cheapest(H) "Four or more hearts, 0-10"
      shows H>=4, H>S, hcp+length_points<=10
      when  x is not H, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(H) <= 13
  cheapest(D) "Four or more diamonds, 0-10, no four-card major"
      shows D>=4, D>=C, hcp+length_points<=10, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not D, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(D) <= 13
  cheapest(C) "Four or more clubs, 0-10, no four-card major"
      shows C>=4, C>D | x is D, hcp+length_points<=10, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not C, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(C) <= 13
  # Nothing fits: the longest suit that is not theirs, cheapest first.
  cheapest(S) "No four-card suit: spades"   when x is not S, S>=H, S>=D, S>=C, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(S) <= 13
      priority -5
  cheapest(H) "No four-card suit: hearts"   when x is not H, H>=D, H>=C, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(H) <= 13
      priority -5
  cheapest(D) "No four-card suit: diamonds" when x is not D, D>=C, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(D) <= 13
      priority -6
  cheapest(C) "No four-card suit: clubs"    when x is not C, !(leb | rub) | cheapest_rank(x) > 18 | cheapest_rank(C) <= 13
      priority -7

# ── The doubler's rebid ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# A pass denies the power double (17+ HCP); the strong hand raises,
# shows its own suit, or bids notrump.
after (2x) X (P) 2y (P) | (2x) X (P) 3y (P) | (3x) X (P) 3y (P) | (3x) X (P) 4y (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2y (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3y (P) when y is not x, x is not C
  P   "Minimum double"          shows hcp<=16
      priority -5
  4{y} "Game: four-card support, 17+"      shows y>=4, hcp>=17
      when  y is H | y is S
  cheapest(y) "Raise: four-card support, 17+"                 shows y>=4, hcp>=17
      priority -1
  3N  "18+ with {x} stopped"                         shows hcp>=18, stop(x)
  cheapest(S) "17+ and five or more spades"          shows S>=5, hcp>=17
      when  x is not S, y is not S
  cheapest(H) "17+ and five or more hearts"          shows H>=5, S<=4, hcp>=17
      when  x is not H, y is not H
after (2x) X (P) 2N (P) when x is not C, !leb, !rub
  3N  "Accepts the invitation: 14+"                  shows hcp>=14
  P   "Declines"                                     shows hcp<=13
      priority -5

# ── Lebensohl after our double of their weak two ─────────────────────
# `competitive.lebensohl_weak_twos.play` (the 21GF cards). Bridge Bum,
# "Lebensohl over weak two bids"; Larry Cohen, "Lebensohl". Advancer:
#
# - a new suit at the two level: natural, weak (the rules above);
# - 2NT: a relay to 3C, with a weak hand that must bid at the three
#   level (pass or correct), or game values with their suit stopped
#   ("slow shows": then the cue bid or 3NT);
# - a new suit at the three level directly: constructive, 8-11;
# - the cue bid directly: game values, four of an unbid major, no stopper;
# - 3NT directly: game values, no stopper, no four-card major;
# - jumps to three of a major (invitational) and to game: as before.
#
# The natural replies above step aside at the three level when this is
# on (their `!leb` clauses); over a three-level preempt nothing changes.
# Tried 2026-09-27 and reverted on par; built again from the card
# 2026-10-05 (vs-preempts.notes.md).
after (2x) X (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) when x is not C, leb, !rub
  2N  "Lebensohl: relay to 3C, weak or game values"
      alert  artificial
      shows  (hcp<=8, C>=4 | (D>=4, x is H | x is S) | (H>=4, x is S), S<=3 | x is S | cheapest_rank(S) >= 15, H<=3 | x is H | cheapest_rank(H) >= 15) | (hcp>=13, stop(x), S<=4 | x is S, H<=4 | x is H)
      sets   ask=leb_relay
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Cue bid: game values, a four-card major, no {x} stopper"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp>=13, (S=4, x is not S) | (H=4, x is not H), S<=4 | x is S, H<=4 | x is H
      when   !stop(x)
      sets   forcing=game, ask=leb_cue
      priority 1
  3N  "Game values, no four-card major, no stopper in {x}"
      shows hcp>=13, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  !stop(x)
      priority 1
  cheapest(S) "Constructive: four or more spades, 9-12"
      shows S>=4, S>=H, hcp=9..12
      when  x is not S, cheapest_rank(S) >= 15
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Constructive: four or more hearts, 9-12"
      shows H>=4, H>S, hcp=9..12
      when  x is not H, cheapest_rank(H) >= 15
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Constructive: four or more diamonds, 9-12"
      shows D>=4, D>=C, hcp=9..12, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not D, cheapest_rank(D) >= 15
      priority 1
  cheapest(C) "Constructive: four or more clubs, 9-12"
      shows C>=4, C>D | x is D, hcp=9..12, S<=3 | x is S, H<=3 | x is H
      when  x is not C, cheapest_rank(C) >= 15
      priority 1
  # A five-card unbid major and game values: bid the game (BBA too).
  4S  "Game: five or more spades"
      shows S>=5, S>=H, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is not S
      priority 1
  4H  "Game: five or more hearts"
      shows H>=5, H>S, hcp+length_points>=11
      when  x is not H
      priority 1
  # Five of their suit and a weak hand: nowhere to go, pass (BBA).
  P   "Leaves the double in: five or more {x}"
      shows x>=5, hcp<=8
      priority 1
  # Nothing else fits: the relay, then the best of what is left.
  2N  "Lebensohl: relay to 3C"
      alert  artificial
      sets   ask=leb_relay
      priority -8

# The doubler: 3C as asked; with 19+ and their suit stopped, 3NT.
after (2x) X (P) 2N (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2N (P) when x is not C, leb, !rub
  3N  "Game: 19+ with {x} stopped"    shows hcp>=19, stop(x)
      priority 2
  3C  "Lebensohl: as asked"
      alert  artificial
      priority 1

# Advancer after the relay.
after (2x) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) when x is not C, leb, !rub
  P   "Weak, clubs"                                  shows C>=4, hcp<=8
      priority 1
  cheapest(D) "Weak, diamonds: to play"              shows D>=4, D>C, hcp<=8
      when  x is not D
      priority 1
  cheapest(H) "Weak, hearts: to play"                shows H>=4, H>D, H>C, hcp<=8
      when  x is S
      priority 1
  cheapest(x) "Slow cue: game values, four of an unbid major, {x} stopped"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp>=13, stop(x), (S=4, x is not S) | (H=4, x is not H)
      sets   forcing=game, ask=leb_cue
      priority 1
  3N  "Slow 3NT: game values with {x} stopped, no four-card major"
      shows hcp>=13, stop(x)
      priority 1
  P   "Weak: to play in clubs"                          priority -10

# The doubler answers either cue bid: an unbid four-card major, else
# 3NT, else his longer minor.
after (2x) X (P) 3x (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 3x (P) | (2x) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3x (P) | (2x) P (P) X (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3x (P) when x is not C, leb, !rub
  cheapest(H) "Four hearts"                          shows H>=4
      when  x is not H
      priority 2
  cheapest(S) "Four spades"                          shows S>=4
      when  x is not S
      priority 2
  3N  "No four-card major"                           priority 1
  cheapest(D) "No major, no stopper: diamonds"       shows D>=4, D>=C
      when  x is not D
      priority -1

# ── Advancer after our overcall of their weak two ────────────────────
after (2x) 2y (P) | (2x) 3y (P) | (3x) 3y (P) | (3x) 4y (P) | (2x) P (P) 2y (P) | (2x) P (P) 3y (P) when y is not x, x is not C
  4{y} "Game: three-card support, 12+"               shows y>=3, hcp+length_points>=12
      when  y is H | y is S
  cheapest(y) "Raise: three-card support, 8-11"      shows y>=3, hcp+length_points=8..11
  3N  "Game: 12+ with {x} stopped"                   shows hcp+length_points>=12, stop(x), y<=2
  P   "Nothing to add"                               priority -10

# ── Advancer after our 2NT (15-17) ───────────────────────────────────
after (2x) 2N (P) when x is not C
  3N  "Game: 9+"                                     shows hcp>=9, S<=5, H<=5
  4S  "Game: six or more spades, 8+"                 shows S>=6, hcp>=8
      when  x is not S
  4H  "Game: six or more hearts, 8+"                 shows H>=6, hcp>=8
      when  x is not H
  P   "No game"                                      shows hcp<=8
      priority -10

# ── Their side after our action over the weak two ───────────────────
# The weak-two responses assume a pass on the right. Over our double or
# overcall the responder competes with a fit (total-tricks.bid) or
# passes; the opener has described his hand.
after 2x (X) | 2x (2y) | 2x (3y) | 2x (2N) | 3x (X) | 3x (3y) | 3x (4y) | 3x (3N) | 4x (X) | 4x (4y) | 4x (5y) when x is not N
  P   "No further bid"                 priority -10
after 2x (X) P (*) | 2x (2y) P (*) | 2x (3y) P (*) | 2x (2N) P (*) | 3x (X) P (*) | 3x (3y) P (*) | 3x (4y) P (*) | 4x (X) P (*) | 4x (4y) P (*) | 4x (5y) P (*) when x is not N
  P   "No further bid"      priority -10
files.rules/competitive/vs-takeout-double.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responder's raises of partner's major once they have doubled it for
# takeout: Jordan (Truscott) 2NT and BROMAD (2026-10-05). The rest of
# responder's calls over the double (redouble, new suits, the simple
# raise, 1NT) are in after-interference.bid.
#
# - Jordan 2NT (`competitive.jordan_2nt.play`; Bridge Bum, "Jordan
#   2NT"): 1M (X) 2NT is a limit raise or better with four or more
#   trumps, and the jump to 3M is preemptive (four trumps; Bridge Bum
#   says 5-9, we stop at 7 support points: BBA raises to 2M with four
#   trumps and 6-9 HCP, and jumps only with less; notes).
#   Opener signs off in 3M or bids the game, as over any limit raise.
# - BROMAD (`competitive.bromad.play`; Bridge Bum, "BROMAD"): 2♣ a
#   constructive raise with three trumps (7-9), 2♦ three trumps and a
#   limit raise or better, 3♣ a constructive raise with four, 3♦ a
#   four-card limit raise, 2M and 3M preemptive (three and four trumps,
#   up to 6), 2NT a weak minor two-suiter. When the card plays Jordan
#   too (BBA's cards with BROMAD all do), 2NT stays Jordan and covers
#   the four-card limit raise, so BROMAD's 3♦ and 2NT are not played.
#
# Notes: vs-takeout-double.notes.md.

module vs-takeout-double "Raises over their takeout double: Jordan 2NT and BROMAD"
  kind   system
  needs  base
  needs  after-interference
  skill  competitive_bidding/over_their_takeout_double
  skill  competitive_bidding/jordan_2nt
  skill  competitive_bidding/bromad
  param  jordan = competitive_bidding/jordan_2nt:over_major default false
  param  bromad = competitive_bidding/bromad default false
  param  drury_comp = bidding_conventions/drury:in_comp default false
  param  drury   = bidding_conventions/drury default false
  param  rdrury  = bidding_conventions/drury:reverse default false
  param  tfr     = bidding_conventions/transfers_after_double default false
  param  system  = general.system   # `brill`: the Brill card's treatments (Jordan 2NT)

# ── Jordan 2NT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Above the redouble (priority 1): with a four-card fit the raise comes
# first, as BBA bids it (Jordan_2N: 375 of 500 boards). A passed hand
# that plays Drury over the double bids Drury instead (drury.bid).
after 1M (X) when jordan, !passed_hand | !drury_comp | !(drury | rdrury)
  2N  "Jordan 2NT: limit raise or better, four or more {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=4, tp(M)>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      when  system is not brill
      priority 2
  # brill (the Brill card): three trumps will do. Brill /explain,
  # 2026-10-15, "TruscottMajor, 10+ hcp": `(suitpoints('S') > 12 or hcp
  # >= 10) and S >= 3`.
  2N  "Jordan 2NT: limit raise or better, three or more {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=3, tp(M)>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      when  system is brill
      priority 2
  3{M} "Preemptive raise: four or more {M}, up to 7"
      shows M>=4, tp(M)<=7
      when  !bromad
      priority 1

# ── BROMAD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1M (X) when bromad, !tfr, !passed_hand | !drury_comp | !(drury | rdrury)
  2C  "BROMAD: constructive raise, three {M}, 7-9"
      alert  artificial
      shows M=3, tp(M)>=7, tp(M)<=9
      priority 2
  2D  "BROMAD: limit raise or better, three {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M=3, tp(M)>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      priority 2
  3C  "BROMAD: constructive raise, four or more {M}, 7-9"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=4, tp(M)>=7, tp(M)<=9
      priority 2
  2{M} "BROMAD: preemptive raise, three {M}, up to 6"
      shows M=3, tp(M)<=6
      priority 1
  3{M} "BROMAD: preemptive raise, four or more {M}, up to 6"
      shows M>=4, tp(M)<=6
      priority 1
after 1M (X) when bromad, !jordan, !tfr
  3D  "BROMAD: limit raise or better, four or more {M}"
      alert  artificial
      shows M>=4, tp(M)>=10
      sets  forcing=round, ask=limit_raise(M)
      priority 2
  2N  "BROMAD: weak, five-five or better in the minors"
      alert  artificial
      shows C>=5, D>=5, hcp<=6, M<=2
      priority 2

# Opener after the constructive raises: the game with 17+ support points
# opposite 2♣ (15+ opposite 3♣), an invitation with 15-16 opposite 2♣,
# else the cheapest bid in the major.
after 1M (X) 2C (P) | 1M (X) 2C (XX) when bromad
  4{M} "Game: 17+"     shows tp(M)>=17
  3{M} "Invites game: 15-16"                           shows tp(M)>=15, tp(M)<=16
  2{M} "Minimum: nothing more"                         priority -1
after 1M (X) 3C (P) | 1M (X) 3C (XX) when bromad
  4{M} "Game: 15+"   shows tp(M)>=15
  3{M} "Minimum: nothing more"                                  priority -1
after 1M (X) 2C (P) 3M (P) when bromad
  4{M} "Accepts: the top of the constructive raise"    shows tp(M)>=9
  P    "Declines"                                      priority -1

# Responder after opener's sign-off over the limit raise: the game with
# an opening hand.
after 1M (X) 2N (P) 3M (P) | 1M (X) 2D (P) 2M (P) | 1M (X) 3D (P) 3M (P) when jordan | bromad
  4{M} "Game: 13+ opposite opener's minimum"           shows tp(M)>=13
  P    "Limit raise only"                priority -1
files.rules/competitive/western-cue.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Western cue bid: once both of us have bid and they have bid a suit, a
# cue bid of their suit (three of it, or two when that is cheaper) asks partner to bid 3NT with a stopper
# there; without one partner makes a natural descriptive bid. It is for
# a side with game values, no major fit and no stopper in their suit.
# Card field `slam.western_cuebid.play` (the card files it under slam).
# A module of its own, outside slam/: it is a competitive tool. Notes:
# western-cue.notes.md.

module western-cue "Western cue bid: three of their suit asks for a stopper for 3NT"
  kind   convention
  needs  base
  skill  bidding_conventions/western_cuebid
  param  western = bidding_conventions/western_cuebid default false

# Game values between us, no major fit and no stopper of mine in their
# suit. The cue is the cheapest bid in their suit, at the two or three
# level (`cheapest_rank`: 3♣ 15, 3♦ 16, 3♥ 17, 3♠ 18). Both of us have
# bid, so it is never the first-round cue raise (after-interference.bid).
define wc_values = points + partner.points.min >= 25
define wc_no_major_fit = we.fit(S).min <= 7, we.fit(H).min <= 7

# ── The ask ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

when western, they.bid, !asked, !answered western, me.bids >= 1, partner.bids >= 1, we.trump is none | we.trump is C | we.trump is D
  cheapest(C)  "Western cue: a club stopper for 3NT?"  alert
      when  they.strain is C, cheapest_rank(C) <= 15
      when  !stop(C), wc_values, wc_no_major_fit
      sets  ask=western(C), forcing=game
      artificial
      priority 2
  cheapest(D)  "Western cue: a diamond stopper for 3NT?"  alert
      when  they.strain is D, cheapest_rank(D) <= 16
      when  !stop(D), wc_values, wc_no_major_fit
      sets  ask=western(D), forcing=game
      artificial
      priority 2
  cheapest(H)  "Western cue: a heart stopper for 3NT?"  alert
      when  they.strain is H, cheapest_rank(H) <= 17
      when  !stop(H), wc_values, wc_no_major_fit
      sets  ask=western(H), forcing=game
      artificial
      priority 2
  cheapest(S)  "Western cue: a spade stopper for 3NT?"  alert
      when  they.strain is S, cheapest_rank(S) <= 18
      when  !stop(S), wc_values, wc_no_major_fit
      sets  ask=western(S), forcing=game
      artificial
      priority 2

# ── The answer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# 3NT with a stopper. Without one, the natural descriptive bid: a suit of
# five or more of my own, or support for partner's suit (seven cards
# between us on his shown length), the longer fit first. With none of those,
# 3NT anyway (a stopper is likelier than not to be missing from the
# asker's partner only).

when western, asked western(y)
  3N  "A stopper in {y}: 3NT"
      shows stop(y)
      priority 2
  cheapest(C)  "No stopper in {y}: clubs"
      when  y is not C, C>=5 | we.fit(C).min>=7
      prefer C + partner.C.min
  cheapest(D)  "No stopper in {y}: diamonds"
      when  y is not D, D>=5 | we.fit(D).min>=7
      prefer D + partner.D.min
  cheapest(H)  "No stopper in {y}: hearts"
      when  y is not H, H>=5 | we.fit(H).min>=7
      prefer H + partner.H.min
  cheapest(S)  "No stopper in {y}: spades"
      when  y is not S, S>=5 | we.fit(S).min>=7
      prefer S + partner.S.min
  3N  "3NT: no stopper, no suit to show"
      priority -5

# ── The asker places the contract ─────────────────────────────────────
#
# 3NT stands. Over a suit: game in a major fit, else five of our best
# minor fit; 3NT once more if partner's suit is a minor and no fit.

when western, answered western(y)
  P   "Plays 3NT"
      when  partner.last = 3N
      priority 2
  4H  "Game in the heart fit"
      when  we.fit(H).min >= 8
  4S  "Game in the spade fit"
      when  we.fit(S).min >= 8
  5C  "Game in clubs: no stopper"
      when  we.fit(C).min >= 8
      prefer we.fit(C).min
  5D  "Game in diamonds: no stopper"
      when  we.fit(D).min >= 8
      prefer we.fit(D).min
  P   "Plays partner's game"
      when  partner.last = 4H | partner.last = 4S | partner.last = 5C | partner.last = 5D
      priority 1
files.rules/majors/bergen.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Bergen raises: over partner's 1♥/1♠ (RHO passing), responder's jumps
# show four-card raises by strength, so opener knows the fit and the
# values at once:
#
#   Bergen         (`major_openings.bergen_raises.play`)     3♣ constructive 7-10, 3♦ limit 11-12
#   Reverse Bergen (`major_openings.bergen_raises.reverse`)  3♣ limit 11-12, 3♦ constructive 7-10
#   either                                                    3M preemptive, about 3-6
#
# Support points (shortness counted). Game-forcing raises stay with Jacoby
# 2NT and splinters. (Bridge Bum, "Bergen Raises"; Bergen & Cohen; the
# PBS scenario Bergen_Raises.) With both switches, Reverse. See
# bergen.notes.md.

module bergen "Bergen raises: four-card raises at the three level"
  kind   convention
  needs  responses
  skill  bidding_conventions/bergen_raises
  skill  bidding_conventions/reverse_bergen_raises
  param  bergen  = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises default false
  param  reverse = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises:reverse default false
  param  drury   = bidding_conventions/drury default false
  param  drury_r = bidding_conventions/drury:reverse default false

# ── Responder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
after 1M (P) when bergen | reverse
  3C  "Bergen: constructive raise, 4 {M}, 7-10 support points"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=7..10, hcp>=5
      when  !reverse
      when  M=4 | hcp>=8               # five trumps and 5-7 HCP: the jump to game
      sets  trump=M
      artificial
      priority 1                       # the four-card raise, ahead of 2M or a new suit
  3D  "Bergen: limit raise, 4 {M}, 11-12 support points"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=11..12, hcp<=12
      when  !reverse
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_r)   # a passed hand's limit raise is Drury's 2♣
      sets  trump=M
      artificial
      priority 1
  3D  "Reverse Bergen: constructive raise, 4 {M}, 7-10 support points"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=7..10, hcp>=5
      when  reverse
      when  M=4 | hcp>=8
      sets  trump=M
      artificial
      priority 1
  3C  "Reverse Bergen: limit raise, 4 {M}, 11-12 support points"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=11..12, hcp<=12
      when  reverse
      when  !passed_hand | (!drury, !drury_r)
      sets  trump=M
      artificial
      priority 1
  # Five trumps and a weak hand keep the jump to game (responses.bid).
  3M  "Bergen: preemptive raise, four {M}, about 3-6"
      shows M>=4, tp(M)<=7, hcp<=6, hcp>=2
      when  M=4 | hcp<=3
      sets  trump=M, ask=preemptive_raise(M)
      priority 1

# ── Opener ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Written against the auction, not as a question (`ask=`): a pending
# question would shut out the slam rules, which have the big hands.
define bergen_constructive(M) = (bergen, !reverse, partner.last=3C) | (reverse, partner.last=3D)
define bergen_limit(M)        = (bergen, !reverse, partner.last=3D) | (reverse, partner.last=3C)

# Opposite 7-10 with a nine-card fit: game from 17, invite with 15-16
# (the cheapest step is a game try in Bergen; with Reverse Bergen and
# hearts there is no step below 3♥, so opener decides).
after 1M (P) 3x (P) when x is C | x is D, bergen | reverse, bergen_constructive(M)
  4M  "Game opposite a constructive raise: 17-20"
      shows tp(M)=17..20
      when  M is S | x is C
      priority 3                       # ahead of opener's natural rebids
  4M  "Game opposite a constructive raise: 16-20"
      shows tp(M)=16..20
      when  M is H, x is D
      priority 3
  4M  "Game opposite a constructive raise"
      shows tp(M)>=16
      priority -1                      # with more, the slam rules first
  # The game try outranks the control bids (slam/control-bids.bid, 12),
  # which would otherwise read it as a control bid opposite a limited
  # raise and send responder cue-bidding to the five level (as in
  # game-tries.bid).
  3D  "Game try opposite a constructive raise: 15-16"  alert
      shows tp(M)=15..16
      when  x is C
      artificial
      priority 13
  3H  "Game try opposite a constructive raise: 15-16"  alert
      shows tp(M)=15..16
      when  x is D, M is S
      artificial
      priority 13
  # A minimum: with more than 16 and no slam route, the 4M fallback.
  3M  "Sign off opposite a constructive raise"
      shows tp(M)<=14
      when  M is S | x is C
      priority 2
  3M  "Sign off opposite a constructive raise"
      shows tp(M)<=15
      when  M is H, x is D
      priority 2

# Opposite 11-12: game from 14.
after 1M (P) 3x (P) when x is C | x is D, bergen | reverse, bergen_limit(M)
  4M  "Game opposite a limit raise: 14-18"
      shows tp(M)=14..18
      priority 3
  4M  "Game opposite a limit raise"
      shows tp(M)>=14
      priority -1                      # with more, the slam rules first
  3M  "Sign off opposite a limit raise: a minimum"
      shows tp(M)<=13
      priority 3

# Responder after the game try.
after 1M (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) when bergen, !reverse
  4M  "Accepts the game try: the top of the constructive raise"
      shows tp(M)>=9
      priority 3
  3M  "Declines the game try"
      priority 2
after 1S (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) when reverse
  4S  "Accepts the game try: the top of the constructive raise"
      shows tp(S)>=9
      priority 3
  3S  "Declines the game try"
      priority 2

# Opener after responder declines: the try was 15-16, so pass. A bigger
# hand that got here through a control bid (read as the try) bids game.
after 1M (P) 3C (P) 3D (P) 3M (P) when bergen, !reverse
  P   "No further bid"
      shows tp(M)<=16
      priority 2
  4M  "Game after the declined try: extra values"
      shows tp(M)>=17
      priority 2
after 1S (P) 3D (P) 3H (P) 3S (P) when reverse
  P   "No further bid"
      shows tp(S)<=16
      priority 2
  4S  "Game after the declined try: extra values"
      shows tp(S)>=17
      priority 2

# Responder after opener's sign-off.
after 1M (P) 3x (P) 3M (P) when x is C | x is D, bergen | reverse
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 2

# Opener after the preemptive 3M: jump-raises.bid (`asked preemptive_raise`).
files.rules/majors/drury.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Drury: after partner's third- or fourth-seat 1♥/1♠, a passed hand's 2♣
# is artificial: a fit and limit-raise values, the hand that would
# otherwise jump to 3M. Opener says whether game is possible:
#
#   original Drury (`major_openings.drury.play`)    2♦ sub-minimum, 2M full opening
#   Reverse Drury  (`major_openings.drury.reverse`) 2M sub-minimum, 2♦ full opening
#
# (Bridgebum, "Drury"; Wikipedia, "Drury convention"; BBA's opener,
# probes/drury-opener-*.toml, plays exactly these meanings.) Either switch
# turns the convention on; with both, Reverse. Two-way Drury
# (`drury.two_d`): 2♣ promises exactly three trumps, 2♦ four or more.
# `drury.in_comp` keeps 2♣ Drury over a double or a one-level overcall.
# See drury.notes.md.

module drury "Drury: a passed hand's 2♣ limit raise"
  kind   convention
  needs  responses
  skill  bidding_conventions/drury
  skill  bidding_conventions/reverse_drury
  skill  bidding_conventions/two_way_drury
  param  drury   = bidding_conventions/drury default false
  param  reverse = bidding_conventions/drury:reverse default false
  param  two_way = bidding_conventions/drury:two_d default false
  param  in_comp = bidding_conventions/drury:in_comp default false

# ── Responder: the limit raise, at the two level ─────────────────────
# 10-12 support points: a point below the unpassed limit raise
# (responses.bid, 11-12), which is where BBA puts it too (9-11 total
# points, probes/drury-resp-*.toml). Starting at 10 beat 11 (+126 IMPs)
# and 9 (+34) on the corpus (drury.notes.md). It replaces the passed
# hand's jump to 3M, and natural 2♣ goes with it.
after 1M (P) when passed_hand, drury | reverse
  2C  "Drury: 3+ {M}, limit-raise values"  alert
      shows M>=3, tp(M)=10..12, hcp<=12
      when  !two_way
      sets  trump=M, ask=drury(M), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 1                       # ahead of the natural calls a fit could make
  2C  "Drury: exactly three {M}, limit-raise values"  alert
      shows M=3, tp(M)=10..12, hcp<=12
      when  two_way
      sets  trump=M, ask=drury(M), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 1
  2D  "Two-way Drury: 4+ {M}, limit-raise values"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=10..12, hcp<=12
      when  two_way
      sets  trump=M, ask=drury(M), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 1

after 1M (X) | 1M (1x) when passed_hand, in_comp, drury | reverse
  2C  "Drury: 3+ {M}, limit-raise values"  alert
      shows M>=3, tp(M)=10..12, hcp<=12
      sets  trump=M, ask=drury(M), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 1

# ── Opener: is game possible? ────────────────────────────────────────
# Facing 10-12 support points, game wants about 25 between us: 15+
# support points bid it, 13-14 show a full opening and leave it to
# responder, 12 or fewer (the light third-seat openings) stop in 2M.
# BBA draws the line one point lower (its sub-minimum 2♥ is 11-12 total
# points, drury-opener-21GF-DEFAULT); we count shortness, it does not.
when asked drury(M), rho.last=P, partner.last=2C
  2M  "Sub-minimum: no game opposite a limit raise"
      shows tp(M)<=12
      when  reverse
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids
  2D  "Reverse Drury: a full opening, 13-14 support points"  alert
      shows tp(M)=13..14
      when  reverse
      artificial
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids
  2D  "Drury: a sub-minimum opening"  alert
      shows tp(M)<=12
      when  !reverse
      artificial
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids
  2M  "A full opening, 13-14 support points"
      shows tp(M)=13..14
      when  !reverse
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids
  4M  "Game: 15+ support points"
      shows tp(M)>=15
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids

# After two-way Drury's 2♦ (four trumps) the ninth trump is worth a
# point: 13 bids game.
when asked drury(M), rho.last=P, partner.last=2D
  2M  "Sub-minimum: no game opposite a four-card limit raise"
      shows tp(M)<=12
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids
  4M  "Game opposite a four-card limit raise"
      shows tp(M)>=13
      priority 3                       # the answer, ahead of opener's natural rebids

# ── Responder: game or not ───────────────────────────────────────────
when answered drury(M), partner.last=2{M}, reverse
  P   "Partner is sub-minimum: play 2{M}"
      priority 2                       # ahead of responder's natural rebids
when answered drury(M), partner.last=2D, !reverse
  2M  "Partner is sub-minimum: play 2{M}"
      priority 2
# A full opening (13-14) facing 10-12: game with the top of the range.
when answered drury(M), partner.last=2D, reverse
  4M  "Game facing a full opening"   shows tp(M)>=12 | (tp(M)=11, M>=4)
      priority 2
  2M  "Sign off facing a full opening"
      priority 1
when answered drury(M), partner.last=2{M}, !reverse
  4M  "Game facing a full opening"   shows tp(M)>=12 | (tp(M)=11, M>=4)
      priority 2
  P   "No game facing a full opening"
      priority 1

# Opener, after responder signs off.
after 1M (P) 2C (P) 2D (P) 2M (P)
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 2
files.rules/majors/game-tries.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Game tries after a single raise of a major, 1M-2M, uncontested. Without
# a convention opener invites with 3M (rebids.bid). With
#
#   help-suit tries (`other_conventions.help_suit_game_tries.play`):
#       a new suit below 3M is a long-suit try: 3+ cards that need help
#   two-way tries (`other_conventions.two_way_game_tries.play`):
#       the next step (1♥-2♥-2♠, 1♠-2♠-2NT) shows unspecified shortness;
#       responder's next step asks where it is; opener names the short
#       suit, or bids 3M when it is one of the two step suits. Any other
#       call below 3M is a long-suit try, three or more cards with some
#       honours (over 1♥, 2NT is the spade try, with four);
#       3M is a general try, no singleton or void.
#
# (BBO, "GIB system notes", Two-way Game Try; Bridge Bum, "Help Suit Game
# Try"; the PBS scenarios Two-Way_Game_Try and Help_Suit_Game_Try.)
# See game-tries.notes.md.

module game-tries "Help-suit and two-way game tries after 1M-2M"
  kind   convention
  needs  rebids
  skill  bidding_conventions/help_suit_game_try
  skill  bidding_conventions/two_way_game_tries
  param  two_way = bidding_conventions/two_way_game_tries default false
  param  help    = bidding_conventions/help_suit_game_try default false

# The invitational range of rebids.bid's 3M (17-18 support points), with
# 14 HCP at least: BBA passes 15 HCP and a singleton opposite a raise
# (Two-Way_Game_Try), and a singleton honour counts twice in tp.
define try_values(M) = tp(M)=17..18, hcp>=14
# Shortness worth showing: a void, or a singleton other than the K, Q, J.
define small_short(x) = x=0 | (x=1, !has(K,x), !has(Q,x), !has(J,x))
define short_side(M) = (M is not C, small_short(C)) | (M is not D, small_short(D)) | (M is not H, small_short(H)) | (M is not S, small_short(S))
# A suit that needs help: three or more cards with two or three losers.
define needs_help(x) = x>=3, !(has(A,x), has(K,x)), !(has(A,x), has(Q,x)), !(has(K,x), has(Q,x))
# A two-way long-suit try (GIB): three or more cards with some honours.
define long_try(x) = x>=3, has(A,x) | has(K,x) | has(Q,x)
# Partner's help in my try suit: at most one loser there, or four cards.
define helps(x) = x>=4, has(A,x) | has(K,x) | has(Q,x) | x<=1 | (x=2, has(A,x) | has(K,x)) | (has(A,x), has(K,x)) | (has(A,x), has(Q,x)) | (has(K,x), has(Q,x))
# Partner's honours wasted opposite my shortness.
define wasted(x) = has(K,x) | has(Q,x) | has(J,x)

# ── Opener's tries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Priorities above the control bids (slam/control-bids.bid, 12): over a
# single raise a new suit is a game try, and partner must read it so.
# A control bid there needs 23+ (33 opposite a raise to 10), which the
# tries' 17-18 never reach.
after 1H (P) 2H (P) when two_way
  2S  "Short-suit game try: a singleton or void somewhere, 17-18"  alert
      shows try_values(H), short_side(H), H>=5
      sets  ask=short_try(H), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 14                      # shortness first, ahead of a long-suit try
  # Four spades with the ace or KQ: BBA tries 2NT ahead of the
  # short-suit try (Two-Way_Game_Try: every 2NT holds four such spades,
  # singleton or not; QJ86 and KT32 make the short-suit try).
  2N  "Long-suit game try in spades: four good spades, 17-18"  alert
      shows try_values(H), S>=4, has(A,S) | (has(K,S), has(Q,S))
      sets  ask=help_try(S), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 15                      # ahead of the short-suit try
after 1S (P) 2S (P) when two_way
  2N  "Short-suit game try: a singleton or void somewhere, 17-18"  alert
      shows try_values(S), short_side(S), S>=5
      sets  ask=short_try(S), forcing=round
      artificial
      priority 14
after 1H (P) 2H (P) when help, !two_way
  2S  "Help-suit game try: help wanted in spades, 17-18"
      shows try_values(H), needs_help(S)
      sets  ask=help_try(S), forcing=round
      priority 13
after 1M (P) 2M (P) when two_way
  3x  "Long-suit game try: 3+ {x} with honours, 17-18"
      shows try_values(M), long_try(x)
      when  x is not M, M is S | x is not S
      sets  ask=help_try(x), forcing=round
      prefer x
      priority 13
after 1M (P) 2M (P) when help, !two_way
  3x  "Help-suit game try: help wanted in {x}, 17-18"
      shows try_values(M), needs_help(x)
      when  x is not M, M is S | x is not S
      sets  ask=help_try(x), forcing=round
      prefer x
      priority 13

# ── Responder after a short-suit try ─────────────────────────────────
# Accept with the top of the raise, sign off with the bottom, and with
# the middle ask where the shortness is: honours there are wasted.
when asked short_try(M), rho.last=P
  4M  "Accepts the short-suit try: the top of the raise"
      shows tp(M)>=10
      priority 3                       # ahead of responder's natural rebids
  3M  "Declines the short-suit try: the bottom of the raise"
      shows tp(M)<=6
      priority 3
  2N  "Where is the shortness?"  alert
      shows tp(M)=7..9
      when  M is H
      sets  ask=where_short(M)
      artificial
      priority 3
  3C  "Where is the shortness?"  alert
      shows tp(M)=7..9
      when  M is S
      sets  ask=where_short(M)
      artificial
      priority 3

# Opener names the short suit; 3M when it is one of the step suits.
when asked where_short(M), rho.last=P
  3x  "Shortness in {x}"  alert
      shows x<=1
      when  x is not M, M is S | x is not S, M is H | x is not C
      artificial
      priority 3
  3M  "Shortness: ♠ over 1♥, ♣ over 1♠"  alert
      shows S<=1 | M is S
      shows C<=1 | M is H
      artificial
      priority 2

# Responder: game without wasted honours opposite the shortness.
when answered where_short(M), rho.last=P
  4M  "No wasted honours opposite the shortness: game"
      when  !partner.last=3{M}
      shows !wasted(C) | !partner.last=3C, !wasted(D) | !partner.last=3D, !wasted(H) | !partner.last=3H
      priority 3
  4M  "No wasted honours in either step suit: game"
      when  partner.last=3{M}
      shows !wasted(S) | M is S, !wasted(C) | M is H
      priority 3
  P   "Wasted honours opposite the shortness: no game"
      when  partner.last=3{M}
      priority 2
  3M  "Wasted honours opposite the shortness: no game"
      when  !partner.last=3{M}
      priority 2

# ── Responder after a long-suit (help-suit) try ──────────────────────
when asked help_try(x), rho.last=P
  # Help in the try suit, or the top of the raise.
  4{trump} "Accepts the help-suit try"
      shows helps(x) | tp(trump)>=10 | (tp(trump)>=8, has(A,x) | has(K,x) | x=2)
      priority 3
  3{trump} "Declines the help-suit try"
      priority 2

# Opener after a sign-off: the try was all opener had. Priority above
# the control bids (12), which would otherwise read a limited hand's
# slam values into it.
when answered help_try(x), rho.last=P, partner.last=3{trump}
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 13
when answered short_try(M), rho.last=P, partner.last=3{M}
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 13
after 1H (P) 2H (P) 2S (P) 2N (P) 3x (P) 3H (P) when two_way, x is not H
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 13
after 1S (P) 2S (P) 2N (P) 3C (P) 3x (P) 3S (P) when two_way, x is not S
  P   "No further bid"
      priority 13
files.rules/majors/jacoby-2nt.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.

module jacoby-2nt "Jacoby 2NT"
  kind   convention
  needs  base
  skill  bidding_conventions/jacoby_2nt
  param  jacoby   = bidding_conventions/jacoby_2nt default false
  param  modified = bidding_conventions/modified_jacoby_2nt default false
  param  rkcb     = bidding_conventions/roman_keycard default false
  param  bw       = bidding_conventions/blackwood default false

after 1M (P) when !passed_hand, jacoby | modified
  2N  "Jacoby 2NT: 4+ {M}, game forcing"  alert
      shows M>=4, tp(M)>=13
      sets  trump=M, forcing=game, ask=jacoby   # trump agreed from here on
      artificial
      priority 1                       # ahead of a natural new suit (responses.bid)

# Opener's answers. Modified Jacoby 2NT has its own (modified-jacoby-2nt.bid).
after 1M (P) 2N (P) when jacoby, !modified
  3x  "Singleton or void in {x}"      shows x<=1                when x is not M  artificial
  4x  "Good 5-card side suit"         shows x>=5, quality(x)>=good  when x is not M
  3M  "18+, no shortness"             shows hcp>=18, shortest>=2
  3N  "15-17, no shortness"           shows hcp=15..17, shortest>=2
  4M  "Minimum, no shortness"         shows hcp<=14, shortest>=2

# Responder after the shortness (Rick, 2026-11-07: the goal of Jacoby
# 2NT, like the relays and splinters, is to find the slams where every
# high card works). Honours opposite the singleton or void are wasted
# (slam-entry.bid, `working_count`): with the working count for slam on
# opener's floor, responder asks for keycards; without it the slam
# modules decide (control bids, game), since opener's strength is still
# open: an explicit 4M sign-off here lost opener's extras (notes).
after 1M (P) 2N (P) 3x (P) when jacoby, !modified, x is not M
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}: opener's shortness fits"
      when  rkcb
      shows working_slam(M)
      sets  ask=keycards(M)
      artificial
      priority 14
  4N  "Blackwood: opener's shortness fits"
      when  bw, !rkcb
      shows working_slam(M)
      sets  ask=aces
      artificial
      priority 14

# Opener after responder's 4M (Rick, 2026-11-07: "for standard jacoby,
# survey bba to see where it decides to go on"). BBA's line, from the
# grids probes/jacoby-opener-1{S,H}-*-4{S,H}.toml (jacoby-2nt.notes.md):
# over the shortness answer it goes on with points + controls (A 2,
# K 1) of about 24 (19 points with five controls); over 3M with 20+
# points; over 3NT hardly ever; over the side suit nearly always (left
# to the slam modules). Par decides, BBA teaches: BBA's 24 cost 526
# IMPs on the corpus, so ours is 22 (83% agreement with BBA against its
# own 84%, par-neutral) and 19 points over our 18+ 3M. Going on is the
# slam modules' call, else the keycard ask.
define jac_on_short = points + controls >= 22
define jac_on_3m = points >= 19
after 1M (P) 2N (P) 3x (P) 4M (P) when jacoby, !modified, x is not M
  P   "Responder signed off: no extras for slam"
      shows !jac_on_short
      priority 16
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}: extras opposite the sign-off"
      when  rkcb
      shows jac_on_short
      sets  ask=keycards(M)
      artificial
      priority -10                     # the fallback: the slam modules' own calls first (exclusion, control bids)
after 1M (P) 2N (P) 3M (P) 4M (P) when jacoby, !modified
  P   "Responder signed off: no extras for slam"
      shows !jac_on_3m
      priority 16
  4N  "Keycard ask in {M}: extras opposite the sign-off"
      when  rkcb
      shows jac_on_3m
      sets  ask=keycards(M)
      artificial
      priority -10                     # the fallback: the slam modules' own calls first (exclusion, control bids)
after 1M (P) 2N (P) 3N (P) 4M (P) when jacoby, !modified
  P   "Responder signed off: 15-17 has no extras"
      shows !jac_on_short
      priority 16

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# The jump raise 1M-3M when it is not the limit raise (responses.bid):
#
#   weak  (`major_openings.jump_raise.weak`)   preemptive: four trumps, about 3-6
#   mixed (`major_openings.jump_raise.mixed`)  four trumps, 7-10 support points:
#                                              more than a raise to 2M, less than a limit raise
#
# The invitational jump raise (`jump_raise.inv`) wins when a card sets it
# too (BBA's cards set "Mixed raise" beside "1M-3M inviting", and BBA then
# plays 1M-3M inviting: probes/mixed-resp-1H-GIB.toml). Bergen raises
# (bergen.bid) take the jump to 3M when they are on. Uncontested only.
# (Bridge Bum, "Weak Jump Raise" and "Mixed Raise"; for the mixed raise,
# Larry Cohen, "Simple Overcalls",
# https://www.larryco.com/bridge-articles/simple-overcalls; the PBS scenario
# Gavin_Mixed_Raise: "Mixed 4-card Raise (8-10 TP) 3M".) See
# jump-raises.notes.md.

module jump-raises "Weak and mixed jump raises of a major"
  kind   convention
  needs  responses
  param  weak    = major_openings.jump_raise.weak default false
  param  mixed   = major_openings.jump_raise.mixed default false
  param  inv     = major_openings.jump_raise.inv default true
  param  bergen  = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises default false
  param  reverse = bidding_conventions/bergen_raises:reverse default false

after 1M (P) when !bergen, !reverse, !inv
  3M  "Weak jump raise: four {M}, about 3-6"
      shows M>=4, tp(M)<=7, hcp<=6, hcp>=2
      when  weak
      when  M=4 | hcp<=3               # five trumps and a weak hand: 4M (responses.bid)
      sets  trump=M, ask=preemptive_raise(M)
      priority 1
  3M  "Mixed raise: four {M}, 7-10 support points"
      shows M>=4, tp(M)=7..10, hcp>=5
      when  mixed, !weak
      sets  trump=M, ask=mixed_raise(M)
      priority 1                       # the four-card raise, ahead of 2M or a new suit

# Opposite a mixed raise (7-10, nine trumps): game from 16.
when asked mixed_raise(M), rho.last=P, partner.last=3{M}
  4M  "Game opposite a mixed raise: 16+"
      shows tp(M)>=16
      priority 3                       # ahead of opener's natural rebids
  P   "No game opposite a mixed raise"
      priority 2

# Opener after a preemptive 3M, the weak jump raise or Bergen's (bergen.bid).
when asked preemptive_raise(M), rho.last=P, partner.last=3{M}
  4M  "Game opposite a preemptive raise: 19+"
      shows tp(M)>=19
      priority 3
  P   "No game opposite a preemptive raise"
      priority 2

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.

module choice-of-games "Choosing between 3NT and a major-suit game"
  kind   system
  needs  notrump-base

# Partner has bid 3NT offering a choice (after Stayman, or with five cards
# in a major after a transfer). Correct to four of a major with an
# eight-card fit, which is four opposite four or three opposite five.
when asked choice
  4H  "Corrects to the heart fit"   shows H>=8-partner.H.min  when partner.H>=4
  4S  "Corrects to the spade fit"   shows S>=8-partner.S.min  when partner.S>=4
  P   "Plays 3NT"

# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.

module minor-transfers "Minor-suit responses to 1NT"
  kind   convention
  needs  notrump-base
  skill  bidding_conventions/minor_suit_transfers
  param  mtp   = bidding_conventions/minor_suit_transfers:over_1nt default true    # a silent card plays relay, as before the switch (2026-10-30)
  param  style = bidding_conventions/minor_suit_transfers:style default relay
  param  systems_on = nt_overcalls.direct.systems_on default true
  param  vs_2c = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:vs_2c default false

# One card field chooses the treatment (see notes). Only the calls that
# start the sequence and opener's answer differ; responder's next call is
# written once, for every treatment, against `answered transfer(m)`.
#
# The transfers are for weak and invitational hands with no five-card major
# (with one, transfer to the major first). With game values, bid 3NT.

# ── relay (the default): 2S relays to 3C; pass with clubs, 3D with diamonds.
after nt1 when (!they.bid | systems_on), mtp, style is relay
  2S  "Relay to 3♣: a weak hand with a long minor"  alert
      shows C>=6 | D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, strength=signoff
      sets forcing=round, ask=relay
      artificial
after nt1 2S (P) when mtp, style is relay
  3C  "Completes the relay"  artificial
when answered relay
  P   "Clubs: play here"       shows C>=6
  3D  "Diamonds: play here"    shows D>=6

# ── four-way: 2S transfers to clubs, 2NT to diamonds. Opener shows good
# support (Kxx or better) by bidding the step below the suit (four_way) or the
# suit itself (four_way_reversed); the other call denies it.
after nt1 when (!they.bid | systems_on), mtp, style is four_way | style is four_way_reversed
  2S  "Transfer to clubs"      alert  shows C>=6, H<=4, S<=4, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(C)  artificial
  2N  "Transfer to diamonds"   alert  shows D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(D)  artificial

after nt1 2S (P) when mtp, style is four_way
  2N  "Good club support: Kxx or better"   alert  shows C>=3, has(A,C) | has(K,C)  artificial
  3C  "No good club support"
after nt1 2N (P) when mtp, style is four_way
  3C  "Good diamond support: Kxx or better"   alert  shows D>=3, has(A,D) | has(K,D)  artificial
  3D  "No good diamond support"

after nt1 2S (P) when mtp, style is four_way_reversed
  3C  "Good club support: Kxx or better"   shows C>=3, has(A,C) | has(K,C)
  2N  "No good club support"                alert  artificial
after nt1 2N (P) when mtp, style is four_way_reversed
  3D  "Good diamond support: Kxx or better"   shows D>=3, has(A,D) | has(K,D)
  3C  "No good diamond support"                alert  artificial

# ── bba: 2S transfers to clubs, 3C to diamonds; opener always completes.
after nt1 when (!they.bid | systems_on), mtp, style is bba
  2S  "Transfer to clubs"      alert  shows C>=6, H<=4, S<=4, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(C)  artificial
  3C  "Transfer to diamonds"   alert  shows D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(D)  artificial
after nt1 2S (P) when mtp, style is bba
  3C  "Completes the transfer"
after nt1 3C (P) when mtp, style is bba
  3D  "Completes the transfer"

# ── two_nt_three_c: 2NT transfers to clubs, 3C to diamonds; opener always
# completes. 2S stays free for Minor Suit Stayman (21GF-MSTandMSS). Any
# strength: with game values responder goes on after the completion.
after nt1_undoubled when (!they.bid | systems_on), mtp, style is two_nt_three_c
  2N  "Transfer to clubs: six or more clubs"  alert
      shows C>=6, D<=3, H<=3, S<=3
      sets  forcing=round, ask=transfer(C)
      artificial
      priority 1
  3C  "Transfer to diamonds: six or more diamonds"  alert
      shows D>=6, C<=3, H<=3, S<=3
      sets  forcing=round, ask=transfer(D)
      artificial
      priority 1                         # ahead of the natural 3♦ slam try
after nt1_undoubled 2N (P) when mtp, style is two_nt_three_c
  3C  "Completes the transfer"
after nt1_undoubled 3C (P) when mtp, style is two_nt_three_c
  3D  "Completes the transfer"

# ── Responder after any minor transfer. Game values: 3NT. Opposite good
# support the long minor should run, so invitational values bid 3NT too.
# Otherwise play the minor at the three level.
when answered transfer(m)
  P   "Play here"                          shows strength<=invite   when partner.last=3{m}
  3m  "Sign off in {m}"                    shows strength<=invite
  3N  "To play: {game} total points"       shows strength>=game
  3N  "To play: invitational values, a long {m}"   shows strength=invite    when partner.m>=3

# ── Over a 2♣ overcall of our 1NT (`notrump.jacoby_transfers.vs_2c`). Every
# treatment keeps its own calls: 2♣ was not one of them, so nothing
# moves. The minor transfer picks up the same five-HCP floor as the
# major ones: below that BBA leaves their 2♣ alone.
after 1N (2C) when vs_2c, mtp, style is relay
  2S  "Relay to 3♣: a weak hand with a long minor"  alert
      shows C>=6 | D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp>=5, strength=signoff
      sets forcing=round, ask=relay
      artificial
after 1N (2C) 2S (P) when vs_2c, mtp, style is relay
  3C  "Completes the relay"  artificial

after 1N (2C) when vs_2c, mtp, style is four_way | style is four_way_reversed
  2S  "Transfer to clubs"      alert  shows C>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp>=5, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(C)  artificial
  2N  "Transfer to diamonds"   alert  shows D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp>=5, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(D)  artificial

after 1N (2C) when vs_2c, mtp, style is bba
  2S  "Transfer to clubs"      alert  shows C>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp>=5, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(C)  artificial
  3C  "Transfer to diamonds"   alert  shows D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp>=5, strength<=invite  sets forcing=round, ask=transfer(D)  artificial
after 1N (2C) 2S (P) when vs_2c, mtp, style is bba
  3C  "Completes the transfer"
after 1N (2C) 3C (P) when vs_2c, mtp, style is bba
  3D  "Completes the transfer"
files.rules/notrump/nt-interference.bid:
# Syntax: docs/LANGUAGE.md. Check with `rbb bid check`.
#
# Responder when RHO acts over our 1NT opening.
#
# Stayman and the transfers keep their own calls in `stayman.bid` and
# `jacoby-transfers.bid`, gated by the two card switches
# `notrump.jacoby_transfers.vs_double` and `notrump.jacoby_transfers.vs_2c`. What is
# left, and lives here, is what only exists because they bid: the
# redouble, the weak escapes when the transfers are off, and the pass.
#
# See nt-interference.notes.md for the BBA meanings behind the ranges.

module nt-interference "Our 1NT when RHO acts"
  kind   system
  needs  notrump-base
  skill  competitive_bidding/notrump_interference
  param  vs_double = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:vs_double default false
  param  vs_2c     = bidding_conventions/jacoby_transfers:vs_2c default false
  param  leb       = competitive_bidding/lebensohl:over_1nt_interference default false
  param  rub       = competitive_bidding/rubensohl:over_1nt_interference default false

# ── They doubled, transfers on ───────────────────────────────────────
# 2♣ is Stayman and 2♦/2♥ are the transfers (see the other modules).
# Everything else with values redoubles: partner has 15-17 and they have
# opened their mouth on the rest, so the hand is ours.
after 1N (X) when vs_double
  XX  "Values: 6+ HCP, no suit to show"
      shows hcp>=6
      priority -1
  P   "Not enough to act over the double"
      shows hcp<=5
      priority -10

# ── They doubled, transfers off ──────────────────────────────────────
# Without the transfers the two-level calls are natural escapes: a weak
# hand runs to its own long suit and everything else passes. The cut is
# four HCP, measured against BBA on the cards that leave the switch off
# (see the notes): at five and up BBA sits for the double whatever the
# shape, and running there loses more calls than it wins. There is no
# redouble here for the same reason — BBA redoubles only about one hand
# in twenty-five, and no condition we can write picks those out.
after 1N (X) when !vs_double
  2H  "Weak: five or more hearts, running from the double"
      shows H>=5, H>=S, hcp<=4
  2S  "Weak: five or more spades, running from the double"
      shows S>=5, hcp<=4
  2C  "Weak: six or more clubs, running from the double"
      shows C>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp<=4
  2D  "Weak: six or more diamonds, running from the double"
      shows D>=6, H<=4, S<=4, hcp<=4
  P   "Sitting for the double"
      priority -10

# Opener after responder's escape over the double: partner's suit is
# where we play (2026-09-28: 179 no-rule boards once the opponents'
# Cappelletti doubled for penalties).
after 1N (X) 2y (P) when !vs_double, y is not N
  P   "Partner's escape: to play"

after 1N (X) XX (P)
  P   "Playing 1NT redoubled"

# Our redouble, and they run: opener passes, leaving it to responder,
# who doubles for penalties with four of their suit or 9+ HCP.
after 1N (X) XX (*) when !rho.last=P
  P   "Partner redoubled: his decision"
after 1N (X) XX (2y) P (P)
  X   "Penalty"                                  shows y>=4 | hcp>=9
  P   "No further bid"                             priority -5

# Over a 2♣ overcall with `vs_2c` on nothing new is needed: the double
# is Stayman (stayman.bid), the transfers keep their calls
# (jacoby-transfers.bid, minor-transfers.bid, texas-transfers.bid) and
# the natural notrump calls and the pass are in one-nt.bid. With it off,
# a natural 2♣ has its own rules below.

# ── They overcalled 2♦, 2♥ or 2♠ ─────────────────────────────────────
# Their natural two-level overcall (2026-09-25; nt-interference.notes.md,
# probes/nt-2D-resp, nt-2H-resp, nt-2S-resp). No Lebensohl on the Basic
# card, so everything is natural except the double, which BBA plays as
# negative: four cards in an unbid major and 5+ HCP (over 2♠ five hearts
# with a weak hand too). A new suit at the two level is weak and to play,
# a non-jump at the three level forcing to game (BBA bids 3NT rather than
# jump in a five-card major); 2NT invites with 8-9 and 3NT is game from
# 10 (BBA does not insist on a stopper); four of a major is six cards
# and 10+.
after 1N (2y) when y is not C, rho.y>=4, (maybe rho.H<=3) | (maybe rho.S<=3)
  X   "Negative double: four cards in an unbid major, 5+ HCP"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp>=5, S>=4 | H>=4
      when   y is D, S<=4, H<=4
      priority 1
  # Five hearts below 10 points double too: with 10+ they bid 3♥.
  X   "Negative double: four hearts, 5+ HCP"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp>=5, H=4 | (H=5, points<=9)
      when   y is S
      priority 1
  X   "Negative double: four spades, 5+ HCP"
      alert  artificial
      shows  hcp>=5, S=4
      when   y is H
      priority 1
  2H  "Natural, to play: five or more hearts"   shows H>=5, hcp>=4, points<=9
      when  y is D
  2S  "Natural, to play: five or more spades"   shows S>=5, hcp>=4, points<=9
